地球政府殖民地海军陆战队退役老兵远征队长

original: You feel too weak to summon new plasma...
translation: 你感觉太虚弱了，无法生成新的等离子体...

original: The cold vacuum instantly freezes you, maybe this was a bad idea?
translation: 冰冷的真空瞬间将你冻结，也许这不是个好主意？

original: You feel like you're burning from the inside!
[debuff_owner] rolls on the floor, trying to put themselves out!
translation: [debuff_owner]在地上打滚，试图扑灭身上的火焰！
[debuff_owner] 成功扑灭了身上的火焰！

original: You've fallen asleep. Wait a bit and you should wake up. Unless you don't, considering how helpless you are.
translation: 你已经睡着了。稍等片刻，你应该会醒来。除非你醒不来，考虑到你现在是多么无助。

original: You've been slept by an Admin.
translation: 你已被管理员强制睡眠。
你感到头晕目眩，意识模糊。

original: You've been irradiated! The effects of the radiation will continue to harm you until purged from your system.
translation: 你受到了辐射！辐射的影响将持续伤害你，直到从体内清除。

original: A dreadful presence. You are slowed down until this expires.
translation: 一股可怕的存在。你的速度会减慢，直到此效果消失。

original: A dreadful presence. You take constant stamina damage until this expires.
translation: 一股可怕的存在。在此效果持续期间，你将持续受到耐力伤害。

original: You are burning from the inside!
Space is very very cold, who would've thought?
translation: 太空真是冷得要命，谁能想到呢？

original: Your life force transfers to xenos when they slash you!
translation: 你的生命能量会在异形斩击你时转移给它们！

original: We have established an Essence Link with [link_target]. Stay within [DRONE_ESSENCE_LINK_RANGE] tiles to maintain it.
translation: 我们已与[link_target]建立精华链接。保持在[DRONE_ESSENCE_LINK_RANGE]格范围内以维持链接。

original: [link_owner] has established an Essence Link with us. Stay within [DRONE_ESSENCE_LINK_RANGE] tiles to maintain it.
translation: [link_owner] 已与我们建立了精华链接。请保持在 [DRONE_ESSENCE_LINK_RANGE] 格范围内以维持链接。

original: The Essence Link between us and [link_target] has been cancelled.
translation: 我们与[link_target]之间的精华链接已被取消。

original: The Essence Link between us and [link_owner] has been cancelled.
translation: 我们与[link_owner]之间的精华链接已被取消。
我们屈服于我们的饥渴！
我们的嗜血欲望平息了...

original: You feel your wounds being restored by [owner_xeno]'s pheromones.
translation: 你感到自己的伤口正在被[owner_xeno]的信息素修复。

original: Our feast has come to an end...
translation: 我们的盛宴已经结束了……

original: We feel on top of the world! Go, go, go!
translation: 我们感觉棒极了！冲，冲，冲！

original: We come down from our adrenaline high.
translation: 我们从肾上腺素飙升的状态中平复下来。

original: [buff_target]'s chitin begins to gleam with an unseemly glow...
translation: [buff_target]的甲壳开始闪烁着不祥的光芒……
没有等离子体用于链接！
没有等离子体用于链接！
你的攻击能恢复生命值。

original: Your health is being restored at the cost of plasma.
translation: 你的生命值正在以消耗等离子体为代价恢复。
你的等离子体再生速度加快了。

original: Adrenaline is pushing your muscles to the limit!
translation: 肾上腺素正将你的肌肉推向极限！

original: [parent.name] now picks up all items in a tile at once.
translation: [parent.name] 现在会一次性拾取一个格子内的所有物品。

original: [parent.name] now picks up one item at a time.
translation: [parent.name] 现在一次只能拾取一件物品。

original: Clicking [parent.name] with an empty hand now puts the last stored item in your hand.
translation: 空手点击[parent.name]现在会将最后存放的物品放入手中。

original: Clicking [parent.name] with an empty hand now opens the pouch storage menu.
translation: 用空手点击[parent.name]现在会打开附包存储菜单。
[item_to_insert] 对于这个 [parent.name] 来说太长了。

original: \The [parent.name] cannot hold \the [item_to_insert] as it's a storage item of the same size.
translation: \The [parent.name] 无法容纳 \the [item_to_insert]，因为它是相同尺寸的存储物品。

original: \The [parent.name] can't fit any more of those.
You are busy doing something else!
You can't grab anything out of [parent] while it's not deployed.
translation: [parent]未展开时，你无法从中取出任何物品。

original: Server updated, changes will be applied on the next round...
translation: 服务器已更新，更改将在下一轮生效...

original: You feel the acid rain melting you away!
translation: 你感觉酸液雨正在将你融化！

original: The planet's thunderstorms are by nature acidic, and will incinerate anyone standing beneath them without protection.
translation: 这颗行星的雷暴天然带有酸液，任何未受保护站在其下方的人都会被烧成灰烬。

original: An intense atmospheric storm lifts ash off of the planet's surface and billows it down across the area, dealing intense fire damage to the unprotected.
translation: 一场强烈的风暴卷起行星表面的灰烬，席卷整个区域，对未受保护者造成严重的火焰伤害。

original: A passing ash storm blankets the area in harmless embers.
translation: 一阵掠过的灰烬风暴将这片区域笼罩在无害的余烬之中。

original: You are battered by the coarse sand!
translation: 你被粗糙的沙粒击中了！

original: A passing sandstorm blankets the area in sand.
translation: 一场经过的沙尘暴将这片区域笼罩在沙尘之中。

original: Harsh snowstorms roam the topside of this arctic planet, burying any area unfortunate enough to be in its path.
translation: 这颗极地行星的地表肆虐着猛烈的暴风雪，任何不幸处于其路径上的区域都会被积雪掩埋。

original: [user] fumbles around figuring out the wiring.
translation: [user] 笨手笨脚地摸索着线路。

original: [usr] fumbles around figuring out the wiring.
translation: [usr] 笨手笨脚地摸索着线路。

translation: 新星医疗中心综合医院 - 应急响应一号着陆区

Holds stuff, and sometimes goes swoosh.

original: You wear this on your back and put items into it. Usually one special item too.
translation: 你把它背在背上，然后把物品放进去。通常还能放一件特殊物品。

original: This backpack can hold 4 67mm shells, in addition to a recoiless launcher.
translation: 这个背包除了能装无后坐力炮外，还能容纳4枚67毫米炮弹。

original: This backpack can hold 6 67mm shells, in addition to a recoiless launcher.
translation: 这个背包可以容纳6发67毫米炮弹，外加一门无后坐力炮。

translation: 这个背包除了能装下一具火箭发射器外，还能容纳4枚火箭弹。

original: This backpack can hold 11 80mm mortar shells, in addition to the mortar itself.
translation: 这个背包除了能装下迫击炮本身外，还能容纳11枚80毫米迫击炮弹。

original: This backpack can carry its accompanying flamethrower as well as a modest general storage capacity. Automatically refuels it's accompanying flamethrower.

original: A large leather scabbard used to carry a M2132 machete. It can be strapped to the back, waist or armor.
translation: 一个用于携带M2132砍刀的大型皮质刀鞘。可固定在背部、腰部或护甲上。

original: A large, vibrantly colored katana scabbard used to carry a japanese sword. It can be strapped to the back, waist or armor. Because of the sturdy wood casing of the scabbard, it makes an okay defensive weapon in a pinch.
translation: 一个色彩鲜艳的大型武士刀鞘，用于携带日本刀。可以固定在背部、腰部或护甲上。由于刀鞘坚固的木制外壳，在紧急情况下也可作为凑合的防御武器。

original: A large leather scabbard used to carry a sword. Appears to be a reproduction, rather than an original. It can be strapped to the waist or to armor.
translation: 一个用于携带剑的大型皮革剑鞘。看起来是复制品，而非原品。可系在腰间或装甲上。

original: A large leather holster allowing the storage of any shotgun. It contains harnesses that allow it to be secured to the back for easy storage.
translation: 一个大型皮制枪套，可容纳任何霰弹枪。内含背带系统，可固定在背部以便于存放。

original: A large leather holster allowing the storage of an SH-35 Shotgun. It contains harnesses that allow it to be secured to the back for easy storage.
translation: 一个大型皮制枪套，可容纳SH-35霰弹枪。它包含背带，可将其固定在背部以便于存放。

original: The M276 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version is designed for the M25 SMG, and features a larger frame to support the gun. Due to its unorthodox design, it isn't a very common sight, and is only specially issued.
translation: M276是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的标准负重装备。它由一个带有各种夹扣的模块化腰带组成。此版本专为M25冲锋枪设计，并采用更大的框架以支撑该枪。由于其非正统的设计，它并不常见，仅为特殊配发。

original: The M276 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version is designed for the MP-19 SMG, and features a larger frame to support the gun. Due to its unorthodox design, it isn't a very common sight, and is only specially issued.
translation: M276是TGMC的标准携行装备。它由一个模块化腰带和各种夹扣组成。此版本专为MP-19冲锋枪设计，采用更大的框架以支撑该枪。由于其非正统的设计，它并不常见，仅作为特殊配发。

original: A pouch designed to hold flares and a single flaregun. Refillable with a M94 flare pack.
translation: 专为存放照明弹和一把信号枪设计的附包。可使用M94照明弹包补充。

original: A backpack holster allowing the storage of any a ML-41 Assault Machinegun, also carries ammo for the other portion of the system.
translation: 一个背包式枪套，可容纳任何ML-41突击机枪，并为系统的另一部分携带弹药。

original: A belt-holster assembly that allows one to hold a pistol and two magazines.
translation: 一种腰带式枪套组件，可容纳一把手枪和两个弹匣。

original: A pistol belt that is not a revolver belt
translation: 一条非左轮手枪的手枪腰带

original: The M4A3 is a common holster belt. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version has a holster assembly that allows one to carry a handgun. It also contains side pouches that can store 9mm or .45 magazines.
translation: M4A3是一种常见的枪套腰带。它由一条带有各种夹扣的模块化腰带组成。此版本带有一个枪套组件，可以携带手枪。它还包含侧附包，可以存放9毫米或.45口径弹匣。

original: A belt with origins dating back to old colony security holster rigs.
translation: 一条可追溯至旧殖民地安保枪套装备的腰带。

original: A quality pistol belt of a style typically seen worn by SOM officers. It looks old, but well looked after.
translation: 一款质量上乘的手枪腰带，采用火星之子军官常见的款式。看起来有些年头，但保养得很好。

original: The M276 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version has a holster assembly that allows one to carry the M4A3 comfortably secure. It also contains side pouches that can store 9mm or .45 magazines.
translation: M276是TGMC的标准负重装备。它由一条模块化腰带和各种夹扣组成。这个版本配备了一个枪套组件，可以舒适安全地携带M4A3手枪。它还包含侧附包，可以存放9毫米或.45口径弹匣。

original: The T457 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips.
translation: T457是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的标准承载装备。它由一个带有多个附包的模块化腰带组成。

original: The T457 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips.
translation: T457是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的标准承载装备。它由一个带有多个附包的模块化腰带组成。

original: The M276 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version is for the M44 magnum revolver, along with three pouches for speedloaders.
translation: M276是TGMC的标准负重装备。它由一条模块化腰带和各种夹扣组成。此版本适用于M44马格南左轮手枪，并配有三个用于快速装弹器的附包。

original: The M276 is the standard load-bearing equipment of the TGMC. It consists of a modular belt with various clips. This version is for the powerful Mateba magnum revolver, along with three pouches for speedloaders.
translation: M276是TGMC的标准负重装备。它由一条模块化腰带和各种夹扣组成。此版本适用于强大的马特巴马格南左轮手枪，并配有可容纳三个快速装弹器的附包。

original: A modification of the standard UPP pouch rig to carry a single Korovin PK-9 pistol. It also contains side pouches that can store .22 magazines, either hollowpoints or tranquilizers.
translation: 这是标准UPP附包携行具的改进型号，用于携带一把科罗温PK-9手枪。它还包含侧袋，可存放.22口径弹匣，无论是空尖弹还是麻醉弹。

original: A purpose built belt-holster assembly that holds a SH-34 shotgun and one shell box or 2 handfuls.
translation: 专门设计的腰带式枪套组件，可容纳一把SH-34霰弹枪以及一个弹药盒或两把弹药。

original: A holster belt, which holds SP-13 smart machinepistol and magazines for it.
translation: 一个枪套腰带，可容纳SP-13智能冲锋手枪及其弹匣。

original: The force of the blow sends the contents of [src] flying!
translation: 这一击的力道让[src]里的东西都飞了出来！

original: [user] slams [attacked_human] in the face with the tray!
translation: [user] 用托盘猛击了 [attacked_human] 的脸！

translation: 手持使用以将托盘中的物品放置到面前。

translation: 这只是一个普通的木质板条箱。

original: A large case containing an experiemental suit of B18 armor for the discerning specialist.
translation: 一个装有实验性B18装甲的大型箱子，专为眼光独到的专家准备。

original: A large case containing a heavy-duty multi-shot grenade launcher, the Armat Systems M92. Drag this sprite into you to open it up!\nNOTE: You cannot put items back inside this case.
translation: 一个装有阿玛特系统M92重型多管榴弹发射器的大型箱子。将此图标拖入你的角色以打开它！\n注意：你无法将物品放回此箱子内。

original: A large case containing a heavy-caliber antitank missile launcher and missiles. Drag this sprite into you to open it up!\nNOTE: You cannot put items back inside this case.
translation: 一个装有重型反坦克导弹发射器和导弹的大箱子。将此图标拖入你的角色以打开它！\n注意：你无法将物品放回此箱子内。

original: A large case containing B17 Heavy Armor and a heavy-duty multi-shot grenade launcher, the Armat Systems M92. Drag this sprite into you to open it up!\nNOTE: You cannot put items back inside this case.
translation: 一个装有B17重型护甲和阿玛特系统M92重型多管手雷发射器的大箱子。将此图标拖入角色以打开！\n注意：无法将物品放回此箱内。

original: A large case containing B18 armor, munitions, and a goddamn minigun. Drag this sprite into you to open it up!\nNOTE: You cannot put items back inside this case.
translation: 一个装有B18护甲、弹药和一把该死加特林的大箱子。将此图标拖入你的角色来打开它！\n注意：你无法将物品放回此箱内。

original: You [open ? "close [src]. Another time, then." : "open [src]. Mmmmm... donuts."]
translation: 你 [open ? "close [src]. Another time, then." : "open [src]. Mmmmm... donuts."]

original: It's a small container with dice inside.
translation: 这是一个装有骰子的小容器。

original: A box of mouth watering \"Yum!\" brand donuts.
translation: 一盒令人垂涎欲滴的'Yum!'牌甜甜圈。

original: Contains pills. Once you take them out they don't go back in.
translation: 内含药片。一旦取出便无法放回。

original: This packet contains bicaridine pills. Used to treat minor lacerations. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含比卡瑞丁药片。用于治疗轻微割伤。一旦取出便无法放回。一次最多服用2片。

original: This packet contains kelotane pills. Used to treat surface burns. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含凯洛坦药片。用于治疗表面烧伤。一旦取出便无法放回。一次最多服用2片。

original: This packet contains tramadol pills. Used as a medium-strength painkiller. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含曲马多药片。用作中等强度的止痛药。一旦取出便无法放回。一次最多服用2片。

original: This packet contains tricordrazine pills. Heals all types of damage slightly. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含三氯唑啉药片。可轻微治愈所有类型的伤害。一旦取出便无法放回。每次最多服用2片。

original: This packet contains dylovene pills. Used to purge toxins and heal toxic damage. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含迪洛芬药片。用于清除毒素并治疗毒素伤害。一旦取出便无法放回。一次服用不得超过2片。

original: This packet contains paracetamol pills, also known as tylenol. A long lasting but minor painkiller. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 4 pills in a long period.
translation: 本包装内含扑热息痛药片，亦称泰诺。这是一种长效但效果轻微的止痛药。一旦取出便无法放回。长时间内服用不得超过4片。

original: A pill with an isotonic solution inside. Used to stimulate blood regeneration. Once you take them out they don't go back in.
translation: 内含等渗溶液的药片。用于刺激血液再生。一旦取出便无法放回。

original: This packet contains leporazine pills. Rapidly stablizes the patients internal temperature. Once you take them out they don't go back in..
translation: 本包装内含勒波拉嗪药片。能快速稳定患者的体内温度。一旦取出就无法放回。

original: This packet contains Russian Red pills. Used for field treatment of critical cases without a medic. Once you take them out they don't go back in..
translation: 这个包装内装有俄罗斯红药片。用于在没有卫生兵的情况下进行战场急救。一旦取出就无法放回。

original: This packet contains Ryetalyn pills. Used to provide a shield against bloodstream toxins. Once you take them out they don't go back in. No more than 2 pills at once.
translation: 本包装内含莱特林药片。用于提供对抗血液毒素的防护。一旦取出便无法放回。一次最多服用2片。

original: A general purpose pouch used to carry small items.
translation: 用于携带小物品的通用附包。

original: A general purpose pouch used to carry small items used during mining.
translation: 用于携带采矿期间使用的小型物品的通用附包。

original: A general purpose pouch used to carry small items used during mining.
translation: 用于携带采矿期间使用的小型物品的通用附包。

original: It can contain flashlights, a pill, a crowbar, metal sheets, and some bandages.
translation: 它可以容纳手电筒、药片、撬棍、金属板和部分绷带。

original: Standard marine first-aid pouch. It can contain most common medical supplies.
translation: 标准陆战队急救附包。可容纳大多数常见医疗用品。

original: A basic first aid pouch originally used by miners due to dangerous working conditions on the mining colonies. This one is marked as belonging to the SOM.
translation: 一个基础急救附包，最初因采矿殖民地危险的工作条件而被矿工使用。这个附包标记为火星之子所有。

original: It can contain a pistol or revolver. Useful for emergencies.
translation: 可容纳手枪或左轮手枪。适用于紧急情况。

original: It can contain a pistol or revolver. Useful for emergencies, and made out of stylish leather in the old SOM tradition.
translation: 可容纳手枪或左轮手枪。用于紧急情况，采用火星之子的传统风格皮革制成。

original: It can contain a pistol or revolver. Useful for emergencies, and made is out of a syntheic tan fabric.
translation: 可容纳手枪或左轮手枪。适用于紧急情况，由合成棕色织物制成。

original: This pouch can contain three ammo magazines.
translation: 这个附包可以容纳三个弹匣。

original: This pouch can contain three ammo magazines. Made with traditional SOM leather.
translation: 这个附包可容纳三个弹匣。采用传统的火星之子皮革制成。

original: This pouch can contain three ammo magazines, appears to be made with a synthetic tan fiber.
translation: 这个附包可以容纳三个弹药弹匣，似乎是用合成棕褐色纤维制成的。

original: It can contain pistol and revolver ammo magazines.
translation: 可容纳手枪和左轮手枪弹匣。

original: This pouch can contain six pistol and revolver ammo magazines.
translation: 这个附包可以容纳六个手枪和左轮弹药弹匣。

original: It can contain four drum magazines.
It can contain grenades, plastiques, mine boxes, and other explosives.
translation: 它可以容纳手雷、塑胶炸药、地雷箱和其他爆炸物。

original: A leather pouch for storing grenades, rockets, mine boxes, and other explosives.
translation: 一个用于存放手雷、火箭弹、地雷盒和其他爆炸物的皮革附包。

original: It can contain grenades, plastiques, mine boxes, and other explosives. Clearly made from with a synthetic tan fiber.
translation: 可容纳手雷、塑胶炸药、地雷箱及其他爆炸物。明显由合成棕褐色纤维制成。

original: It can contain grenades. This one looks to be made out of traditional SOM leather.
translation: 它可以容纳手雷。这个看起来是用传统的火星之子皮革制成的。

original: A standard use medkit pouch that can contain all kinds of medical supplies and equipment.
translation: 一个标准用途的医疗附包，可容纳各类医疗物资和设备。

original: Standard marine first-aid pouch. Contains basic pills, splints, and a stabilizing injector.
translation: 标准陆战队急救附包。包含基础药片、夹板和一支稳定剂注射器。

original: A standard use medkit pouch that can contain all kinds of medical supplies and equipment. Made with traditional SOM leather.
translation: 一个标准用途的医疗附包，可容纳各类医疗物资和设备。采用传统的火星之子皮革制成。

original: A specialized medical pouch that can only hold auto-injectors.
translation: 一个只能存放自动注射器的专用医疗附包。

original: Standard marine first-aid injector pouch. Specialized to store only auto-injectors. Contains basic injectors, a stabilizing injector, stimulant injector, and an emergency injector.
translation: 标准陆战队急救注射器附包。专用于存放自动注射器。包含基础注射器、稳定剂注射器、兴奋剂注射器和紧急注射器。

original: A specialized medical pouch that can only hold auto-injectors. This one looks to be made out of traditional SOM leather.
translation: 一个只能存放自动注射器的专用医疗附包。这个看起来是用传统的火星之子皮革制成的。

original: A specialized medical pouch that can only hold auto-injectors. This one looks to be made out of a synthetic tan fabric.
translation: 一个只能存放自动注射器的专用医疗附包。这个看起来是用合成米色织物制成的。

original: A small medical pouch with three seperate pockets to sort your medical lollipops.
translation: 一个带有三个独立口袋的小型医疗附包，用于分类存放你的医疗棒棒糖。

original: A pouch containing all of your berry needs.
translation: 一个满足你所有浆果需求的附包。

original: An eye catching white medical pouch capable of holding all your surgical tools.
translation: 一款引人注目的白色医疗附包，能够容纳你所有的外科手术工具。

original: It can contain papers and clipboards.
translation: 它可以存放文件和写字板。

original: It can contain a motion detector, signaller, beacons, map tablets, radios, papers and other handy battlefield communication, navigation, and detection devices.
translation: 可容纳运动探测器、信号器、信标、地图平板、无线电、文件及其他实用的战场通信、导航与探测设备。

original: It is designed to hold most electronics, power cells and circuitboards.
translation: 它设计用于容纳大多数电子设备、电源电池和电路板。

original: It's designed to hold construction materials - glass/metal sheets, metal rods, barbed wire, cable coil, and empty sandbags. It also has a hook for an entrenching tool.
translation: 它设计用于容纳建筑材料——玻璃/金属板、金属杆、铁丝网、电缆卷和空沙袋。还带有一个用于固定工兵铲的挂钩。

original: It's designed to hold construction materials - glass/metal sheets, metal rods, barbed wire, cable coil, and empty sandbags. It also has a hook for an entrenching tool. Made with traditional SOM leather.
translation: 它设计用于容纳建筑材料——玻璃板/金属板、金属杆、铁丝网、电缆卷和空沙袋。还带有一个用于固定工兵铲的挂钩。采用传统的火星之子皮革制成。

original: It's designed to hold construction materials - glass/metal sheets, metal rods, barbed wire, cable coil, and empty sandbags. It also has a hook for an entrenching tool. Made with synthetic tan.
translation: 它设计用于容纳建筑材料——玻璃/金属板、金属杆、铁丝网、电缆卷和空沙袋。还带有一个用于固定工兵铲的挂钩。采用合成鞣制皮革制成。

original: It's designed to hold maintenance tools - screwdriver, wrench, cable coil, etc. It also has a hook for an entrenching tool.

original: TerraGov Marine Corps' experimental High Point-Singularity 'Harvester' blade. An advanced weapon that trades sheer force for the ability to apply a variety of debilitating effects when loaded with certain reagents. Activate after loading to prime a single use of an effect. It also harvests substances from alien lifeforms it strikes when connected to the Vali system.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队实验型高能点-奇点'收割者'刃。一种先进武器，牺牲纯粹力量以换取装载特定试剂时施加多种削弱效果的能力。装载后激活以准备单次效果使用。当连接至瓦利系统时，它还能从击中的外星生命体中采集物质。

original: TerraGov Marine Corps' experimental High Point-Singularity 'Harvester' knife. An advanced version of the HP-S Harvester blade, shrunken down to the size of the standard issue boot knife. It trades the harvester blades size and power for a smaller form, with the side effect of a miniscule chemical storage, yet it still keeps its ability to apply debilitating effects to its targets. Activate after loading to prime a single use of an effect. It also harvests substances from alien lifeforms it strikes when connected to the Vali system.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队实验型高能点-奇点'收割者'匕首。HP-S收割者刀片的高级版本，缩小至标准配发靴刀尺寸。它以收割者刀片的尺寸和威力为代价换取更小的形态，附带副作用是化学储存容量极小，但仍保留对目标施加虚弱效果的能力。装载后激活以准备单次效果使用。当连接至瓦利系统时，它还能从击中的外星生命体中采集物质。

original: This appears to be a rather old blade that has been well taken care of, it is probably a family heirloom. Oddly despite its probable non-combat purpose it is sharpened and not blunt.
translation: 这似乎是一把相当古老的刀，保养得很好，很可能是一件家族传家宝。奇怪的是，尽管它可能并非用于战斗，但刀刃却被磨得很锋利，并不钝。

original: The pride of an imperial commissar, held high as they charge into battle.
translation: 帝国政委的骄傲，在他们冲锋陷阵时高高举起。

original: A finely made Japanese sword, with a well sharpened blade. The blade has been filed to a molecular edge, and is extremely deadly. Commonly found in the hands of mercenaries and yakuza.
translation: 一把做工精良的日本刀，刀身经过精细打磨。刀刃被研磨至分子级锋利度，极具致命性。常见于雇佣兵和极道成员手中。

original: A heavy hammer that's good at smashing rocks, but would probably make a good weapon considering the circumstances.

original: The AGM-224 is the latest in air to ground missile technology. translation: 此内容不应可见，如果在回合中看到此内容并附带位置信息，请使用管理帮助（AHELP）报告'ART-P01'。

original: A fuel enhancement system for dropships. It improves the thrust produced by the fuel combustion for faster travels. Fits inside the engine attach points. You need a powerloader to lift it.
translation: 一种用于运输船的燃料增强系统。它能提升燃料燃烧产生的推力，以实现更快速的航行。可安装在引擎连接点内。需要使用动力装载机来搬运。

original: A small computer hooked up into the ship's systems.
translation: 连接至舰船系统的小型计算机。

original: A small computer hooked up into the ship's computer network.
translation: 一台连接至舰船计算机网络的小型计算机。

original: Used to upload laws to the AI.
translation: 用于上传法律至人工智能。

original: The finest in spring-loaded piston toy technology, now on a space station near you.
translation: 采用最先进的弹簧活塞玩具技术，现已登陆您附近的太空站。

original: A mysterious gateway built by unknown hands, it allows for faster than light travel to far-flung locations.
translation: 一座由未知之手建造的神秘传送门，它能实现超光速旅行，通往遥远之地。

original: A device which produces a graviton field when set up.
translation: 一种在部署时能产生引力子场的装置。

original: A wonder of subsidized corporate design, this holographic barrier is almost entirely resistant to atmos loss and degradation by melee or ballistic damage. It's also made of space asbestos and is illegal under the new Geneva conventions.
translation: 这项受资助的企业设计奇迹，这种全息屏障几乎完全抵抗大气流失以及近战或弹道损伤造成的退化。它也是由太空石棉制成，根据新版日内瓦公约属于非法。

original: It's a gravestone, used to mark the burial site of important people. Press F to pay respects to the fallen.
translation: 这是一块墓碑，用于标记重要人物的埋葬地点。按F键向逝者致敬。

original: A standard silicon unit assigned to manage the research duties of NT stations. This one is completely deactivated.
translation: 一台标准的硅基单元，被指派负责纳米传讯空间站的研究任务。这台已完全停用。

original: A charging dock for energy based weaponry, PDAs, and other devices. A small blinking light indicates that this recharger isn't functional.
translation: 能量武器、PDA及其他设备的充电坞。闪烁的小灯表明此充电器无法使用。

original: Protolathe, used to be used to print tools and such.
translation: 原型制造机，过去曾用于打印工具等物品。

original: This can be used for various important functions.
translation: 这可用于各种重要功能。

original: Used to monitor active health sensors built into most of the crew's uniforms.
translation: 用于监控大多数船员制服内置的活性生命体征传感器。

original: THIS SHOULDN'T BE VISIBLE, AHELP 'ART-P02' IF SEEN IN ROUND WITH LOCATION
translation: 此内容不应可见，如果在回合中看到此内容并附带位置信息，请使用管理员帮助（AHELP）报告'ART-P02'。

original: It used to produce items using metal and glass.
translation: 它过去曾用金属和玻璃制造物品。

original: A crate full of 30mm bullets used on one of the weapon pod types for the dropship. Moving this will require some sort of lifter.
translation: 装满30毫米弹药的板条箱，用于登陆艇的某种武器吊舱。搬运它需要某种起重设备。

original: The Mission Planning System IV (MPS IV), a enhancement in mission planning and charting for dropship pilots across the TGMC. Fully capable of customizing their flight paths and loadouts to suit their combat needs.
translation: 任务规划系统IV（MPS IV），是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队所有运输机飞行员在任务规划与航图绘制方面的一项增强。该系统完全能够根据作战需求，定制飞行路线和载荷配置。

original: The Common Mapping Production System version II allows for sensory imput from satellites and ship systems to derive planetary maps in a standardized fashion for all TGMC pilots.
translation: 通用制图生产系统II型允许从卫星和舰船系统接收感官输入，以标准化的方式为所有地球政府殖民地海军陆战队飞行员生成行星地图。

original: The IBM series 10 computer retrofitted to work as a sensor computer for the ship. While somewhat dated it still serves its purpose.
translation: 这台IBM系列10计算机经过改装，用作舰船传感器计算机。虽然有些过时，但它仍能胜任其职责。

original: The IBM series 10 computer retrofitted to work as a sensor computer for the ship. While somewhat dated it still serves its purpose.
translation: 经过改装用作舰船传感器计算机的IBM系列10型计算机。虽然有些过时，但仍能胜任其职责。

original: The IBM series 10 computer retrofitted to work as a sensor computer for the ship. While somewhat dated it still serves its purpose.
translation: 经过改装用作舰船传感器计算机的IBM系列10型计算机。虽然有些过时，但它仍能胜任其职责。

original: Cold launch tubes that can fire a few varieties of missiles out of them The most common being the ASAAR-21 Rapier IV missile used against satellites and other spacecraft and the BGM-227 Sledgehammer missile which is used for ground attack.
translation: 冷发射管，可发射多种导弹。最常见的是用于攻击卫星和其他航天器的ASAAR-21'利剑IV'导弹，以及用于对地攻击的BGM-227'大锤'导弹。

original: A ship memorial dedicated to the triumphs of the TGMC and the fallen marines of this ship. On the left there are grand tales of victory etched into the slab. On the right there is a list of famous marines who have fallen in combat serving the TGMC.
translation: 一座纪念TGMC胜利和本舰阵亡陆战队员的舰船纪念碑。左侧石板上镌刻着辉煌的胜利史诗。右侧则列有为TGMC服役而战死的著名陆战队员名单。

original: The Mark 74 Railgun is top of the line for space based weaponry. Capable of firing a round with a diameter of 3/4ths of a meter at 24 kilometers per second. It also is capable of using a variety of round types which can be interchanged at anytime with its newly designed feed system.
translation: Mark 74 导轨炮是太空武器的顶尖产品。能够以每秒24公里的速度发射直径达四分之三米的炮弹。它还配备了全新设计的供弹系统，可以随时更换多种不同类型的弹种。

original: The name of the ship stenciled on the hull.
A large number stenciled on the hangar floor used to designate which dropship it is.
translation: 机库地板上喷涂的大型编号，用于标识所属的运输机。

original: A thermoelectric generator sitting atop a plasma-filled borehole. The powercell is missing and strange lines of text scroll by on its status panel, you get the feeling there's no fixing it.
translation: 一台热电发电机坐落在充满等离子体的钻孔上方。电池缺失，状态面板上滚动着奇怪的文字，你感觉这东西已经无法修复了。

original: A strangely translucent and iridescent crystal.
translation: 一块奇特的半透明虹彩水晶。

original: A device which uses radiation and plasma to produce power.
translation: 一种利用辐射和等离子体产生能量的装置。

original: A heavy set of blast resistant shutters.
translation: 一套厚重的防爆百叶窗。

original: A mighty piece of hardware used to broadcast processed subspace signals.
translation: 一种强大的硬件设备，用于广播处理过的子空间信号。

original: A mighty piece of hardware used to send/receive massive amounts of data.
translation: 一款用于发送/接收海量数据的强大硬件设备。

original: This machine is used to process large quantities of information.
translation: 这台机器用于处理大量信息。

original: A mighty piece of hardware used to send massive amounts of data quickly.
translation: 一款用于快速传输海量数据的强大硬件设备。

original: This machine has a dish-like shape and green lights. It is designed to detect and process subspace radio activity.
translation: 这台机器呈碟状，带有绿色指示灯。它用于探测和处理子空间无线电活动。

original: A dish-shaped machine used to broadcast processed subspace signals.
translation: 一种碟形机器，用于广播处理过的子空间信号。

original: A mighty piece of hardware used to send massive amounts of data far away.
translation: 一款强大的硬件设备，用于远距离传输海量数据。

original: An industrial U-Stor-It Storage unit designed to accomodate all kinds of space suits. Its on-board equipment also allows the user to decontaminate the contents through a UV-ray purging cycle. There's a warning label dangling from the control pad, reading \"STRICTLY NO BIOLOGICALS IN THE CONFINES OF THE UNIT\". This one appears to be magnetically locked.
translation: 一个工业级U-Stor-It存储单元，设计用于容纳各类太空服。其内置设备还允许用户通过紫外线净化循环对内部物品进行消毒。控制面板上悬挂着一个警告标签，写着'单元内部严禁存放生化物品'。这个单元似乎处于磁力锁定状态。

original: A giant machine for processing data and producing department specific tools. A small warning light labeled 'server connection' is flashing red
translation: 一台用于处理数据并生产部门专用工具的大型机器。一盏标有'服务器连接'的小型警告灯正在闪烁红光。

original: Manufactures circuit boards for the construction of machines.
translation: 制造用于建造机器的电路板。

original: A highly precise directional sensor array which measures the release of quants from decaying tachyons. The doppler shifting of the mirror-image formed by these quants can reveal the size, location and temporal affects of energetic disturbances within a large radius ahead of the array.\n
translation: 一种高精度的定向传感器阵列，用于测量衰变快子释放的量子。这些量子形成的镜像多普勒频移可以揭示阵列前方大范围内能量扰动的大小、位置和时间效应。

original: An advanced machine capable of implosion-compressing raw anomaly cores into finished artifacts. Also equipped with state of the art bomb prediction software.
translation: 一台能够通过内爆压缩原始异常核心制成成品神器的高级机器。同时配备了最先进的爆炸预测软件。

original: Heavy duty shielded air compressor designed to pressurize tanks above the safe limit.
translation: 重型屏蔽式空气压缩机，设计用于将储罐加压至安全限值以上。

original: A large thermal battery that projects a high amount of energy when powered.
translation: 一个大型热能电池，通电时可释放大量能量。

original: Used to seal minor hull breaches.
translation: 用于密封小型船体裂缝。

original: Keeps an area from being fried by Edison's Bane, does not work against handheld Tesla cannons commonly issued by paramilitaries.
translation: 防止区域被爱迪生之灾烧毁，对民间武装常用的手持特斯拉炮无效。

original: A connector for the large cannon cables.
translation: 大型火炮电缆的连接器。

original: An angled mirror for reflecting laser beams.
translation: 用于反射激光束的棱镜。

original: A NT security officer guarding the perimeter. They look rather busy and pays no attention to you.
translation: 一名纳米传讯安保人员正在警戒周边。他们看起来相当忙碌，没注意到你。

original: A staff officer in charge of the ongoing operation, either too busy operating the observation consoles or simply looking at you and your comrades and hoping that you will succeed, that being said, it's best to leave them be.
translation: 负责当前行动的参谋军官，要么正忙于操作监控台，要么只是看着你和你的战友们，希望你们能够成功。话虽如此，最好还是别打扰他们。

original: A hard working technician maintaining the vehicles of the base, as well as the base itself. They seem to be very busy investigating something right now.
translation: 一位辛勤工作的技术员，负责维护基地的车辆以及基地本身。他们现在似乎正忙于调查某件事。

original: A hard working SOM technician maintaining the vehicles of the base, as well as the base itself. They seem to be very busy investigating something right now.
translation: 一名辛勤工作的火星之子技术员，负责维护基地的载具以及基地本身。他们此刻似乎正忙于调查某件事。

original: Standard Sons of Mars infantry with a V-31 assault rifle on hand. While their face is obscured by the visor, it feels like you should keep going instead of loitering around.
translation: 手持V-31突击步枪的标准火星之子步兵。虽然他们的面容被面罩遮蔽，但感觉你应该继续前进，而不是在此逗留。

original: Heavy Sons of Mars infantry with a VX-32 charger on hand. While their face is obscured by the visor, it feels like you should keep going instead of loitering around.
translation: 手持VX-32充能枪的重型火星之子步兵。虽然他们的面容被面罩遮蔽，但感觉你应该继续前进，而不是在此逗留。

original: Heavy Sons of Mars infantry. Better leave them to whatever it is they're doing
translation: 重型火星之子步兵。最好别管他们在做什么。

original: Sons of Mars infantry in heavy duty Lorica armor, with a VX-32 charger on hand. They don't look like they're messing around.
translation: 身着重型洛里卡装甲的火星之子步兵，手持VX-32充能枪。他们看起来可不是在闹着玩的。

original: Sons of Mars infantry in heavy duty Lorica armor. They look pretty tough.
translation: 身着重型洛里卡装甲的火星之子步兵。他们看起来相当强悍。

original: A hard working SOM scientist type. They look like they're doing something important.
translation: 一名勤奋的火星之子科学家类型。看起来正在处理重要事务。

original: A Terra Defense Force soldier. They don't seem to be doing very well.
translation: 一名地球防卫军士兵。他们看起来状态不佳。

original: A Terra Defense Force soldier. This one seems to have lost their mind.
translation: 一名地球防卫军士兵。这位看起来已经神志不清了。

original: Where's your head at? (Where's yo head at?) (Where's yo head at?)
translation: 你的脑袋在哪？（你的脑袋在哪？）（你的脑袋在哪？）

original: This would be a hole, except it's got a big piece of metal covering it.
translation: 这本来会是个洞，但上面盖了一大块金属板。

original: A container used to store high quantities of fuel.
translation: 用于储存大量燃料的容器。

original: A container that used to store high quantities of fuel.
translation: 用于储存大量燃料的容器。

original: A flag bearing the symbol of Terragov. It doesn't seem as inspirational as other flags might be.
translation: 一面印有地球政府标志的旗帜。它看起来不像其他旗帜那样鼓舞人心。

original: A flag bearing the symbol of the Sons of Mars. It doesn't seem as inspirational as other flags might be.
translation: 一面印有火星之子标志的旗帜。它看起来不像其他旗帜那样鼓舞人心。

original: An all-in-one bluespace storage and transmission system for the colony's mineral distribution needs. This one appears to be deactivated.
translation: 一个集蓝空间存储与传输于一体的系统，用于满足殖民地的矿物分发需求。这个装置似乎已停用。

original: A ferocious, fang-bearing creature that resembles a fish.
translation: 一种凶猛、长着尖牙、形似鱼类的生物。

original: A remotely-activatable dispenser for crowd-controlling foam.
translation: 一种可远程激活的用于人群控制的泡沫喷洒器。

original: A point-defense laser turret supplied by NanoTrasen. This one looks inactive
translation: 由纳米传讯提供的点防御激光炮塔。这个看起来处于非活动状态。

original: A pneumatic tube commonly used for transportation on NanoTrasen research stations.
translation: 纳米传讯研究站上常用的气动运输管道。

original: That's a gas flow meter. It measures something.
translation: 那是个气体流量计。它能测量一些东西。

original: A one meter section of regular pipe.
translation: 一段一米长的标准管道。

original: A manifold composed of regular pipes.
translation: 由标准管道组成的歧管。

original: A pump that moves gas by pressure.
translation: 一种通过压力输送气体的泵。

original: A half-assembled mech. It's missing limbs and the maintenance ports are open. You probably shouldn't screw with it.
translation: 一台半组装状态的机甲。它缺少肢体部件，维护舱口也敞开着。你最好别乱动它。

original: An advanced vanguard chassis mech. It's a recent advancement in military hardware only been in service for a short time and not in mass production yet.
translation: 一款先进的先锋底盘机甲。这是军事装备领域的最新进展，仅服役了很短时间，尚未投入大规模生产。

original: A large vat used to store humans.
translation: 用于储存人类的大型容器。

original: A large vat used to store humans. This one doesnt seem functional...
translation: 一个用于储存人类的大型容器。这个看起来已经无法使用了……

original: THIS SHOULDN'T BE VISIBLE, AHELP 'ART-P03' IF SEEN IN ROUND WITH LOCATION
translation: 此处不应可见，如果在游戏回合中看到此信息并附带位置信息，请使用管理员求助（AHELP）并注明代码'ART-P03'。

original: It looks like it probably just plopped out. It's too decayed to be reinserted in a patient.
translation: 看起来它可能只是掉出来了。它已经腐烂得太厉害，无法重新植入病人体内。

original: An AI Module for programming laws to an AI.
translation: 用于为AI编程法则的AI模块。

original: A storage device for AIs. Patent pending.
translation: 人工智能存储设备。专利待批。

original: The remains of a marine long dead, you hope they found peace.
translation: 一名陆战队员的遗骸，早已逝去，愿他们安息。

original: Whoever PFC Jim is, you hope made it out alive.
translation: 不管列兵吉姆是谁，你都希望他能活着出来。

original: The insides of this vendor are visible and rusted through, you get the feeling there's no fixing this machine.
translation: 这台自动售货机的内部结构暴露在外且锈迹斑斑，你感觉这台机器已经没救了。

original: You study the rusted hulk in vain trying to determine what this vendor was before realizing that it's hopeless.
translation: 你徒劳地研究着这具锈蚀的残骸，试图弄清这台自动售货机原本的模样，最终意识到这不过是白费力气。

original: An old van, seems to be broken down.
translation: 一辆旧货车，看起来抛锚了。

original: An old truck, seems to be broken down.
translation: 一辆旧卡车，看起来抛锚了。

original: An old crane, seems to be broken down.
translation: 一台旧起重机，看起来已经损坏了。

original: An old crawler, seems to be broken down.
translation: 一台老旧的爬行者，看起来已经损坏了。

original: A military truck, made for transporting equipment or personnel in bulk.
translation: 军用卡车，用于大批量运输装备或人员。

original: A light armored all terrain vehicle. Beats walking.
translation: 一辆轻型全地形装甲车。比步行强多了。

original: An all terrain vehicle with some armor plating and an attached machinegun. Unfortunately, the machinegun has no ammo, and you don't have your drivers license.
translation: 一辆全地形车，带有一些装甲板和一门固定机枪。可惜的是，机枪没有弹药，而且你也没有驾照。

original: An unarmed APC designed to command and transport troops in the battlefield. For some reason, it bears the same name as its predecessor. Its doors are locked, and you probably don't know how to drive this thing anyways.
translation: 一种设计用于在战场上指挥和运输部队的无武装装甲运兵车。不知为何，它沿用了其前代的名字。它的车门是锁着的，而且你大概也不知道怎么开这东西。

original: A decomissioned tank, all methods of propulsion have been disabled and the entrances sealed.
translation: 一辆已退役的坦克，所有推进方式均已禁用，入口也已密封。

original: The base of a decomissioned tank.
The base of a decomissioned tank.
The turret of a decomissioned tank.
The turret of a decomissioned tank.
The turret of a decomissioned tank.
The turret of a decomissioned tank.
A decomissioned APC, all methods of propulsion have been disabled and the entrances sealed.
translation: 一辆已退役的装甲运兵车，所有推进方式均已停用，出入口也已封闭。

original: Somebody fucked up, ping the map creator on Discord with the location of this object.
translation: 有人搞砸了，去Discord上@地图作者并告知这个物体的位置。

original: A small patch of wiring used for cordoning off areas.
translation: 一小块用于隔离区域的布线。

original: A post with an empty bulb at the top, used for lighting areas of dense snow.
translation: 顶部带有空灯泡的灯柱，用于在积雪密集区域提供照明。

original: A metallic box used for holding growing plants, this one is empty.
translation: 一个用于存放生长植物的金属盒子，这个是空的。

original: A metallic box used for holding growing plants, this one is filled with soil.
translation: 一个用于种植植物的金属盒子，里面装满了土壤。

original: A floor you can walk on. This one comes with gaps to see the space underneath.
translation: 可供行走的地板。这种带有缝隙，可以看到下方的太空。

original: A metallic box used for holding growing plants, this one is empty.
translation: 一个用于存放生长植物的金属盒子，这个是空的。

original: A floor you can walk on. This one comes with gaps to see the space underneath.
translation: 可供行走的地板。这种带有缝隙，可以看到下方的太空。

original: This machine sits quietly, you can see a warning light faintly shining on its diagnostic panel.
translation: 这台机器静静地待着，你能看到诊断面板上有一盏警示灯在微弱地闪烁。

original: This machine sits quietly, you can see a warning light faintly shining on its diagnostic panel.
translation: 这台机器静静地待着，你能看到诊断面板上有一盏警示灯在微弱地闪烁。

original: A deployable barrier used by security forces to cordone off an area.
translation: 安全部队用于封锁区域的部署式屏障。

original: A heavy cable node used for linking high performance cables between buildings.
translation: 用于连接建筑物间高性能电缆的重型电缆节点。

original: A heavy cable node used for connecting high performance cables between buildings.
translation: 用于在建筑物之间连接高性能电缆的重型电缆节点。

translation: 森林绿眼镜，就像策划阴谋诡计时会戴的那种。

translation: 标准配发的TGMC护目镜。主要用于装饰头盔。内含处方镜片，以防你不确定它们是否很逊。

translation: 采用更昂贵材料制成的焊接护目镜，奇怪的是闻起来有股土豆味。

original: Strangely ancient technology used to help provide rudimentary eye cover. Enhanced shielding blocks many flashes.
translation: 采用古老技术制造的护目镜，能提供基础的眼部防护。增强型护光镜片可阻挡多种强光。

original: Strangely ancient technology used to help provide rudimentary eye cover. Larger than average enhanced shielding blocks many flashes.
translation: 采用古老技术制造的护目镜，能提供基础的眼部防护。其增大的护盾能有效阻挡多数闪光。

translation: 一副设计师太阳镜。看起来似乎无法阻挡闪光。

original: A standard eyepiece, but modified to display security information to the user visually. This makes it commonplace among military police, though other models exist.
translation: 一款标准目镜，但经过改装，可向用户视觉显示安全信息。这使其在宪兵中颇为常见，尽管也存在其他型号。

original: Gloves worn by commissars of the Imperial Army so that they do not soil their hands with the blood of their men.
translation: 帝国军政委佩戴的手套，以免他们双手沾染部下的鲜血。

original: You give up and collapse! K.O!
translation: 你放弃了，倒下了！被击倒了！

original: Regal blue gloves, with a nice gold trim. Swanky.
translation: 尊贵的蓝色手套，配有漂亮的金色镶边。真时髦。

original: These tactical gloves are somewhat fire and impact-resistant.
translation: 这些战术手套具有一定的防火和抗冲击能力。

original: These tactical gloves are somewhat fire and impact resistant.
translation: 这些战术手套具有一定的火焰和冲击抗性。

original: A pair of gloves used by workers in dangerous environments.
translation: 用于危险环境作业的一副手套。

original: These leather gloves protect against thorns, barbs, prickles, spikes and other harmful objects of floral origin.
translation: 这些皮手套能防护荆棘、倒刺、尖刺以及其他植物来源的有害物体。

original: Because you really needed another excuse to punch your crewmates.
translation: 因为你真的需要另一个借口来揍你的队友。

original: Because you really needed another excuse to punch your crewmates.
translation: 因为你真的需要另一个借口来揍你的队友。

original: A Nanotrasen punching bag. A common sight this far from Sol.\nCheap and flimsy, might break if hit by something too heavy.
translation: 一个纳米传讯的沙袋。在离太阳系这么远的地方很常见。\n廉价且不结实，如果被太重的东西击中可能会坏掉。

original: an ultra rare hat. It commands a certain respect.
translation: 一顶极其罕见的帽子。它自带一种威严感。

original: It just latches right in place!
A rare Chef's Hat meant for hat collectors!
translation: 一顶稀有的厨师帽，专为帽子收藏家准备！

original: What looks like an ordinary paper hat, is actually a rare and valuable collector's edition paper hat. Keep away from water, fire and Librarians.
translation: 这顶看似普通的纸帽，其实是稀有珍贵的收藏版纸帽。请远离水、火焰和图书管理员。

original: A top hat worn by only the most prestigious hat collectors.
translation: 只有最负盛名的帽子收藏家才会佩戴的高顶礼帽。

original: A Collectable Hat that'll make you look just like a real comdom!
translation: 一顶收藏帽，让你看起来就像个真正的安全套！

original: A Collectable Police Officer's Hat. This hat emphasizes that you are THE LAW.
translation: 一顶可收藏的警官帽。这顶帽子强调你就是法律。

original: A Collectable red Beret. It smells faintly of Garlic.
translation: 一顶可收藏的红色贝雷帽。它散发着淡淡的大蒜味。

original: A Collectable Welding Helmet. Now with 80% less lead! Not for actual welding. Any welding done while wearing this Helmet is done so at the owner's own risk!
translation: 一款收藏用焊接头盔。含铅量降低80%！不可用于实际焊接。佩戴此头盔进行任何焊接操作均需自行承担风险！

original: Just like a real Brain Slug!

translation: 一顶可收藏的农夫平顶帽！

original: You'd make a great Dread Syndie Roberts!
translation: 你简直是个天生的恐怖辛迪加罗伯茨！

original: Not as lucky as the feet!
NOTE:Any magical powers gained from wearing this hat are purely coincidental.
translation: 注意：佩戴此帽子获得的任何魔法力量纯属巧合。

original: WARNING! Offers no real protection, or luminosity, but it is damn fancy!
translation: 警告！不提供实际防护或照明，但确实非常华丽！

original: Now you can beat prisoners, set silly sentences and arrest for no reason too!
translation: 现在你也可以殴打囚犯、判处荒唐刑期甚至无故逮捕了！

original: Go Red! I mean Green! I mean Red! No Green!
translation: 红队！我是说绿队！我是说红队！不，绿队！

original: Now you can be in the Deathsquad too!
translation: 现在你也能加入死亡小队了！

original: You cannot turn the light on while in [user.loc]
We disable the metal thing's lights.
translation: 我们关掉那个金属玩意儿上的灯。

original: A piece of headgear used in dangerous working conditions to protect the head. Comes with a built-in flashlight.
translation: 一种在危险工作条件下用于保护头部的头戴装备。配有内置手电筒。

original: A piece of headgear used in dangerous working conditions to protect the head. Comes with a built-in flashlight. Looks rather robust.
translation: 一种在危险工作条件下用于保护头部的头戴装备。配有内置手电筒。看起来相当坚固。

original: You spin the hat backwards! You look like a tool.
translation: 你把帽子反戴了！看起来像个傻瓜。

original: You spin the hat back forwards. That's better.
translation: 你把帽子转回正面。这样好多了。

original: You raise the ear flaps on the ushanka.
translation: 你将乌沙帽的护耳翻了上去。

original: You lower the ear flaps on the ushanka.
translation: 你将乌沙帽的耳罩放了下来。

original: A standard military beanie, often worn by non-combat military personnel and support crews, though the occasional one finds its way to the front line. Popular due to being comfortable and snug.
translation: 一顶标准的军用无檐帽，通常由非战斗军事人员和支持人员佩戴，不过偶尔也会出现在前线。因其舒适贴身而广受欢迎。

original: A hat typically worn by the field-officers of the TGMC. Occasionally they find their way down the ranks into the hands of squad-leaders and decorated grunts.
translation: 通常由地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的战地军官佩戴的帽子。偶尔它们也会流传到下级，落入班长和受勋的普通士兵手中。

original: An ERP-approved improved design of the red beret, how this small piece of cloth has such good padding is a closely guarded ERP-secret.
translation: ERP认证的改进型红色贝雷帽设计，这块小布料如何拥有如此出色的衬垫是ERP严格保守的秘密。

original: An ERP-approved improved design of the red beret, how this small piece of cloth has such good padding is a closely guarded ERP-secret. This one is held by Master Pranksters only!
translation: ERP认证的红色贝雷帽改进设计，这块小布料为何有如此出色的衬垫，是ERP严格保守的秘密。只有恶作剧大师才能持有它！

original: A beret with the lieutenant insignia emblazoned on it. It shines with the glow of corrupt authority and a smudge of doughnut.
translation: 一顶饰有中尉徽章的贝雷帽。它闪烁着腐败权力的光芒，还沾着一抹甜甜圈的污渍。

original: A beret with the field commander insignia emblazoned on it. It commands loyalty and bravery in all who gaze upon it.
translation: 一顶印有战地指挥官徽章的贝雷帽。所有注视它的人都会感受到忠诚与勇气的感召。

original: A casual cap occasionally worn by Squad-leaders and Combat-Engineers. While it has limited combat functionality, some prefer to wear it instead of the standard issue helmet.
translation: 班长和工程兵偶尔佩戴的休闲帽。虽然其战斗功能有限，但有些人更喜欢佩戴它，而不是标准配发的头盔。

original: A hat usually worn by officers in the TGMC. While it has limited combat functionality, some prefer to wear it instead of the standard issue helmet.
translation: 通常由地球政府殖民地海军陆战队军官佩戴的帽子。虽然其战斗功能有限，但有些人更愿意佩戴它，而不是标准配发的头盔。

original: A hat usually worn by officers in the TGMC. This time in a nice shade of navy blue.
translation: 通常由地球政府殖民地海军陆战队军官佩戴的帽子。这次是漂亮的海军蓝色调。

original: It's a fancy hat for a not-so-fancy military supply clerk.
translation: 这是一顶花哨的帽子，配给一位不那么花哨的军事补给文员。
战术酷炫科技的巅峰之作。

original: An ornamented cap with a visor. This one seems to be torn at the back.
translation: 一顶带有护目镜的装饰帽。这顶帽子后部似乎被撕裂了。

original: A nice slouch hat worn by some TGMC troopers while on planets with hot weather, or just for style. While it has limited combat functionality, some prefer to wear it instead of the standard issue helmet.
translation: 一顶漂亮的软檐帽，一些地球政府殖民地海军陆战队员在炎热天气的行星上或仅仅为了风格而佩戴。虽然其战斗功能有限，但有些人更喜欢佩戴它，而不是标准配发的头盔。

original: A rag typically worn by the less-orthodox weapons operators in the TGMC. While it offers no protection, it is certainly comfortable to wear compared to the standard helmet. Comes in two stylish colors.
translation: TGMC中非正统武器操作员常佩戴的头巾。虽然不提供任何防护，但佩戴起来确实比标准头盔舒适。提供两种时尚颜色。

original: It flutters in the face of the wind, defiant and unrestrained, like the man who wears it.
translation: 它在风中飘扬，桀骜不驯，如同佩戴它的那个人。

original: A replica of the headband of a legendary soldier. Sadly it doesn't offer infinite ammo. Yet.
translation: 传奇士兵头带的复制品。可惜它还不能提供无限弹药。暂时还不能。

original: A headset typically found in use by radio-operators and officers. This one appears to be malfunctioning.
translation: 通常由无线电操作员和军官使用的耳机。这个看起来出了故障。

original: A somewhat fancy hat, typically worn by those who wish to command medical respect.
translation: 一顶颇为精致的帽子，通常由那些希望获得医疗权威感的人佩戴。

original: A hat often worn by security officers, it is comfortable and lightly armored.
translation: 安保人员常戴的帽子，舒适且带有轻量护甲。

original: A beret with the TGMC insignia emblazoned on it. It radiates respect and authority.
translation: 一顶印有地球政府殖民地海军陆战队徽章的贝雷帽。它散发着敬意与权威。

original: A beret with the captain insignia emblazoned on it. Wearer may suffer the heavy weight of responsibility upon his head and shoulders.
translation: 一顶饰有舰长徽章的贝雷帽。佩戴者可能会感受到责任的重担压在头上和肩上。

original: A beret with the lieutenant-commander insignia emblazoned on it. It emits a dark aura and may corrupt the soul.
translation: 一顶饰有中校徽章的贝雷帽。它散发着黑暗气息，可能会腐蚀灵魂。

original: A beret with the Spatial Agent insignia on it.
translation: 一顶带有空间特工徽章的贝雷帽。

original: A beret with the lieutenant insignia emblazoned on it. There's something inexplicably efficient about it...
translation: 一顶饰有中尉徽章的贝雷帽。它散发着某种难以言喻的高效感……

original: A beret with the lieutenant insignia emblazoned on it. It inspires a feeling of respect.
translation: 一顶饰有中尉徽章的贝雷帽。它令人肃然起敬。

original: Perfect for winter in Siberia, da?
translation: 西伯利亚的冬天正合适，对吧？

original: Standard USL head gear for covert operations and low-ranking pirates alike.
translation: 联合太空鳞翅目用于隐蔽行动的标准头部装备，低级海盗也常佩戴。

original: A large hood in service with some militias, meant for obscurity on the frontier. Offers some head protection due to the study fibers utilized in production.
translation: 一些民兵部队使用的大型兜帽，旨在边境地区提供隐蔽性。由于生产中使用的高强度纤维，提供了一定的头部防护。

original: A sturdy admiral's cap. More protective than it seems. Please don't ditch this for a helmet like a punk.
translation: 一顶结实的海军上将帽。比看起来更坚固。请别像个混混一样把它换成头盔。

original: A cap worn by commissars of the Imperial Army. This one seems to radiate authority.
translation: 帝国陆军政委佩戴的军帽。这顶帽子似乎散发着权威的气息。

original: A hat lined with durathread on the outside, has the usual iconic look of a straw hat. A common hat across the bubble.
translation: 一顶外衬杜拉线材的帽子，保留了草帽标志性的经典外观。在星际泡沫区中随处可见。

original: CrashCore sponsored caps with kevlar fabric, comes with a headset.
translation: CrashCore 赞助的带凯夫拉纤维的帽子，配有耳机。

original: CrashCore sponsored beret with kevlar fabric, seen on Vyacheslav Squad Leaders and Officers.
translation: 采用凯夫拉面料制成的CrashCore赞助贝雷帽，常见于维亚切斯拉夫班长和军官。

original: CrashCore sponsored beret with kevlar fabric, seen on Vyacheslav Squad Leaders and Officers.
translation: 采用凯夫拉面料制成的CrashCore赞助贝雷帽，常见于维亚切斯拉夫班长和军官。

original: Standard Security gear. Protects the head from impacts.
translation: 标准安保装备。保护头部免受冲击。

original: It's a helmet specifically designed to protect against close range attacks. It covers your ears.
translation: 这是一款专为防护近距离攻击而设计的头盔。它能覆盖你的耳朵。

original: The hat of the Head of Security. For showing the officers who's in charge.
translation: 安保部长的帽子。用于向警员们展示谁才是负责人。

original: You're not quite sure how you manage to take it on and off, but it implants nicely in your head.
translation: 你不太确定自己是怎么把它戴上又摘下的，但它完美地植入到了你的脑袋里。

original: It's a special helmet issued to the Warden of a securiy force. Protects the head from impacts.
translation: 这是安保部队典狱长配发的专用头盔。可保护头部免受冲击伤害。

original: A stylish hat that both protects you from enraged former-crewmembers and gives you a false sense of authority.
translation: 一顶时髦的帽子，既能保护你免受愤怒的前船员的伤害，又能给你一种虚假的权威感。

original: No one in a commanding position should be without a perfect, white hat of ultimate authority.
translation: 任何指挥岗位的人员都应当配备一顶象征绝对权威的完美白色军帽。

original: They're often used by highly trained Swat Members.
translation: 它们通常由训练有素的特警队员使用。
万岁，皇帝，赴死者向您致敬。

original: A standard M10 Pattern Helmet. It reads on the label, 'The difference between an open-casket and closed-casket funeral. Wear on head for best results.'.
translation: 一顶标准的M10型头盔。标签上写着：'开棺葬礼与闭棺葬礼的区别。戴在头上效果最佳。'

original: The B18 Helmet that goes along with the B18 Defensive Armor. It's heavy, reinforced, and protects more of the face.
translation: 与B18防御护甲配套的B18头盔。它沉重、加固，能提供更全面的面部防护。

original: The helmet that pairs with the Ace hardsuit, heavily armored and reinforced.
translation: 与王牌硬质作战服配套的头盔，经过重装甲和加固处理。

original: A heavy duty helmet created to complement the B17 marine armor. Practically explosive proof. Unless you stand next to a nuke or something like that.
translation: 专为配合B17陆战队护甲设计的重型头盔。几乎能防爆。除非你站在核弹旁边之类的地方。

original: The M30 tactical helmet has a visor displaying the pilot tactical data. It is used by pilots in the TGN.
translation: M30战术头盔配有显示飞行员战术数据的护目镜。TGN的飞行员使用它。

original: A lightweight helmet with a small port in the back. Offers lower response times for TGMC mech pilots by integrating them directly into their mech suit's systems, though it certainly doesn't make them smarter.
translation: 一款轻量化头盔，背面带有一个小型接口。通过将机甲驾驶员直接接入其机甲服系统，降低了地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的机甲驾驶员的反应时间，不过这当然不会让他们变得更聪明。

original: A lightweight helmet. Offers the user protection from being hit in the hell by ejected shell casings, mostly.
translation: 一顶轻型头盔。主要为佩戴者提供防护，避免被抛出的弹壳击中头部。

original: A lightweight helmet with a small port in the back. Offers decent protection against reckless driving.
translation: 一顶轻便的头盔，背面有一个小孔。能为鲁莽驾驶提供不错的防护。

original: It's a modified version of the widely used Riot Helmets for use against angry jarheads. Boasts high ballistic protection
translation: 这是广泛使用的防暴头盔的改进型，用于对抗愤怒的陆战队员。具备高弹道防护能力。

original: An open version of standard enclosed helmets. It lacks filtration and HUD systems, but the ease of use and price make it a good choice for low ranking mercenaries and security.
translation: 标准封闭式头盔的开放版本。它缺乏过滤系统和抬头显示器，但易用性和价格使其成为低级佣兵和安保人员的不错选择。

original: Standard issue enclosed helmet, produced by Nanotrasen Armory Division for their mercenaries and security assets.
translation: 标准配发封闭式头盔，由纳米传讯军械部门为其雇佣兵和安全人员生产。

original: Standard issue enclosed helmet, produced by Nanotrasen Armory Division for their mercenaries and security assets. You like stripes, don't you?
translation: 标准配发封闭式头盔，由纳米传讯军械部门为其雇佣兵和安全人员生产。你喜欢条纹，对吧？

original: Standard issue enclosed helmet, produced by Nanotrasen Armory Division for their mercenaries and security assets. You could say we're of two minds on the subject.
translation: 标准配发封闭式头盔，由纳米传讯军械部门为其雇佣兵和安全资产生产。可以说，我们对这个问题的看法是双重的。

original: Standard issue enclosed helmet, produced by Nanotrasen Armory Division for their mercenaries and security assets. You feel quite hungry.
translation: 标准配发封闭式头盔，由纳米传讯军械部门为其雇佣兵和安全人员生产。你感到相当饥饿。

original: The pinacle of fashion, combined with protective faceplate, for any aspiring mercenary leader.
translation: 时尚的巅峰之作，搭配防护面罩，专为有抱负的佣兵领袖打造。

original: A custom model of M4 helmet for snipers with additional enviromental protection.
translation: 狙击手专用M4头盔定制型号，提供额外的环境防护。

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat.
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库。重型封闭式头盔配备硬化摄像头，是偏爱近身作战的佣兵的明智之选。

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat. It's rattling time.
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库。配备加固摄像头的重型封闭式头盔，是偏爱近身作战的佣兵明智之选。是时候大干一场了。

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat. I've got you in my sights.
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库。重型封闭式头盔配备强化摄像头，是偏爱近距离作战的佣兵的明智之选。你已进入我的视线。

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat. You love seeing people smile.
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库装备。带有加固摄像头的重型封闭式头盔，是偏爱近距离作战的佣兵的明智之选。你喜欢看到人们微笑。

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat. You like stripes, don't you?
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库。重型封闭式头盔配备加固摄像头，是偏爱近身作战的佣兵的明智之选。你喜欢条纹，对吧？

original: A newest generation of Nanotrasen Armory. The heavy enclosed helmet with hardened cameras, a wise choice for mercenary who prefers close quarters combat. This particular helmet looks like it belongs to a high-ranking officer.
translation: 纳米传讯最新一代的军械库装备。带有加固摄像头的重型封闭式头盔，是偏爱近身作战的佣兵的明智之选。这顶特殊的头盔看起来像是属于高级军官的。

original: A fully enclosed, armored helmet made for Nanotrasen elite commandos.
translation: 专为纳米传讯精英突击队员设计的全封闭式装甲头盔。

translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。提供相当数量的全方位附加装甲板，旨在为用户提供针对各类威胁的额外防护。此旧版本防护性能较差。将极大影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. A substantial amount of all-around armour plating designed to grant the user extra protection against any kind of threat.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。采用全方位重型装甲板，旨在为用户提供针对各类威胁的额外防护。

original: Designed for mounting on modular SOM armor. A substantial amount of additional armor plating designed to grant the user extra protection against all forms of damage. Will definitely impact mobility.
translation: 专为安装在模块化火星之子装甲上设计。大量附加装甲板，旨在为用户提供针对所有伤害形式的额外防护。肯定会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. Contains large amounts of ballistic armor plating, as well as energetically reflective and thermally dissipative material that grant it a high level of defense against bullets and lasers alike. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。包含大量弹道装甲板，以及能量反射和热消散材料，使其对弹道和激光攻击均具有高等级防护。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. Contains large amounts of ballistic armor plating, as well as energetically reflective and thermally dissipative material that grant it a high level of defense against bullets and lasers alike. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。包含大量弹道装甲板，以及能量反射和热消散材料，使其对弹道和激光攻击都具有高水平的防御能力。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. This newer model provides great resistance to acid, as well as biological and radiological threats. Pairing this with a Mimir helmet module and a gas mask will make the user impervious to gas attacks. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。这款新型号提供出色的酸液、生化及辐射威胁防护。与米米尔头盔模块和防毒面具搭配使用，可使穿戴者完全免疫毒气攻击。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. This newer model provides great resistance to acid, as well as biological and radiological threats. Pairing this with a Mimir suit module and a gas mask will make the user impervious to gas attacks.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。这款新型号对酸液、生化及辐射威胁具有极佳的抗性。与米米尔防护服模块和防毒面具搭配使用，可使穿戴者免受毒气攻击。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. This older model provides minor resistance to acid, as well as biological, and radiological threats. Pairing this with a Mimir helmet module and mask will make the user highly resistant to gas attacks, but will not provide immunity. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为模块化装甲安装设计。这款旧型号对酸液、生化及辐射威胁提供轻微防护。与米米尔头盔模块和面罩搭配使用，可使穿戴者对气体攻击具有高度抗性，但无法提供完全免疫。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. This older model provides minor resistance to acid, as well as biological, and radiological threats. Pairing this with a Mimir helmet module and mask will make the user highly resistant to gas attacks, but will not provide immunity. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。这款旧型号对酸液、生化及辐射威胁提供轻微防护。与米米尔头盔模块和面罩搭配使用，可使穿戴者对气体攻击具有高度抗性，但无法提供完全免疫。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on modular SOM armor. This module appears to be designed to protect the user from the effects of radiological attacks, although it also provides improved resistance against other environmental threats such as acids and gasses. Pairing this with a Mithridatius helmet module and mask will make the user impervious to gas clouds. Will impact mobility.
translation: 专为安装在模块化火星之子装甲上而设计。该模块似乎旨在保护使用者免受辐射攻击的影响，同时也提供对酸液和毒气等其他环境威胁的增强抵抗力。将其与米特里达梯头盔模块和面罩搭配使用，可使使用者对毒气云免疫。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. Uses a complex set of armor plating and compensation to lessen the effect of explosions. Will impact mobility
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。采用复杂的装甲板和补偿系统来减轻爆炸效果。会影响机动性。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. This experimental module runs on green blood taken from xenos with harvester class weapons; Green blood heals the user and boosts any chems in the suit injection system. \nUse the suit menu to connect harvester class weapons, control the injection system, find chem boost information, and more.
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。这个实验性模块使用由收割者级武器从异形身上提取的绿色血液供能；绿色血液能治疗使用者并增强防护服注射系统中的任何化学物质。\n使用防护服菜单连接收割者级武器、控制注射系统、查看化学增强信息等。

original: A brand new innovation in armor systems, this module creates a shield around the user that is capable of negating all damage at the cost of increased vulnerability to melee, biological, and acid attacks. If it sustains too much damage it will deactivate, and leave the user vulnerable until it recharges.
translation: 装甲系统的一项全新创新，该模块能在使用者周围生成一个护盾，能够抵消所有伤害，代价是增加对近战、生化和酸液攻击的脆弱性。如果承受过多伤害，它会停用，并在重新充能前让使用者处于脆弱状态。

original: A sophisticated shielding unit, designed to disperse the energy of incoming impacts, rendering them harmless to the user. If it sustains too much it will deactivate, and leave the user vulnerable. It is unclear if this was a purely  SOM designed module, or whether it was reverse engineered from the TGMC's 'Svalinn' shield system which was developed around the same time.
translation: 一套精密的护盾单元，旨在分散来袭冲击的能量，使其对使用者无害。如果承受过多伤害，它会停用，让使用者陷入脆弱状态。尚不清楚这究竟是纯粹的火星之子设计模块，还是从地球政府殖民地海军陆战队同期开发的'斯瓦林'护盾系统逆向工程而来。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. This module creates a holographic projection of the user while simultaneously rendering them invisible for a short duration, which can be used to distract enemies and draw their fire.
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。该模块会生成使用者的全息投影，同时让使用者在短时间内隐形，可用于分散敌人注意力并吸引火力。

original: Designed for mounting on modular armor. This module seals gaps in the armor when activated, making the user unable to do any actions but increasing their armor.
translation: 专为模块化装甲设计。激活时，此模块会密封装甲间隙，使使用者无法进行任何动作，但会提升其护甲。

original: Designed for mounting on conventional clothing, this grants it a level of reinforcement against attacks.
translation: 专为安装在常规衣物上设计，这使其具备一定程度的攻击防护能力。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. This module can be toggled on or off to function as welding protection for your delicate eyes.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。此模块可开关，作为焊接护具保护您脆弱的眼睛。

original: Built in welding module for a SOM engineering helmet. This module can be toggled on or off to function as welding protection for your delicate eyes.
translation: 火星之子工程头盔内置焊接模块。该模块可开关，为您的精密双眼提供焊接防护。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. This more expensive module can be toggled on or off to function as welding protection for your delicate eyes, strangely smells like potatoes.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。这款价格更高的模块件可切换开关，为你的娇嫩双眼提供焊接保护，奇怪的是闻起来有股土豆味。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. Can be flipped down to view into the distance.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。可向下翻转以观察远处。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. The Freyr module is designed with an overlay visor that clarifies the user's vision, allowing them to see clearly even in the harshest of circumstances. This version is enhanced and allows the marine to peer through the visor, akin to binoculars.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。弗雷尔模块配备增强型护目镜，可在最恶劣环境下提供清晰视野。此版本经过强化，使陆战队员能够透过护目镜进行观察，功能类似双筒望远镜。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. The Freyr module is designed with an overlay visor that clarifies the user's vision, allowing them to see clearly even in the harshest of circumstances.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。弗雷尔模块配备增强视觉的覆盖式面罩，即使在最恶劣的环境下也能让使用者清晰视物。

original: Designed for mounting on a modular helmet. This module is able to shield against the interference of caves, allowing for normal messaging in shallow caves, and only minor interference when deep.
translation: 专为模块化头盔设计。此模块能够屏蔽洞穴干扰，在浅层洞穴中可实现正常通讯，深层洞穴中仅受轻微干扰。

original: Installation kit for the BE-35 night vision system. Slightly impedes movement.
translation: BE-35夜视系统安装套件。轻微阻碍移动。

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Certainly not as specialised as any other storage modules, but definitely able to hold some larger things, like binoculars, maps, and motion detectors.
translation: 专为安装在TGMC模块化装甲系统上设计。虽然不如其他存储模块那样专业，但绝对能容纳一些较大的物品，比如双筒望远镜、地图和运动探测器。

original: Designed for mounting on SOM combat armor. Certainly not as specialised as any other storage modules, but definitely able to hold some larger things, like pistols or magazines.
translation: 专为火星之子战斗护甲设计。虽然不如其他存储模块那样专业，但绝对能容纳一些较大的物品，比如手枪或弹匣。

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Holds some magazines. Don’t expect to fit specialist munitions or LMG drums in, but you can get some good mileage.
translation: 专为地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的模块化装甲系统设计。可容纳一些弹匣。别指望能装下专家级弹药或轻机枪弹鼓，但它的实用性还是不错的。

original: Designed for mounting on the MAGNUM mercenaries modular armor. Impedes movement somewhat, but holds about as much as a satchel could.
translation: 专为安装在MAGNUM佣兵模块化装甲上设计。会略微妨碍行动，但容量与挎包相当。

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Can hold about as much as a tool pouch, and sometimes small spools of things like barbed wire, or an entrenching tool.
translation: 专为地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的模块化装甲系统设计。容量与工具附包相当，有时可容纳小型线轴物品，如铁丝网或工兵铲。

original: Designed for mounting on SOM combat armor. Can hold about as much as a tool pouch, and sometimes small spools of things like barbed wire, or an entrenching tool.
translation: 专为火星之子战斗护甲设计。容量与工具附包相当，有时可容纳小型线轴（如铁丝网）或工兵铲。

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Can hold a substantial variety of medical supplies and apparatus, but cannot hold as much as a medkit could.
translation: 专为地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的模块化装甲系统设计。可容纳多种医疗物资和设备，但容量不及医疗包。

original: Designed for mounting on SOM combat armor. Can hold a substantial variety of medical supplies and apparatus, but cannot hold as much as a medkit could.
translation: 专为安装在火星之子战斗护甲上设计。可容纳多种医疗物资和设备，但容量不及医疗包。

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Can hold a substantial variety of injectors.

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Impedes movement somewhat, but holds about as much as a satchel could.

original: Designed for mounting on the TGMC's modular armor systems. Can hold a respectable amount of grenades.
translation: 专为安装在TGMC模块化装甲系统上设计。可容纳相当数量的手雷。

original: A small set of straps to hold something in your boot.
translation: 一套小型绑带，用于将物品固定在靴子上。

original: A small set of bands and straps to allow easy storage of small items.
translation: 一套小型束带和绑带，便于存放小件物品。

original: A sturdy mess of synthcotton belts and buckles, ready to share your burden.
translation: 一套坚固的合成棉带扣组合，随时准备分担你的负重。

original: Robust black synthcotton vest with lots of pockets to hold whatever you need, but cannot hold in hands.
translation: 坚固的黑色合成棉背心，带有多个口袋，可容纳你所需但无法手持的物品。

original: Worn brownish synthcotton vest with lots of pockets to unload your hands.
translation: 磨损的褐色合成棉背心，带有许多口袋，方便你腾出双手。

original: A clean white Nylon vest with large pockets specially designed for medical supplies
translation: 一件干净的白色尼龙背心，带有专为医疗用品设计的大口袋

original: A clean white Nylon webbing composed of many straps and pockets to hold surgical tools.
translation: 一条干净的白色尼龙织带，由多条带子和口袋组成，用于存放手术工具。

translation: 一个破旧的手枪枪套。非常适合隐蔽携带。

translation: 一个手枪枪套。由昂贵的皮革制成。

original: A special helmet designed for work in a hazardous, low-pressure environment. Only for the most fashionable of military figureheads.
translation: 专为在危险低压环境中工作而设计的特殊头盔。只为最时尚的军事领袖准备。

original: A bulky, heavy-duty piece of exclusive Nanotrasen armor. YOU are in charge!
translation: 一件笨重、耐用的纳米传讯专属装甲。现在由你负责！

original: A sleek silver helmet. It almost seems to stem from the future...
translation: 一顶光滑的银色头盔。它仿佛来自未来……

original: A sleek silver suit. It almost seems to stem from the future...
translation: 一套光滑的银色套装。它仿佛源自未来……

original: Has a tag: Totally not property of an enemy corporation, honest.
translation: 有一个标签：绝对不是敌对公司的财产，真的。

original: Has a tag on it: Totally not property of of a hostile corporation, honest!
translation: 上面有个标签：绝对不是敌对企业的财产，真的！

original: You need to be wearing somethng under this to be able to equip it.
translation: 你需要穿着内衣才能装备这个。

original: An armored vest that protects against some damage.
translation: 一件能提供一定防护的防弹背心。

original: An armoured jacket with gold regalia
translation: 一件带有金色徽章的装甲夹克

original: An armored vest that protects against some damage.
translation: 一件能提供一定防护的防弹背心。

original: An armoured jacket with silver rank pips and livery.
translation: 一件带有银色军衔徽章和标识的装甲夹克。

original: A vest that excels in protecting the wearer against high-velocity solid projectiles.
translation: 一件擅长防护穿戴者免受高速实体弹丸伤害的防弹背心。

original: A suit of armor with heavy padding to protect against melee attacks. Looks like it might impair movement.
translation: 一套带有厚重衬垫的盔甲，用于防护近战攻击。看起来可能会妨碍行动。

original: A heavily armored suit that protects against moderate damage. Used in special operations.
translation: 一套重型装甲服，可抵御中等程度伤害。用于特种作战。

original: An armored jacket used in special operations.
translation: 特种作战中使用的装甲夹克。

original: An armored vest with a detective's badge on it.
translation: 一件带有侦探徽章的防弹背心。

original: A suit of armor used by workers in dangerous environments.
translation: 危险环境中作业人员使用的防护服。

original: A lightweight suit of armor used by security officers on patrol. While it is more advanced than kevlar, it is heavier and will slightly slow the wearer down.
translation: 一套供巡逻安保人员使用的轻型护甲。虽然比凯夫拉更先进，但重量更大，会略微降低穿戴者的移动速度。

original: A field of invisible energy, it protects the wearer but prevents any clothing from being worn.
translation: 一片无形的能量场，它能保护穿戴者，但无法同时穿戴任何衣物。

original: A suit that protects against some damage.
translation: 一套能提供一定防护的护甲。

original: A heavily armored suit that protects against moderate damage.
translation: 一套重型装甲服，可抵御中等程度的伤害。

original: A greatcoat enhanced with a special alloy for some protection and style.
translation: 一件采用特殊合金增强的大衣，兼具防护与时尚风格。

original: A trenchcoat augmented with a special alloy for some protection and style.
translation: 一件经过特殊合金强化的风衣，兼具防护与时尚。

original: A hood that protects the head and face from biological comtaminants.
translation: 一种保护头部和面部免受生化污染物侵害的头罩。

original: A suit that protects against biological contamination.
translation: 一套能防护生化污染的防护服。

original: It protected doctors from the Black Death, back then. You bet your arse it's gonna help you against viruses.
translation: 这玩意儿当年能保护医生对抗黑死病，我敢打赌它肯定能帮你对付病毒。

original: You attempt to button-up the velcro on your [src], before promptly realising that it won't work.
translation: 你试图扣上[src]的魔术贴，但很快就意识到这行不通。

original: A plastic covering to prevent the passage of bodily fluids during surgery.
translation: 用于手术中防止体液渗透的塑料覆盖物。

original: Worn by a Captain to show their class.
translation: 舰长佩戴以彰显其阶级。

original: A less formal jacket for everyday captain use.
Maximum piety in this star system.
An apron used by a high class chef.
A basic, dull, white chef's apron.
translation: 一件基础、单调的白色厨师围裙。

original: A formal military jacket. Not recommended for combat use.
translation: 一件正式的军用夹克。不建议用于战斗。

original: An officer's formal jacket, makes you look authoritative.
translation: 军官的正式夹克，让你看起来很有权威。

original: This piece of clothing was specifically designed for asserting superior authority.
translation: 这件服装专为彰显至高权威而设计。

original: An 18th-century multi-purpose trenchcoat. Someone who wears this means serious business.
translation: 一件18世纪的多用途战壕风衣。穿上它的人，意味着要动真格了。
一件红色法医技术员夹克。
一件蓝色的法医技术员夹克。

original: A high-visibility vest used in work zones.
translation: 工作区使用的高能见度背心。

original: A high-visibility jacket worn by medical first responders.
translation: 医疗急救人员穿着的高能见度夹克。

original: They suspend the illusion of the mime's play.
translation: 他们暂停了默剧表演的幻象。

original: A standard snow suit. It can protect the wearer from extreme cold.
translation: 一套标准雪地服。它能保护穿戴者抵御严寒。
你解开了实验服的纽扣。
你扣上了实验袍的扣子。

original: A suit that protects against minor chemical spills.
translation: 一套能防护轻微化学泄漏的防护服。

original: It makes you look capable of konking someone on the noggin and shooting them into space.
translation: 这让你看起来能敲晕别人，然后把他们射进太空。

original: A suit that holds small medical items for responding and tending to emergencies.
translation: 一套用于存放小型医疗物品，以便应对和处理紧急情况的防护服。

original: A suit that protects against minor chemical spills. Has an orange stripe on the shoulder.
translation: 一套能防护轻微化学泄漏的防护服。肩部有一条橙色条纹。

original: A suit that protects against minor chemical spills. Offers slightly more protection against biohazards than the standard model. Has a green stripe on the shoulder.
translation: 一套能防护轻微化学泄漏的防护服。相比标准型号，对生化危害提供稍强的防护。肩部有一条绿色条纹。

original: A suit that protects against minor chemical spills. Has a blue stripe on the shoulder.
translation: 一套能防护轻微化学泄漏的防护服。肩部有一条蓝色条纹。

original: A suit that protects against minor chemical spills. Has a purple stripe on the shoulder.
translation: 一套能防护轻微化学泄漏的防护服。肩部有一条紫色条纹。

original: A high quality labcoat, seemingly worn by scholars and researchers alike. It has a distinct rough feel to it, and goads you towards adventure.
translation: 一件高品质的实验服，似乎是学者和研究员们常穿的款式。它有着独特的粗糙质感，仿佛在引诱你踏上冒险之旅。

original: You cannot turn the light on while in [user.loc].
You cannot turn the light on while in [user.loc].

translation: \improper M7-H 重骑兵型 PMC 军官外骨骼装甲
\improper 回收的星际战士动力装甲

\improper 撞击者MT-H/43型'宙斯'动力爆炸防御护甲
