translation: 你忘记在偏好设置中设置合成人名称了。请下次记得设置。

original: [H] shudders violently and shoots out sparks!
[H] shudders violently and shoots out sparks!
\The [src]'s cover swings open, exposing the wires!
translation: \The [src]的盖子打开了，露出了里面的电线！

original: \The [src]'s wires snap apart in a rain of sparks!
translation: \The [src]的电线在一阵火花雨中崩断！

original: [zombie.name] begins to slash at the nuke.
You feel your [pocket_side] pocket being fumbled with!
translation: 你感觉到你的[pocket_side]口袋被翻动了！

original: Maybe you should lie down for a bit...
translation: 也许你该躺下休息一会儿...

original: There is a resin trap in the way!

translation: 这可不是种菜的好地方！

original: We will now spawn [weed_choice]\s when using the plant weeds ability.
translation: 现在使用种植菌毯能力时，将生成[weed_choice]\s。

original: We will no longer automatically plant weeds.
translation: 我们将不再自动铺设菌毯。

original: We will now automatically plant weeds.
translation: 我们现在将自动铺设菌毯。

original: You cannot plant weeds without line of sight!
translation: 没有视野无法种植菌毯！

original: You cannot build here without line of sight!
translation: 没有视野无法在此建造！

original: You cannot secrete resin without line of sight!
translation: 没有视线无法分泌树脂！

original: The hive has ran out of quickbuilding points! Wait until more sisters awaken or the marines land!
translation: 蜂巢已耗尽快速建造点数！等待更多姐妹苏醒或陆战队登陆！

original: We can't give that caste plasma.
translation: 我们不能给那个阶级的异形等离子体。

original: We need to be closer to [target].
We start focusing our plasma towards [target].
translation: 我们开始将等离子体聚焦向[target]。

original: [xeno_owner] has transfered [amount] units of plasma to us. We now have [target.plasma_stored]/[target.xeno_caste.plasma_max].
translation: [xeno_owner] 向我们输送了 [amount] 单位的等离子体。我们现在拥有 [target.plasma_stored]/[target.xeno_caste.plasma_max]。

original: We have transferred [amount] units of plasma to [target]. We now have [xeno_owner.plasma_stored]/[xeno_owner.xeno_caste.plasma_max].
translation: 我们已将[amount]单位的等离子体转移给[target]。当前等离子体储备为[xeno_owner.plasma_stored]/[xeno_owner.xeno_caste.plasma_max]。

original: We begin generating enough acid to melt through the [A]
translation: 我们开始产生足够的酸液来熔化这个[A]。

original: We feel our acid glands refill. We can spray acid again.
translation: 我们感觉到酸液腺体重新充盈。我们可以再次喷射酸液了。
我们现在将喷射[xeno_owner.ammo.name]（消耗[xeno_owner.ammo.spit_cost]等离子体）。
需要再补充 [xeno_owner.ammo?.spit_cost - xeno_owner.plasma_stored] 点等离子体！

original: We feel our neurotoxin glands swell with ichor. We can spit again.
translation: 我们感到神经毒素腺体充满了体液。我们可以再次喷射了。

original: Our sting won't affect this target!
translation: 我们的毒刺对此目标无效！
我们无法抵达这个目标！

original: Ashamed, we reconsider bullying the poor, nested host with our stinger.
translation: 惭愧，我们重新考虑用尾刺欺负这个可怜的、被抱脸虫寄生的宿主。

original: We feel our toxic glands refill. We can use our [initial(name)] again.
translation: 我们感到毒腺重新充盈。我们可以再次使用我们的[initial(name)]了。

original: There's nobody nearby to whisper to.
You hear a strange, alien voice in your head. \"[msg]\"
translation: 你听到脑海中响起一个奇怪的外星声音。'[msg]'

original: Our eggs wouldn't grow well enough here. Lay them on resin.
translation: 我们的卵在这里无法良好生长。把它们产在树脂上。

original: We're too busy being on fire to do this!
translation: 我们正忙着着火呢，没空做这个！

original: This creature is struggling too much for us to drain its life force.
translation: 这个生物挣扎得太厉害，我们无法汲取它的生命能量。

original: There is no longer any life force in this creature!
translation: 这个生物已经没有任何生命迹象了！

original: We can't drain something that is not human.
translation: 我们无法抽取非人类目标的血液。

original: This artificial construct has no life force to drain
translation: 这个人工造物没有生命能量可供汲取

original: You can't do this while flying!
translation: 你不能在飞行时这样做！

original: Someone drained the life force of our victim before we could do it!
translation: 有人在我们动手之前就吸干了受害者的生命力！

original: This creature is struggling too much for us to devour it.
translation: 这个生物挣扎得太厉害，我们无法吞噬它。

original: There is no longer any life force in this creature!
translation: 这个生物已经没有任何生命迹象了！

original: We're too busy being on fire to do this!
translation: 我们正忙着着火呢，没空干这个！

original: We already have something in our stomach, there's no way that will fit.
translation: 我们胃里已经有东西了，那玩意儿塞不下了。

original: We are too close to the fog.
We stop devouring \the [victim]. They probably tasted gross anyways.
translation: 我们停止吞噬\the [victim]。反正他们尝起来可能很恶心。

original: Someone drained the life force of our victim before we could devour it!
translation: 有人在我们吞噬之前就吸干了受害者的生命力！

original: We will eject the cocoon in [cocoon_production_time / 10] seconds! Do not move until it is done.
translation: 我们将在[cocoon_production_time / 10]秒后弹出茧！完成前请勿移动。

original: We moved too soon and we will have to devour our victim again!
translation: 我们行动过早，不得不再次吞噬我们的猎物！

original: \The [owner] regurgitates a pulsating node and plants it on the ground!
translation: \The [owner] 呕出一个脉动的节点并将其种植在地上！

original: \The [xeno_owner] regurgitates a thick substance and shapes it into \a [initial(AM.name)]!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 呕出一团浓稠物质，并将其塑造成 \a [initial(AM.name)]！

original: \The [xeno_owner] vomits globs of vile stuff all over \the [A]. It begins to sizzle and melt under the bubbling mess of acid!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 向 \the [A] 喷吐出大团恶心的物质。在沸腾的酸液混合物下，它开始嘶嘶作响并熔化！

original: \The [xeno_owner] begins opening its mouth and extending a second jaw towards \the [victim].
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 开始张开嘴，向 \the [victim] 伸出第二副下颚。
这个位置无法容纳菌毯！

original: the queen mother prohibits building here!
translation: 异形女王禁止在此处建造！

original: a xeno is blocking this spot!
translation: 一个异形挡住了这个位置！

original: the fog won't let the resin grow!
current acid is equal or higher in power!
translation: 当前酸液的威力相当或更高！
无法在载具上时进行此操作

original: Rest on weeds to regenerate health and plasma.
translation: 在菌毯上休息以恢复生命值和等离子体。

original: Plant a weed node on your tile.
translation: 在你的格子上种植菌毯节点。
建造你选择的树脂结构

original: Increases healing for yourself and nearby teammates.
translation: 提升你自身及附近队友的治疗效果。

original: Increases armor for yourself and nearby teammates.
translation: 为你自身和附近的队友增加护甲。

original: Increases damage for yourself and nearby teammates.
translation: 为你自己和附近的队友增加伤害。

original: Give some of your plasma to a teammate.
translation: 将你的部分等离子体给予队友。

original: Cover an object with acid to slowly melt it. Takes a few seconds.
translation: 用酸液覆盖物体以缓慢熔化它。需要几秒钟。

original: Spit neurotoxin or acid at your target up to 7 tiles away.
translation: 向7格内的目标喷射神经毒素或酸液。

original: Causes your sprite to hide behind certain objects and under tables. Not the same as stealth. Does not use plasma.
translation: 使你的精灵隐藏在特定物体和桌子下方。与潜行不同。不消耗等离子体。

original: A channeled melee attack that injects the target with neurotoxin over a few seconds, temporarily stunning them.
translation: 一种蓄力近战攻击，可在数秒内向目标注入神经毒素，使其暂时眩晕。

original: A channeled melee attack that injects the target with Ozelomelyn over a few seconds, purging chemicals and dealing minor toxin damage to a moderate cap while inside them.
translation: 一种蓄力近战攻击，可在数秒内向目标注入奥泽洛梅林，清除其体内化学物质并造成少量毒素伤害，上限为中等程度。

original: Send a message directly to a living target in view.
translation: 向视野内的一个活体目标直接发送信息。

original: Create an egg that will grow a larval hugger after a short delay. Empty eggs can have huggers inserted into them.
translation: 创建一个会在短暂延迟后孵化出幼虫抱脸虫的卵。空卵可以放入抱脸虫。

original: Rallies the hive to a congregate at a target location, along with an arrow pointer. Gives the Hive your current health status. 60 second cooldown.
translation: 召集蜂群前往目标位置集结，并显示箭头指示。向蜂巢意志报告你的当前生命状态。60秒冷却时间。

original: Rallies the minions around you, asking them to follow you if they don't have a leader already. Rightclick to change minion behaviour.
translation: 召集你周围的仆从，如果它们还没有领导者，就让它们跟随你。右键点击可更改仆从行为。

original: Drain the victim of its life force to gain larva and psych points
translation: 吸取受害者的生命力来获得幼虫和心灵点数

original: Devour your victim to cocoon it in your belly. This cocoon will automatically be ejected later, and while the marine inside it still has life force it will give psychic points.
translation: 将受害者吞入腹中，将其包裹在茧内。此茧稍后将自动排出，只要其中的陆战队员仍有生命力，就会提供灵能点数。

original: Ask the Queen Mother for blessings for your hive in exchange for psychic energy.
translation: 向异形女王祈求赐福，为你的蜂巢换取心灵能量。

original: Place a pattern of hive walls.
translation: 放置一个蜂巢墙壁图案。

original: We disable the creatures hivemind sight apparatus.
translation: 我们关闭了该生物的蜂巢意志视觉装置。

original: We disable whatever annoying lights the dead creature possesses.
translation: 我们关闭这具尸体上所有烦人的灯光。

original: [src] is dead, why would we want to touch it?
translation: [src]已经死了，我们为什么要碰它？
\The [xeno_attacker] 用其镰刀般的手臂抚摸着 [src]。

original: Explode and spread dangerous toxins to hinder or kill your foes. You die.
translation: 爆炸并扩散危险毒素以阻碍或杀死你的敌人。你会死亡。

original: Select which reagent will be released when you explode.
translation: 选择你爆炸时释放的试剂。

original: An oozy, squishy alien that can roll in agile speeds, storing various dangerous chemicals in its sac...
translation: 一种黏糊糊、软绵绵的外星生物，能以敏捷的速度滚动，在其囊袋中储存着各种危险的化学物质……

original: A bulky, six-legged alien with a horn. Its carapace seems quite durable.
translation: 一种体型庞大、六足、长有犄角的外星生物。它的甲壳看起来相当坚固。

original: Toggles Rolling on or off. This can be used to displace talls but won't deal any damage.
translation: 切换滚动开关。可用于推开高个子单位，但不会造成任何伤害。

original: Rush forward in the selected direction, damaging enemies caught in a wide path.
translation: 向选定方向猛冲，对宽阔路径上的敌人造成伤害。

original: Raise a pillar of earth at the selected location. This solid structure can be used for defense, and it interacts with other abilities for offensive usage. The pillar can be launched by click-dragging it in a direction. Alternate use destroys active pillars, starting with the oldest one.
translation: 在选定位置升起一根土柱。这种坚固结构可用于防御，并能与其他能力互动实现进攻用途。通过点击拖拽可将土柱朝指定方向发射。交替使用会摧毁已激活的土柱，从最早创建的柱子开始。

original: Blast the earth around you, inflicting heavy damage within [SEISMIC_FRACTURE_ATTACK_RADIUS] tiles. Earth Pillars will repeat this ability around them if hit by it.
translation: 轰击你周围的地面，对[SEISMIC_FRACTURE_ATTACK_RADIUS]格范围内的目标造成重创。被此能力击中的地刺柱会在其周围重复此能力。

original: Unleash your wrath. Enhances your abilities, changing their functionality and allowing them to apply a damage over time debuff.
translation: 释放你的怒火。强化你的能力，改变其功能并使其能够施加持续伤害减益效果。

original: A resilient and equally ferocious monster that commands the earth itself.
translation: 一种坚韧且同样凶猛的怪物，能够号令大地本身。

original: When your health is 50% or lower, gain 15/20/25 hard armor.
translation: 当你的生命值低于50%时，获得15/20/25点硬护甲。

original: Your slashes deal an additional 0.5/1/1.5x damage to barricades.
translation: 你的斩击对路障造成额外0.5/1/1.5倍伤害。

original: Earth Riser can have 1/2/3 more pillars active at a time, but its cooldown duration is doubled.
translation: 大地崛起者可以同时激活1/2/3根额外的石柱，但其冷却时间加倍。

original: We don't have any globs to choose!
translation: 我们没有可用的掷弹者！

original: We feel our toxin glands swell. We are able to bombard an area again.
translation: 我们感到毒腺肿胀。我们能够再次轰炸一个区域。

original: We have nothing prepared to fire.
translation: 我们没有准备任何火焰武器。

original: You are burned by the hot steam!
translation: 你被滚烫的蒸汽灼伤了！

original: The [owner] tackles us, sending us behind them!
[xeno_owner] stops looking off into the distance.
[xeno_owner] starts looking off into the distance.
\The [xeno_owner] begins digging their claws into the ground.
\The [xeno_owner] launches a huge glob of gas hurling into the distance!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 发射出一大团气体，呼啸着飞向远方！

original: [xeno_owner]'s body starts to hiss with steam!
translation: [xeno_owner]的身体开始嘶嘶作响，冒出蒸汽！
\The [owner] 扑摔 [carbon_victim]，与对方交换了位置！

original: Extend your sight off into the distance. Must remain stationary to use.
translation: 将你的视野延伸至远方。使用时必须保持静止。

original: Switches Boiler Bombard type between available glob types.
translation: 在可用的球体类型之间切换沸腾者轰炸类型。

original: Creates a Boiler Bombard of the type currently selected.
translation: 生成当前所选类型的沸腾者轰炸。

original: [initial(desc)] Reduces bombard cooldown by [BOILER_BOMBARD_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION / 10] seconds for each stored. Begins to emit light when surpassing [xeno_owner.glob_luminosity_threshold] globs stored.
translation: [initial(desc)] 每储存一团黏液，轰炸冷却时间减少[BOILER_BOMBARD_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION / 10]秒。当储存量超过[xeno_owner.glob_luminosity_threshold]团时开始发光。

original: Dig yourself into place in order to launch a glob of gas.
translation: 挖掘自身位置以发射一团气体。

original: Create a smokescreen of gas, setting your Bombard on a longer cooldown. Does not require or consume a reserved globule.
translation: 制造一片烟雾屏障，但会使你的轰炸技能进入更长的冷却时间。无需消耗预留的弹丸。

original: Gain a speed and damage boost while draining plasma. Slashes grant stacks which increase speed and damage. Creates smoke when at max stacks.
translation: 获得速度与伤害加成，同时消耗等离子体。斩击可叠加层数，提升速度与伤害。达到最大层数时产生烟雾。

original: Spit a steam smokescreen to cover your advance or retreat. Direct hits stagger and slow.
translation: 喷射蒸汽烟雾掩护你的前进或撤退。直接命中会令目标踉跄并减速。

original: Instantly dash for [charge_range] tiles, tackling the first marine in your path. If you manage to tackle someone, gain another cast of the ability.
translation: 立即向[charge_range]格冲刺，扑摔路径上的第一名陆战队员。若成功扑摔目标，则获得一次额外的技能使用机会。

original: Fire a high pressure glob of acid that knocks back, stuns, and shatters the target.
translation: 喷射一团高压酸液，可击退、击晕并粉碎目标。

original: [src] begins to bulge grotesquely, and explodes in a cloud of corrosive gas!
translation: [src]开始怪异地膨胀，并在腐蚀性气体云中爆炸！

original: A huge, grotesque xenomorph covered in glowing, oozing acid slime.
translation: 一个巨大的、怪异的异形，全身覆盖着发光、渗出的酸液粘液。

original: If you are staggered while carrying 7/5/3 stored globs, adjacent tiles will be sprayed with stunning acid. This recharges once you reach full health.
translation: 当你携带7/5/3枚储存的酸液球时若被击晕，相邻的格子将被喷洒眩晕酸液。此效果在你恢复满生命值时充能一次。

original: Having excess globs no longer causes you to glow, but will instead slow you down by 0.15/0.1/0.05 for each excess glob.
translation: 过量酸液球不再使你发光，而是每过量一个酸液球会使你的速度减慢0.15/0.1/0.05。

original: The threshold for having excess globs is increased by 1/2/3.
translation: 拥有过量酸液弹的阈值增加1/2/3。

original: If you have 7/5/3 stored globs, your acid spray also leaves a trail of non-opaque gas of your selected glob type.
translation: 若你储存了7/5/3发酸液弹，你的酸液喷射还会留下一道由所选酸液弹类型构成的不透明气体轨迹。

original: Bombard's preparation and firing cast delay is set to 50/40/30% of their original value. You lose Long Range Sight.
translation: 轰炸的准备和射击施法延迟被设定为原始值的50/40/30%。你失去了远程视野。

original: Your normal globs are replaced with fast globs. Fast globs are twice as fast, but the gas is transparent, smaller, and dissipates in two seconds. If a fast glob is used, Bombard's cooldown to 50/40/30% of its original value.
translation: 你的普通酸液球被替换为快速酸液球。快速酸液球的速度是原来的两倍，但气体是透明的、范围更小，并在两秒内消散。如果使用快速酸液球，轰炸技能的冷却时间将缩短至原值的50/40/30%。

original: Whenever you move while carrying 7/5/3 stored globs, a short acid splatter is created underneath you.
translation: 当你携带7/5/3个储存的酸液球移动时，脚下会产生一小片酸液溅射。

original: Bombard now has the option to shoot Ozelomelyn, Hemodile, and Sanguinal. These will consume 6/4/2 stored globs per shot.
translation: 轰炸现在可以选择发射奥泽洛梅林、血泊和血凝。这些弹药将分别消耗6/4/2个储存的球体。

original: Bombard and Long Range Sight can go 2/4/6 tiles further. The time required to use Long Range Sight is set to 250% of its original value.
translation: 轰炸与远程瞄准的射程可额外增加2/4/6格。使用远程瞄准所需的时间设定为原值的250%。

original: Acid Dash leaves a trail of opaque gas behind you. The gas lasts for 2/4/6 seconds.
translation: 酸液冲刺会在你身后留下一道不透明的气体。气体持续2/4/6秒。

original: Smokescreen Spit does stamina damage and emits Neurotoxin instead. Smokescreen Spit's plasma cost is 200/150/100% of its original cost.
translation: 烟雾喷射会造成耐力伤害并释放神经毒素。烟雾喷射的等离子体消耗为原始消耗的200/150/100%。

original: Corrosive Acid is now applied 20/35/50% faster.
translation: 腐蚀酸液现在应用速度加快20/35/50%。

original: When you hit a host, knock them out of your way while continuing your charge undeterred. The force of your charge also disarms them.
translation: 当你击中宿主时，将其撞开并继续不受阻碍地冲锋。冲锋的力量还会解除他们的武装。

original: When you hit a host, stops your charge while headbutting them, flinging them in the air and stunning them for some time.
translation: 当你击中宿主时，会停止冲锋并用头撞击他们，将其甩投到空中并使其眩晕一段时间。

original: When you hit a host, stops your charge while piercing and injecting them with Ozelomelyn.
translation: 当你击中宿主时，会停止冲锋，同时刺穿并注入奥泽洛梅林。

original: A bright red alien with a matching temper.
translation: 一只鲜红色的异形，脾气也同样火爆。

original: Charging will grant you complete stagger immunity if you reach the maximum number of steps minus 1/2/3.
translation: 冲锋达到最大步数减1/2/3时，将赋予你完全的抗踉跄能力。

original: Charging costs twice as much plasma. The speed multiplier per step is increased by 0.02/0.04/0.06.
translation: 充能消耗的等离子体翻倍。每步的速度倍率增加0.02/0.04/0.06。

original: Charge's maximum steps is increased by 4/8/12.
We don't have any facehuggers to use!
We grab one of the facehuggers in our storage. Now sheltering: [xeno_owner.huggers] / [xeno_owner.xeno_caste.huggers_max].
translation: 我们从储存中取出一只抱脸虫。当前庇护数量：[xeno_owner.huggers] / [xeno_owner.xeno_caste.huggers_max]。

original: This facehugger has already expired, we cannot salvage it.
translation: 这只抱脸虫已经死亡，我们无法回收利用。

original: We salvage this facehugger's biomass to produce another. Now sheltering: [huggers] / [xeno_caste.huggers_max].
translation: 我们回收这只抱脸虫的生物质来生产另一只。当前庇护数量：[huggers] / [xeno_caste.huggers_max]。

original: We can't carry any more facehuggers!
translation: 我们没法再带更多抱脸虫了！

original: We can only shape on weeds. We must find some resin before we start building!
translation: 我们只能在菌毯上塑形。在开始建造前，我们必须找到一些树脂！

original: We place a trap on the weeds, but it still needs to be filled.
translation: 我们在菌毯上放置了一个陷阱，但它还需要填充。

original: We can now spawn another facehugger.
translation: 我们现在可以再生成一只抱脸虫。

original: We can't host any more facehugger!
translation: 我们无法容纳更多抱脸虫了！

original: We spawn a facehugger via the miracle of asexual internal reproduction, adding it to our stores. Now sheltering: [xeno_owner.huggers] / [xeno_owner.xeno_caste.huggers_max].
translation: 我们通过无性内部繁殖的奇迹生成了一只抱脸虫，并将其加入我们的储备。当前庇护数量：[xeno_owner.huggers] / [xeno_owner.xeno_caste.huggers_max]。

original: We are not injured enough to panic yet!
translation: 我们还没伤到需要惊慌失措的地步！

original: We do not have any facehuggers to drop!
translation: 我们没有抱脸虫可供投放！

original: We will now spawn [initial(A.name)]\s when using the Spawn Facehugger ability.
translation: 现在使用生成抱脸虫能力时，将生成[initial(A.name)]\s。

original: We will now spawn [hugger_choice]\s when using the Spawn Facehugger ability.
translation: 现在使用生成抱脸虫能力时，将生成[hugger_choice]\s。

original: You cannot build with [blocker] in the way!

translation: \The [xeno_owner] 向 \the [A] 投掷了什么东西！

original: A chittering mass of tiny aliens is trying to escape [xeno_owner]!
translation: 一大群吱吱作响的小异形正试图逃离[xeno_owner]！
\the [owner] 发出一声不同寻常的咆哮！

original: \The [victim] loses [victim.p_their()] balance, falling to the side!
translation: \The [victim] 失去 [victim.p_their()] 平衡，侧身摔倒！

original: Throw a facehugger at something. Using this ability on a facehugger already on the ground will recycle it to your storage.
translation: 向目标投掷抱脸虫。对已在地面上的抱脸虫使用此能力可将其回收至储存空间。

original: Place a hole on weeds that can be filled with a hugger or with acid. Activates when a marine steps on it.
translation: 在菌毯上放置一个可填入抱脸虫或酸液的坑洞。当陆战队员踩上时触发。

original: Spawn a facehugger that is stored on your body.
translation: 生成一只抱脸虫，储存在你的身体上。

original: Drop all stored facehuggers in a fit of panic. Uses all remaining plasma!
translation: 在恐慌中丢弃所有储存的抱脸虫。消耗所有剩余的等离子体！

original: Drop all stored facehuggers in a fit of panic.
translation: 在恐慌中丢弃所有储存的抱脸虫。

original: Selects which hugger type you will build with the Use/Throw Facehugger ability.
translation: 选择你将通过使用/投掷抱脸虫能力构建的抱脸虫类型。

original: Construct a turret that will launch facehuggers at enemy marines. The type of facehugger currently selected when the turret is built will determine the type of facehugger that is fired.
translation: 建造一座会向敌方陆战队员发射抱脸虫的炮塔。建造炮塔时当前选中的抱脸虫类型将决定发射的抱脸虫种类。

original: Appeals to the larva inside a hugged target. The target loses their balance, gets pulled towards you, and their larva's growth progress accelerates.
translation: 吸引被抱脸目标体内的幼虫。目标失去平衡，被拉向你，同时其体内幼虫的成长进度加速。

original: A strange-looking alien creature. It carries a number of scuttling jointed crablike creatures.
translation: 一只外形奇特的异形生物。它携带着数只爬行的多关节蟹状生物。

original: If you are under the effect of Resin Jelly, all thrown huggers gain fire immunity. Each thrown hugger reduce the duration of the effect by 3/2/1 seconds.
translation: 如果你处于树脂凝胶效果下，所有投掷的抱脸虫都会获得火焰免疫。每个投掷的抱脸虫会使该效果的持续时间减少3/2/1秒。

original: While you have 8/7/6 or more stored huggers, you will automatically drop one underneath you when you become staggered.
translation: 当你拥有8/7/6个或更多储存的抱脸虫时，在被击晕时，你会自动在脚下掉落一个。

original: If you're not resting, Carrier Panic will automatically attempt to activate when possible. The cooldown duration is set to 20% of its original value. It only consumes 50/40/30% of your maximum plasma.
translation: 如果你没有处于休息状态，携带者恐慌会在条件允许时自动尝试激活。冷却时间缩短为原值的20%。它只会消耗你最大等离子体的50/40/30%。

original: Thrown huggers can now leap 1 tile at a time. All activation times are 0.8/0.7/0.6x of their original value, but will never be faster than 0.5s.
translation: 投掷的抱脸虫现在可以一次跳跃1格。所有激活时间均为原值的0.8/0.7/0.6倍，但永远不会快于0.5秒。

original: Huggers from your eggs now have a reduced cast time against humans. The cast time is set to 60/50/40% of its original value.
translation: 你产下的抱脸虫现在对人类的施放时间缩短了。施放时间调整为原值的60/50/40%。

original: Thrown huggers will accompanied by a fake facehugger which will mimic their behavior. Their color will be changed to match 50/70/90% of the original hugger's color.
translation: 投掷出的抱脸虫会伴随一个假抱脸虫，模仿其行为。它们的颜色会调整为原抱脸虫颜色的50/70/90%。

original: Egg Lay now creates eggs with your selected type of hugger inside. The plasma cost is set to 50/40/30% of its their original value and its cooldown is set to 50% of its original value. You lose the ability, Spawn Huggers.
translation: 产卵现在会生成内含你所选抱脸虫类型的卵。等离子体消耗设定为原值的50/40/30%，冷却时间设定为原值的50%。你失去了生成抱脸虫的能力。

original: Spawn Facehugger's cooldown is set to 70% of its original value and costs zero plasma, but will deal 50/40/30 true damage to you.
translation: 生成抱脸虫的冷却时间缩短至原值的70%，且不消耗等离子体，但会对自身造成50/40/30点真实伤害。

original: Your newly created traps can fit an additional 1/2/3 huggers, but the stun duration divided by the amount of the hugger inside the trap.
translation: 你新创建的陷阱可以额外容纳1/2/3只抱脸虫，但眩晕持续时间会根据陷阱内的抱脸虫数量进行均分。

original: You reel from the shockwave of [xeno_owner]'s stomp!
translation: 你被[xeno_owner]的践踏冲击波震得踉跄后退！
我们现在可以再次使用抛掷了。

original: We can now rapidly charge forward again.
translation: 我们现在可以再次快速向前冲锋了。
\The [xeno_owner] 用它的冠饰将 [A] 甩投出去[big_mob_message]！

original: Knocks adjacent targets away and down, targets take increased damage and stun when stomped on. Stuns for [CRUSHER_STOMP_PARALYZE / (1 SECONDS)] seconds, [CRUSHER_STOMP_PARALYZE_LONG / (1 SECONDS)] when stomped on.
translation: 击退并击倒邻近目标，被践踏的目标会受到额外伤害和眩晕。眩晕持续[CRUSHER_STOMP_PARALYZE / (1 SECONDS)]秒，被践踏时持续[CRUSHER_STOMP_PARALYZE_LONG / (1 SECONDS)]秒。

original: Fling an adjacent target over and behind you, or away from you while on harm intent. Also works over barricades.
translation: 将相邻目标甩投至你身后，或在伤害意图下将其甩离。也可用于甩投越过路障。

original: Charges up the crushers charge in place, then unleashes the full bulk of the crusher at the target location. Does not crush in diagonal directions.
translation: 蓄力准备碾压者的冲锋，然后向目标位置释放碾压者的全部力量。无法向对角线方向碾压。

original: A huge alien with an enormous armored head crest.
translation: 一个巨大的异形，拥有庞大的装甲头冠。

original: After not moving for 1 second, gain 5/7.5/10 soft armor in all categories.
translation: 静止1秒后，获得5/7.5/10点全类别软护甲。

original: Stomp's range is increased by 1 and loses damage 1 tile further. However, it deals 50/60/70% of its original damage and no longer has extra stun duration for stomping ontop of targets.
translation: 践踏的射程增加1格，并在1格外失去伤害。然而，它造成原伤害的50/60/70%，并且不再对踩踏目标造成额外的击晕持续时间。

original: Crest Toss's cooldown is set to 65/50/35% of its original cooldown if it was used on allies.
translation: Crest Toss的冷却时间在使用于盟友时，将设定为原始冷却时间的65/50/35%。

original: We don't have enough plasma, we need [(ability_cost * 2) - xeno_owner.plasma_stored] more plasma!
translation: 我们没有足够的等离子体，还需要[(ability_cost * 2) - xeno_owner.plasma_stored]点等离子体！

original: We are struck by \the [xeno_owner]'s tail sweep!
We gather enough strength to tail sweep again.
translation: 我们积蓄了足够的力量，可以再次施展尾扫了。

original: We rapidly untuck ourselves, preparing to surge forward.
translation: 我们迅速解除蜷缩状态，准备向前突进。

original: We carefully untuck, keeping our crest lowered.
translation: 我们小心翼翼地舒展身体，保持冠羽低垂。

original: We tuck ourselves into a defensive stance.

translation: 我们可以[xeno_owner.fortify ? "stand up" : "fortify"]再来一次。

original: We cannot yet transition to a defensive stance!
translation: 我们尚不能转为防御姿态！

original: We tuck our lowered crest into ourselves.
translation: 我们将低垂的冠饰收拢起来。

original: We tuck ourselves into a defensive stance.
We feel we are ready to shred our skin and grow another.
translation: 我们感觉已经准备好蜕皮并再次成长了。

original: We can't use that while on fire.
translation: 我们着火时无法使用那个。

original: We don't have enough plasma, we need [(ability_cost * 2) - xeno_owner.plasma_stored] more plasma!
translation: 我们没有足够的等离子体，还需要[(ability_cost * 2) - xeno_owner.plasma_stored]点等离子体！

original: We are struck by \the [xeno_owner]'s flying tail!
\The [xeno_owner] sweeps its tail in a wide circle!
The skin on \the [xeno_owner] shreds and a new layer can be seen in it's place!
translation: \the [xeno_owner] 的表皮剥落，露出了下方的新生皮层！

original: \The [owner] starts swinging its tail in a circle!
Hit all adjacent units around you, knocking them away and stunning for [paralyze_duration / (1 SECONDS)] seconds. You can parry thrown objects with this.
translation: 攻击你周围的所有相邻单位，将其击退并眩晕 [paralyze_duration / (1 SECONDS)] 秒。你可以用此技能格挡投掷物。

original: Charge up to [charge_range] tiles and stun any targets in our way for [paralyze_duration / (1 SECONDS)] seconds.
translation: 蓄力冲刺至[charge_range]格，击晕沿途所有目标[paralyze_duration / (1 SECONDS)]秒。

original: Increase your resistance to projectiles at the cost of slower move speed. Can use abilities while in crest defense.
translation: 提升对弹道攻击的抗性，但会降低移动速度。可在龟缩防御状态下使用技能。

original: Plant yourself for a large defensive boost and stun resistance. Can use forward charge and regeneration in this state.
translation: 扎根以获得大幅防御提升和眩晕抗性。在此状态下可使用向前冲锋和再生能力。

original: Regenerate your hard exoskeleton skin, restoring some health and removing all sunder.
translation: 再生你的坚硬外骨骼皮肤，恢复部分生命值并移除所有破甲效果。

original: Rapidly tail sweep and hit all adjacent humans around you. Uses double plasma when crest is active.
translation: 快速扫尾，攻击周围所有相邻人类。当冠饰激活时消耗双倍等离子体。

original: An alien with an armored head crest.
translation: 头部带有装甲头冠的异形。

original: Regenerate Skin additionally reduces various debuffs by 1/2/3 stacks or 2/4/6 seconds.
translation: 再生皮肤额外减少各类减益效果1/2/3层或2/4/6秒。

original: You can no longer be staggered by projectiles and gain 5/7.5/10 bullet armor, but lose 30/35/40 melee armor. Projectiles from pointblank range negate this bonus bullet armor.
translation: 你不再会被弹道武器击退，并获得5/7.5/10点弹道护甲，但失去30/35/40点近战护甲。来自近距离的弹道攻击会无视此额外弹道护甲。

original: Regenerate Skin additionally recovers 50/60/70% of your maximum health, but will reduce all of your armor values by 30 for 6 seconds.
translation: 再生皮肤额外恢复50/60/70%的最大生命值，但会使你的所有护甲值降低30点，持续6秒。

original: Tail Swipe deals stamina damage instead. It no longer paralyzes and deals 1.5x/1.75/2x more damage.
translation: 甩尾攻击现在造成耐力伤害。它不再造成麻痹，并且造成1.5倍/1.75倍/2倍更多伤害。

original: Tail Swipe's knockback is increased by 1 tile and staggers for 1/2/3 seconds.
translation: 甩尾击退距离增加1格，并造成1/2/3秒踉跄。

original: For each 10 sunder / missing armor, your melee damage multiplier is increased by 3/6/9%.
translation: 每有10点破甲/缺失护甲，你的近战伤害倍率增加3/6/9%。

original: Regenerate Skin can be used while on fire and will apply Resin Jelly to you for 2/4/6 seconds. If you were on fire, you will be extinguished and set nearby humans on fire.
translation: 再生皮肤可在着火时使用，并会为你施加2/4/6秒的树脂凝胶。如果你当时正在着火，你将被熄灭，并使附近的人类着火。

original: You are no longer immobilized during Fortify. However, your move delay is increased by 1.2/1/0.8 seconds while it is active.
translation: 你不再会在'坚守阵地'期间被定身。然而，激活期间，你的移动延迟会增加1.2/1/0.8秒。

original: Regenerate Skin additionally removes 8/16/24% sunder of a nearby friendly xenomorph. This prioritizes those with the highest sunder.
translation: 再生皮肤还会为附近的一名友方异形移除8/16/24%的破甲。此效果优先作用于破甲值最高的目标。

original: You feel your toxin accelerant glands refill. You can use Defile again.
translation: 你感到你的毒素加速腺体已重新充满。你可以再次使用亵渎了。

original: Our stinger successfully discharges accelerant into our victim.
translation: 我们的毒刺成功将加速剂注入受害者体内。

original: You feel horrible pain as something sharp forcibly pierces your thorax.
translation: 你感到一阵剧痛，有什么尖锐的东西强行刺穿了你的胸腔。

original: Your insides feel like they're on fire!
translation: 你的内脏感觉像着火了一样！

original: We feel our dorsal vents bristle with heated gas. We can emit Noxious Gas again.
translation: 我们感到背部的排气孔因炽热气体而竖起。我们可以再次释放有毒气体了。

original: We abort emitting fumes, our expended plasma resulting in nothing.
translation: 我们中止释放烟雾，消耗的等离子体毫无成效。

original: We try to emit toxins but are staggered!
translation: 我们试图释放毒素，但被击退了！

original: We try to emit toxins but are staggered!
translation: 我们试图释放毒素，但被踉跄打断了！

original: We try to emit toxins but are disabled!
translation: 我们试图释放毒素但被禁用了！

original: We feel our stinger fill with toxins. We can inject an egg with gas again.
translation: 我们感到毒刺中充满了毒素。我们可以再次向卵中注入气体。

original: We are able to infuse our spines with toxins again.
translation: 我们又能给脊刺注入毒素了。

original: Tufts of smoke begin to billow from [xeno_owner]!
Noxious smoke billows from the hulking xenomorph!
translation: 恶臭的烟雾从庞大的异形身上滚滚涌出！

original: [xeno_owner] starts injecting the egg with neurogas, killing the little one inside!
translation: [xeno_owner]开始向卵内注入神经毒气，杀死了里面的小家伙！

original: The stinger retracts from [xeno_owner], leaving the egg and little one alive.
translation: 毒刺从[xeno_owner]身上收回，留下卵和幼体存活。

original: Channel to inject an adjacent target with an accelerant that violently reacts with xeno toxins, releasing gas and dealing heavy tox damage in proportion to the amount in their system.
translation: 向相邻目标注射一种加速剂，该加速剂会与异形毒素剧烈反应，释放气体并根据其体内毒素量造成重度中毒伤害。

original: Channel for 3 seconds to emit a cloud of noxious smoke, based on selected reagent, that follows the Defiler. You must remain stationary while channeling; moving will cancel the ability but will still cost plasma.
translation: 引导3秒，根据所选试剂释放一团跟随亵渎者的有毒烟雾。引导期间必须保持静止；移动将取消技能但仍会消耗等离子体。

original: Inject an egg with toxins, killing the larva, but filling it full with gas ready to explode.
translation: 向卵内注入毒素，杀死幼虫，但使其充满气体，随时准备爆炸。

original: Selects which reagent to use for reagent slash and noxious gas. Neuro causes increasing pain and stamina damage. Hemodile slows targets down, multiplied by each other xeno-based toxin. Transvitox converts burns to toxin, and causes additional toxin damage when they take brute damage, both effects multiplied by other xeno-based toxins. Ozelomelyn purges all medicines from their system rapidly and causes minor toxin damage.
translation: 选择用于试剂斩击和毒雾的试剂类型。神经毒素会造成递增的疼痛和耐力伤害。血滞毒素会减缓目标速度，效果会因其他异形毒素而叠加。转毒毒素将烧伤转化为毒素伤害，并在目标受到钝击伤害时造成额外毒素伤害，两种效果均会因其他异形毒素而增强。奥泽洛梅林会快速清除目标体内所有药物，并造成少量毒素伤害。

original: For a short duration, the next 3 slashes made will inject a small amount of selected toxin.
translation: 短时间内，接下来的3次斩击将注入少量所选毒素。

original: Throw one of your tentacles forward to grab a target or item.
translation: 向前甩出你的触手，抓取目标或物品。

original: A large, powerfully muscled xeno replete with dripping spines and gas leaking dorsal vents.
translation: 一个体型庞大、肌肉发达的异形，浑身布满滴着粘液的尖刺和漏气的背脊排气孔。

original: While you have more than 60/40/50% of your maximum plasma, getting staggered will consume that much plasma to release non-opaque gas of your last selected gas. This resets upon reaching maximum health.
translation: 当你的等离子体超过最大值的60/40/50%时，被击晕将消耗相应比例的等离子体，释放你最后选择的不透明气体。此效果在生命值回满时重置。

original: All slashes against humans will consume 20 plasma and inject your selected reagent equal to 20/35/50% of a regular reagent slash. You no longer have the ability, Reagent Slash.
translation: 所有针对人类的斩击将消耗20点等离子体，并注入你选择的试剂，注入量相当于常规试剂斩击的20/35/50%。你不再拥有'试剂斩击'能力。

original: Emit Noxious Gas now emits non-opaque gas instead. The radius of the gas is increased by 0.7/1.3/1.9 tiles.
translation: 释放毒气现在会释放非不透明气体。气体半径增加0.7/1.3/1.9格。

original: Our breath will spew melting fire.
translation: 我们的吐息将喷涌出熔化一切的火焰。

original: Our breath will spew shattering fire.
translation: 我们的吐息将喷涌出毁灭性的火焰。

original: Our breath will spew acidic fire.
translation: 我们的吐息将喷涌出酸性火焰。

original: [xeno_owner] lifts [grabbed_human] into the air and gets ready to slam!
translation: [xeno_owner] 将 [grabbed_human] 举到空中，准备猛砸！

original: [xeno_owner] inhales and turns their sights to [grabbed_human]...
translation: [xeno_owner] 深吸一口气，将目光转向 [grabbed_human]...

original: [xeno_owner] exhales a massive fireball right ontop of [grabbed_human]!
translation: [xeno_owner] 在 [grabbed_human] 正上方呼出一团巨大的火球！
无法在飞行时进行此操作！

original: Deal high damage, a knockback, and stun to marines in front of you. Vehicles and mechas take more damage, but are not knocked back nor stunned. If you are grabbing a marine, deal an incredible amount of damage to that marine after a windup.
translation: 对前方的陆战队员造成高额伤害、击退和眩晕效果。车辆和机甲会受到更多伤害，但不会被击退或眩晕。如果你正抓握着一名陆战队员，蓄力后将对其实施毁灭性打击。

original: After a long cast time, fly into the air. If you're already flying, land with a delay. Landing causes nearby marines to take lots of damage with vehicles taking up to 3x as much.
translation: 经过长时间施法后，飞向空中。若已处于飞行状态，则延迟落地。落地时会对附近陆战队员造成大量伤害，载具承受的伤害最高可达三倍。

original: After a windup, continuously blast fire in a cardinal direction. If you are grabbing a marine, deal an incredible amount of damage and knock them back instead.
translation: 蓄力后，持续向一个主要方向喷射火焰。如果你正抓住一名陆战队员，则会造成巨额伤害并将其击退。

original: After a short windup, deal high damage and a knockback to marines in a cone in front of you. This also clear any gas.
translation: 短暂蓄力后，对前方锥形区域内的陆战队员造成高额伤害并击退。同时清除所有气体。

original: After a windup, drag a marine in front of you and initiate a passive grab allowing you to drag them as you move. They are unable to move on their volition, but are fully capable of fighting back. Your grab automatically breaks if you stop grabbing or take too much damage.
translation: 蓄力后，将一名陆战队员拖拽至你面前并启动被动擒拿，允许你在移动时拖拽他们。他们无法自主移动，但仍能全力反抗。如果你停止擒拿或受到过多伤害，擒拿将自动解除。

original: While flying, breath fire downward from the sky in a long line where you're facing.
translation: 飞行时，从空中朝面向方向向下喷吐火焰，形成一条长线。

original: A massive, ancient beast with scales that shimmer like polished armor. The fiercest and most formidable creature.
translation: 一头体型庞大、古老无比的巨兽，鳞甲如抛光盔甲般闪耀。这是最凶猛、最令人生畏的生物。

original: Whenever you passively regenerate health, you will also gain 2.5/5/7.5% of your maximum plasma. This scales with regenerative power.
translation: 当你被动恢复生命值时，你还会获得最大等离子体值的2.5/5/7.5%。此效果随再生能力增强而提升。

original: Dragon Breath can switch between additional fire types to replace it with different effects: shatter or melting acid. Dragon Breath's cooldown is set to 150/125/100% of its original cooldown.
translation: 龙息可以在额外火焰类型之间切换，以替换为不同效果：碎裂或熔化酸液。龙息的冷却时间设定为原始冷却时间的150/125/100%。

original: You emit all types of pheromones at 2/2.5/3 power in a radius of 14/15/16.
translation: 你以2/2.5/3的强度在14/15/16的半径范围内释放所有类型的信息素。

original: \the [xeno_owner] vomits acid over [target], mending their wounds!
translation: \the [xeno_owner] 向 [target] 吐出酸液，治愈了他们的伤口！
我们无法与她建立链接！

original: Link to a xenomorph. This changes some of your abilities, and grants them and you both various bonuses.
translation: 链接至一个异形。这会改变你的部分能力，并为你和该异形双方提供各种增益。

original: Apply a minor heal to the target. If applied to a linked sister, it will also apply a regenerative buff. Additionally, if that linked sister is near death, the heal's potency is increased.
translation: 对目标施加轻微治疗。若目标为链接的姐妹，还将施加再生增益。此外，若该链接的姐妹濒临死亡，治疗效果将增强。

original: Apply an enhancement to the linked xeno, increasing their capabilities beyond their limits. You can see if a xeno can be empowered by checking their codex.
translation: 对链接的异形施加强化，使其能力突破极限。你可以通过查看它们的法典来确认异形是否可以被赋能。

original: You gain 5/10/15 armor in all categories. You lose this armor if you've been on weeds for longer than 5 seconds.
translation: 你在所有类别获得5/10/15点护甲。如果你离开菌毯超过5秒，你将失去此护甲。

original: While connected with Essence Link, you heal for 10/15/20% of your partner's damage when they slash a human.
translation: 与精华链接连接时，当你的伙伴对一名人类进行斩击时，你会恢复其伤害的10/15/20%。

original: While connected with Essence Link and it ends due to death, the survivor temporarily gains 75/100/125% additional melee damage for 10 seconds.
translation: 当与精华链接连接且因死亡而结束时，幸存者暂时获得75/100/125%的额外近战伤害，持续10秒。

original: Salve Heal has no cast time on your Essence Link partner if they qualify for bonus healing. Bonus healing multiplier is increased by an additive of 1/2/3.
translation: 若你的精华链接伙伴符合额外治疗条件，则'治疗之潮'对其无施法时间。额外治疗倍率增加1/2/3点。

original: While connected with Essence Link, you can manually disconnect to heal your partner for 5/10/15% of their maximum health multiplied by the attunement amount. However, you take true damage equal to the amount healed. This damage can kill you.
translation: 当与精华链接连接时，你可以手动断开连接，为你的伙伴恢复其最大生命值的5/10/15%，该数值乘以协调度。然而，你将承受等同于治疗量的真实伤害。此伤害可致命。

original: This creature is struggling too much for us to devour it.
translation: 这个生物挣扎得太厉害，我们无法吞噬它。

original: We're too busy being on fire to do this!
translation: 我们正忙着着火呢，没空做这个！

original: We are too close to the fog.
We stop devouring \the [victim]. They probably tasted gross anyways.
translation: 我们停止吞噬\the [victim]。反正他们尝起来可能很恶心。

original: We need to be next to our meal.
translation: 我们需要靠近我们的食物。

original: No need, we feel sated for now...
translation: 不必了，我们暂时已经饱足……

original: We can only restore familiar biological lifeforms.
translation: 我们只能恢复熟悉的生化生命体。

original: It is beyond our reach, we must be close and our way must be clear.
translation: 它超出了我们的触及范围，我们必须靠近且路径必须畅通。

original: We can only help living sisters.
translation: 我们只能帮助活着的姐妹。

original: [xeno_owner] slams her fists into you, crushing you to the ground!
translation: [xeno_owner] 用双拳猛击你，将你砸倒在地！

original: Blood shatters the ground around you!
translation: 鲜血在你周围的地面炸裂开来！

original: We can only link to familiar biological lifeforms.
translation: 我们只能链接到熟悉的生化生命体。

original: You are too hurt to link.
translation: 你伤得太重，无法建立链接。

original: It is beyond our reach, we must be close and our way must be clear.
translation: 它超出了我们的触及范围，我们必须靠近且路径必须畅通。

original: You are already linked to a xenomorph.
translation: 你已经与一只异形建立了链接。

original: [target] is already linked to a xenomorph.
translation: [target] 已经与一个异形建立了链接。

original: Not enough to begin a feast. We need [xeno_owner.xeno_caste.feast_plasma_drain * 10] blood.
translation: 还不够开始一场盛宴。我们需要[xeno_owner.xeno_caste.feast_plasma_drain * 10]血液。

original: We decide to end our feast early...
translation: 我们决定提前结束这场盛宴...

original: [xeno_owner] smashes her fists into the ground!
Devour your victim to be able to carry it around.
translation: 吞噬你的猎物以将其携带。

original: Root a marine and attack them twice after a windup, gaining blood and healing yourself. You cannot attack while doing this. When used on a human corpse, instead enter a channeled heal that grants overheal once health is full.
translation: 将一名陆战队员扑倒并蓄力后攻击两次，获得血液并治疗自身。此过程中无法攻击。若对一具人类尸体使用，则改为进入引导治疗状态，生命值回满后获得过量治疗。

original: Restores some of the health of another xenomorph, or overheals, at the cost of blood.
translation: 恢复另一只异形的部分生命值，或进行过量治疗，但会消耗血液。

original: Violently suffuse the ground with stored blood. A marine on your tile is staggered and injured, adjacent marines are staggered, and any nearby xenos are healed, including you.
translation: 将储存的血液猛烈地灌注到地面。你所在格子的陆战队员会被击退并受伤，相邻的陆战队员会被击退，附近的异形（包括你自己）会得到治疗。

original: Link to a xenomorph and take some damage in their place. Unrest to cancel.
translation: 链接至一名异形并代替其承受部分伤害。取消链接以解除。

original: Link to a xenomorph and take some damage in their place.
translation: 链接至一名异形并代替其承受部分伤害。

original: Enter a state of thirst, gaining movement and healing on your next attack, scaling with missing blood. If your blood is below a certain %, you also knockdown your victim and drain some blood, during which you can't move.
translation: 进入渴血状态，下次攻击时获得移动和治疗效果，效果随失血量增加。若血量低于特定百分比，还会击倒目标并吸取血液，期间无法移动。

original: Enter a state of rejuvenation. During this time you use a small amount of blood and heal. You can cancel this early.
translation: 进入恢复状态。在此期间，你将消耗少量血液并治疗自身。你可以提前取消此状态。

original: A large, powerfully muscled xeno with seemingly more vitality than others.
translation: 一个体型庞大、肌肉发达的异形，似乎比其他同类拥有更强的生命力。

original: While Psychic Link is active, you gain maximum movement resistance and gain 5/15/25 armor.
translation: 当心灵链接激活时，你获得最大移动抗性，并获得5/15/25点护甲。

original: Psychic Link no longer forces you to rest. While it is active, Drain is only 20/30/40% effective on corpses.
translation: 心灵链接不再强制你休息。激活期间，对尸体的吸取效果只有20/30/40%。

original: Transfusion heals an additional 8/12/16% maximum health. The plasma cost is set to 150/175/200% of its their original value.
translation: 输血额外恢复8/12/16%的最大生命值。等离子体消耗量设定为其原始值的150/175/200%。
我们将一些树脂塑造成\a [pod]。

original: We create a globule of resin from our ovipositor.
translation: 我们从产卵器中制造出一团树脂。

original: Too far for our reach... We need to be [dist - heal_range] steps closer!
translation: 距离太远，无法触及……我们需要再靠近 [dist - heal_range] 步！

original: Our wounds begin to knit and heal rapidly as [owner]'s healing energies infuse us.
translation: 我们的伤口开始迅速愈合，[owner]的治疗能量正注入我们体内。
我们将一些树脂塑造成\a [recovery_pylon]。

original: \The [xeno_owner] brushes xenomorphs' bits off its claws.
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 将异形的碎屑从它的爪子上拂去。
\the [owner] 向 [target] 注入了神秘的能量！
菌毯行走结束，无等离子体

original: need both hands to be empty!

translation: 已部署最大数量的恢复信标！

original: We deconstruct the body of a fellow fallen xenomorph to avoid marines from harvesting our sisters in arms.
translation: 我们分解了倒下的异形同类的尸体，以免陆战队利用我们的战友姐妹。

original: Place down a dispenser that allows xenos to retrieve fireproof jelly.
translation: 放置一个允许异形获取防火凝胶的分配器。

original: Psychically infuses a friendly xeno with regenerative energies, greatly improving its natural healing. Doesn't work if the target can't naturally heal.
translation: 向一名友方异形灌注心灵再生能量，大幅提升其自然愈合能力。若目标无法自然愈合，则此技能无效。

original: Sow the seeds of an alien plant.
Place down a recovery pylon that increases the amount of regeneration power restored.
translation: 部署一个恢复信标，增加再生能量的恢复量。

original: A huge ass xeno covered in weeds! Oh shit!
translation: 一只巨大的异形，浑身覆盖着菌毯！哦，该死！

original: Resin Walk increases all soft armor by 10/15/20, but prevents you from regenerating plasma.
translation: 树脂行走使所有软质护甲增加10/15/20点，但会阻止你再生等离子体。

original: Resin Walk creates temporary weeds as you move. Each created weed consumes 75/50/25 plasma.
translation: 树脂行走会在你移动时生成临时菌毯。每生成一块菌毯消耗 75/50/25 等离子体。

original: You heal 1/2/3% of your maximum health whenever you successfully use Secrete Resin.
translation: 你成功使用分泌树脂时，会恢复最大生命值的1/2/3%。

original: You lose the ability, Place Resin Jelly Pod. Resin jelly you throw no longer grants fire immunity, but creates thin sticky resin in a 3x3 where it lands for 15 seconds. Direct impacts on humans stagger for 2/4/6 seconds.
translation: 你失去了能力：放置树脂胶质荚。你投掷的树脂胶质不再提供火焰免疫，而是在其落点处生成一片3x3范围的稀薄粘性树脂，持续15秒。直接命中人类会使其踉跄2/4/6秒。

original: Whenever you slash a human, 600/400/200 plasma is consumed to throw a sticky resin grenade at them. This can occur every 8 seconds.
translation: 每当你对一名人类进行斩击时，会消耗600/400/200等离子体向其投掷一枚粘性树脂手雷。此效果每8秒可触发一次。

original: Recovery Pylon's aura is replaced with one that increases melee damage modifier by 10/20/30%. The aura's radius is increased by 3.
translation: 恢复信标的光环效果替换为提升近战伤害修正10/20/30%。光环半径增加3格。

original: Healing Infusion now also applies the effects of resin jelly for 15 seconds. The plasma cost is now 2x/1.75x/1.5x of the original cost.
translation: 治疗灌注现在还会施加树脂凝胶效果，持续15秒。等离子体消耗现在为原始消耗的2倍/1.75倍/1.5倍。

original: Healing Infusion only lasts 50/60/70% as long, but grants innate healing which allows healing off of weeds.
translation: 治疗灌注持续时间仅为50/60/70%，但赋予内在治疗能力，允许在菌毯上恢复生命值。

original: Plant Weeds now costs 80/65/50% of its initial value, but loses the option to select basic weeds.
translation: 现在种植菌毯消耗其初始值的80%/65%/50%，但失去了选择基础菌毯的选项。

original: Change from your incorporeal form to your physical on and vice-versa.
translation: 从你的无形形态转变为实体形态，反之亦然。

original: Command all minions, ordering them to converge on this location. Rightclick to change minion behaviour.
translation: 指挥所有仆从，命令它们向此位置集结。右键点击以更改仆从行为模式。

original: Pick a location on the map and instantly manifest there if possible.
translation: 在地图上选择一个位置，如果可能的话立即传送到那里。

original: Select one of the Hive's artillery buildings and shoot it at a target. Right-click to select which artillery to use.
translation: 选择蜂巢的一个炮台建筑，向目标开火。右键点击选择要使用的炮台。

original: You do not have the strength to manifest yet!
translation: 你还没有足够的力量来显形！

original: We were on top of fire, we got moved to our core.
translation: 我们当时在火焰上方，后来被转移到了核心区域。

original: We had no weeds nearby, we got moved to our core.
translation: 附近没有菌毯，我们被转移到了核心区域。

original: Your core is under attack, and dangerous low on health!
translation: 你的核心正遭受攻击，生命值极低！

original: Your core is under attack, and low on health!
translation: 你的核心正遭受攻击，生命值过低！

original: Our [src.name] has detected a nearby hostile [hostile] at [get_area(hostile)] (X: [hostile.x], Y: [hostile.y]).
translation: 我们的[src.name]侦测到附近有敌对[hostile]位于[get_area(hostile)] (X: [hostile.x], Y: [hostile.y])。

original: A very weird, pulsating node. This looks almost alive.
translation: 一个非常怪异、脉动着的节点。这东西看起来几乎是活的。

original: We're too busy being on fire to enter Stealth!
translation: 我们正忙着着火，无法进入潜行状态！

original: We're ready to use Stealth again.
translation: 我们准备好再次使用潜行了。

original: We're ready to use Sneak Attack while stealthed.
translation: 我们已准备好，可在潜行状态下使用偷袭。

original: We lack sufficient plasma to remain camouflaged.
translation: 我们缺乏足够的等离子体来维持伪装状态。

original: We lack sufficient plasma to remain camouflaged.
translation: 我们缺乏足够的等离子体来维持伪装状态。

original: Pouncing from the shadows, we stagger our victim.
translation: 从阴影中猛扑而出，我们让目标踉跄不稳。

original: We have no target to disguise into!
translation: 我们没有可伪装的目标！

original: You cannot turn into a human!
We lack sufficient plasma to remain camouflaged.
translation: 我们缺乏足够的等离子体来维持伪装状态。

original: We cannot psychically mark this target!
translation: 我们无法用灵能标记这个目标！
这已经是我们的目标了！
我们为什么要攻击自己人？

original: We require line of sight to mark them!
translation: 我们需要视线才能标记他们！

original: We are able to impose our psychic mark again.
translation: 我们能够再次施加我们的心灵印记。

original: We lost line of sight to the target!
translation: 我们失去了对目标的视线！

original: We psychically mark [A] as our quarry.
translation: 我们已用灵能标记[A]为我们的猎物。

original: We have no target we can trace!
translation: 我们无法追踪到任何目标！

original: Our target is too far away, and is beyond our senses!
translation: 目标距离过远，超出感知范围！

original: We sense our quarry [mark.marked_target] is currently located in [AREACOORD_NO_Z(mark.marked_target)] and is [get_dist(xeno_owner, mark.marked_target)] tiles away. It is [calculate_mark_health(mark.marked_target)] and [mark.marked_target.status_flags & XENO_HOST ? "impregnated" : "barren"].
translation: 我们感知到目标 [mark.marked_target] 目前位于 [AREACOORD_NO_Z(mark.marked_target)]，距离 [get_dist(xeno_owner, mark.marked_target)] 格。目标状态为 [calculate_mark_health(mark.marked_target)] 且 [mark.marked_target.status_flags & XENO_HOST ? "impregnated" : "barren"]。

original: The target location is too far! We must be [distance - HUNTER_SILENCE_RANGE] tiles closer!
translation: 目标位置太远了！我们必须再靠近[distance - HUNTER_SILENCE_RANGE]格！

original: We require line of sight to the target location!
translation: 我们需要目标位置的视线！

original: Your mind convulses at the touch of something ominous as the world seems to blur, your voice dies in your throat, and everything falls silent!
translation: 你的意识因某种不祥之物的触碰而剧烈震颤，世界仿佛变得模糊，你的声音在喉间消逝，万物陷入死寂！

original: We were unable to violate the minds of any victims.
translation: 我们未能侵入任何受害者的意识。

original: We invade the mind of [victim_count] [victim_count > 1 ? "victims" : "victim"], silencing and muting them...
translation: 我们入侵了 [victim_count] [victim_count > 1 ? "victims" : "victim"] 的意识，使其陷入沉寂与静默...

original: We refocus our psionic energies, allowing us to impose silence again.
translation: 我们重新凝聚灵能，得以再次施加静默。

original: already in a form of stealth!
already in a form of stealth!

Become harder to see, even harder to see when stalking, and almost invisible if you stand still. While invisible you sneak attack for a [sneak_attack_stun_duration / (1 SECONDS)] second stun. Uses plasma to move and lowers plasma gain.
translation: 更难被发现，潜行时更难被察觉，静止不动时几乎隐形。隐形状态下进行偷袭可造成[sneak_attack_stun_duration / (1 SECONDS)]秒眩晕。移动时消耗等离子体并降低等离子体获取。

original: Disguise yourself as a mob or an object. Uses plasma to move. Select your disguise with Hunter's Mark.
translation: 伪装成生物或物体。消耗等离子体移动。使用猎手标记选择伪装。

original: Leap at your target up to [HUNTER_POUNCE_RANGE] tiles away, stunning them for [XENO_POUNCE_STUN_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)] seconds.
translation: 向最远 [HUNTER_POUNCE_RANGE] 格外的目标猛扑，使其眩晕 [XENO_POUNCE_STUN_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)] 秒。

original: Psychically mark a creature you have line of sight to, allowing you to sense its direction, distance and location with Psychic Trace.
translation: 对视线内的生物进行心灵标记，使你能够通过心灵追踪感知其方向、距离和位置。

original: Psychically ping the creature you marked, letting you know its direction, distance and location, and general condition.
translation: 对你标记的生物进行心灵感应，让你知道它的方向、距离和位置，以及大致状况。

original: Create [illusion_count] mirror images of ourselves. Reactivate to swap with an illusion.
translation: 制造[illusion_count]个自身的镜像幻影。再次激活可与幻影交换位置。

original: Impairs the ability of hostile living creatures we can see in a 5x5 area. Targets will be unable to speak and hear for 10 seconds, or 15 seconds if they're your Hunter Mark target.
translation: 削弱我们可见的5x5区域内敌对生物的能力。目标将无法说话和听见，持续10秒；若目标为你的猎手标记目标，则持续15秒。

original: A beefy, fast alien with sharp claws.
translation: 一个肌肉发达、行动迅捷的外星生物，长着锋利的爪子。

original: Upon reaching 25/40/55% health, a mirage will appear and run away from you. That mirage takes priority when mirage swapping.
translation: 当生命值降至25/40/55%时，一个幻象会出现并逃离你。该幻象在幻象交换时拥有优先权。

original: Mirage will instead cause your slashes to create an illusion for the next 12/14/16 seconds. These illusions disappear when the time is up.
translation: 幻影将改为使你的斩击在接下来的12/14/16秒内制造幻象。这些幻象在时间结束后消失。

original: Mirage will instead creates cloaking gas for 12/14/16 seconds in a radius of 2.
translation: 幻影将改为在半径2范围内制造持续12/14/16秒的隐形气体。

original: Stealth's sneak attack no longer stuns. 1.25/1.5/1.75x of your slash damage is added onto sneak attack instead.
translation: 潜行攻击不再造成眩晕。取而代之的是，斩击伤害的1.25/1.5/1.75倍会附加到潜行攻击上。

original: Stealth's movement cost is 300% of its original value. While at the maximum stealth power, your next sneak attack has an additional 15/22.5/30 AP.
translation: 潜行状态下的移动消耗为原始值的300%。当潜行能量达到最大值时，你的下一次偷袭攻击将额外获得15/22.5/30点穿甲。

original: Pounce no longer stuns, but now slashes your target which can trigger sneak attack. Pounce's cooldown is set to 60/50/40% of its original value.
translation: 猛扑不再造成眩晕，而是对目标发动斩击，可触发偷袭效果。猛扑的冷却时间调整为原值的60/50/40%。

original: The effects of Silence against your Hunter's Mark target last 2.5/2.75/3x as long.
translation: 沉默效果对您猎人印记目标的影响持续时间延长至2.5/2.75/3倍。

original: Mirage creates 4 additional illusions, but the duration is reduced by 5/3/1 seconds.
translation: 幻象额外制造4个分身，但持续时间减少5/3/1秒。

original: Stealth's sneak attack causes temporary blindness, but no longer stuns. Mirage's cooldown is set to 90/80/70% of its original value.
translation: 潜行者的偷袭会造成暂时性失明，但不再造成眩晕。幻象的冷却时间调整为原值的90/80/70%。

original: Move in a burst of speed. Double tap any movement direction to dash towards it.
translation: 快速移动。双击任意移动方向即可向其冲刺。

original: Imbue your punches with charged plasma. Upgrades attacks, and allows you to execute powerful combos while this ability is selected.
translation: 为你的拳击注入带电等离子体。升级攻击，并在选择此能力时允许你执行强力连击。

original: Block attacks with your forearms, slowing you down and reducing damage received by [CONQUEROR_ENDURANCE_DAMAGE_REDUCTION * 100]%.
translation: 用前臂格挡攻击，这会减慢你的速度并减少[CONQUEROR_ENDURANCE_DAMAGE_REDUCTION * 100]%受到的伤害。

original: Teleport towards a target location, distorting reality, and creating powerful shockwaves upon reappearing.
translation: 传送至目标位置，扭曲现实，并在重新出现时产生强大的冲击波。

original: Unleash your latent power. Creates an area of effect that will slowly expand. Activating the ability again will attack everyone caught within it.
translation: 释放你潜在的力量。创造一个会缓慢扩张的范围效果区域。再次激活该能力将攻击被困在其中的所有人。

original: We gather enough mental strength to shut down lights again.
translation: 我们聚集了足够的精神力量，再次关闭了灯光。

original: You are smashed to the ground!
The hives power swells. We may summon our sisters again.
translation: 蜂巢的力量正在增强。我们可以再次召唤我们的姐妹了。

original: Shut down all electrical lights nearby for 10 seconds.
translation: 关闭附近所有电灯，持续10秒。

original: After a [PETRIFY_WINDUP_TIME / (1 SECONDS)] second windup, petrifies all humans looking at you for [PETRIFY_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)] seconds. Petrified humans are immune to damage, but also can't attack.
translation: 经过[PETRIFY_WINDUP_TIME / (1 SECONDS)]秒的准备后，石化所有注视你的[PETRIFY_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)]秒。被石化的人类免疫伤害，但同时也无法攻击。

original: Muddles the mind of an enemy, making it harder for them to focus their aim and movement for a while.
translation: 扰乱敌人的心智，使其在一段时间内难以集中瞄准和移动。

original: Unleash a mighty psychic roar, knocking down any foes in your path and weakening them.
translation: 释放强大的心灵咆哮，击倒路径上的所有敌人并削弱他们。

original: After a windup, concentrates the hives energy into a forward-facing beam that pierces everything, hurting living beings and vehicles.
translation: 蓄力后，将蜂巢的能量汇聚成一道向前发射的射线，穿透一切，对生物和载具造成伤害。

original: Summons all xenos in a hive to the caller's location, uses all plasma to activate.
translation: 召唤蜂巢中所有异形至召唤者位置，消耗全部等离子体激活。

original: A primordial creature, evolved to smash the hardiest of defences and hunt the hardiest of prey.
translation: 原始形态的生物，进化来粉碎最坚固的防御，猎杀最顽强的猎物。

original: A primordial beast, sculpted by countless fights, intent on conquering the battlefield.
translation: 一头原始形态的野兽，历经无数战斗的雕琢，一心要征服战场。

original: The effects of Jab from Conqueror's Will is replaced. It will instead heal you for 5/10/15% of your maximum health.
translation: 征服者意志的猛刺效果已被替换。现在它将为你恢复最大生命值的5/10/15%。

original: Domination's radius is reduced by 1, but knocked down for 0.5/0.8/1.1 seconds longer.
translation: 支配的半径减少1，但击倒时间延长0.5/0.8/1.1秒。

original: Dash can be activated at will as long it has charges. It can store up to 2/3/4 charges which are given at the rate of 200% of the ability's original cooldown.
translation: 冲刺可在有充能时随时激活。最多可储存2/3/4层充能，充能恢复速度为技能原始冷却时间的200%。

original: Allies that are in range of Petrify are granted 5/10/15 armor for the duration of it.
translation: 处于石化范围内的友军在此期间获得5/10/15点护甲。

original: Psychic Summon only affects minions. Once Psychic Summon is completed, the summoned gain a 0/10/20% melee damage increase for 30 seconds.
translation: 心灵召唤仅影响仆从。一旦心灵召唤完成，被召唤的仆从将在30秒内获得0/10/20%的近战伤害加成。

original: Nightfall's range is increased by 1/2/3 tiles and its cooldown is increased by 10 seconds.
translation: 夜袭的射程增加1/2/3格，冷却时间增加10秒。

original: Nightfall's range is decreased by 6/5/4 tiles. Nightfall will cause flares in its affected radius to lose 65/80/95% of their remaining duration.
translation: 夜幕降临的射程减少6/5/4格。夜幕降临会导致其影响范围内的照明弹损失65/80/95%的剩余持续时间。

original: A red, violent alien with four legs and two deadly scythes. Its eyes hone sharply onto its prey...
translation: 一只红色的、凶暴的外星生物，长着四条腿和两把致命的镰刀。它的眼睛锐利地锁定着猎物……

original: We vomit up a sticky lump.
translation: 我们呕出一团粘稠的块状物。

original: Our legs are struck by \the [xeno_owner]'s tail!
translation: 我们的腿被\the [xeno_owner]的尾巴击中了！

original: \The [xeno_owner] hooks into your flesh and yanks you towards it!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 用钩爪刺入你的血肉，将你猛地拽向它！

original: \The [xeno_owner] spews forth a wide cone of acid!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 喷吐出一大片锥形酸液！
\The [xeno_owner] 用它们的尾巴猛烈地刺穿了 \the [target_atom]！

original: \The [xeno_owner] sweeps its tail in a low circle!
\The [xeno_owner] swings the hook on its tail through the air!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 在空中挥舞着它尾巴上的钩子！

original: \The [xeno_owner] empowers nearby xenos with increased speed!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 用提升的速度强化了附近的异形！

original: Cannot create grenade, need empty hands
translation: 无法制造手雷，需要空手

original: A huge, looming beast of an alien.
translation: 一个巨大、若隐若现的异形巨兽。
