original: Assault an organic, restoring health through the use of the their biomass.
translation: 攻击有机体，通过利用其生物质来恢复生命值。

original: A reanimated body, crudely pieced together and held in place by an ominous energy tethered to some unknown force.
translation: 一具被复活的躯体，粗糙地拼凑在一起，由某种未知力量所束缚的不祥能量维系着。

original: An overwhelming sense of dread washes over you... You are temporarily slowed down!
translation: 一股压倒性的恐惧感席卷了你……你暂时被减速了！

original: [xeno_owner] begins to vomit out biomass and skillfully sews various bits and pieces together!
translation: [xeno_owner]开始呕吐出生物质，并熟练地将各种零碎部件缝合在一起！
[xeno_owner] 形成了一个令人作呕的傀儡！

original: [puppet] bloats and slowly unfurls its stitched body!
translation: [puppet] 肿胀起来，缓缓展开缝合的身体！

original: [living_owner] begins to form biomass and force it into the ground!
translation: [living_owner] 开始凝聚生物质并将其注入地面！

original: [living_owner]'s tendrils burst out from the ground!
[owner] swiftly manipulates the psychic strings of the puppets, ordering them to attack!
translation: [owner]迅速操纵傀儡的精神丝线，命令它们发动攻击！

original: [owner] quickly manipulates the psychic strings of the puppets, drawing them near!
translation: [owner]迅速操纵着傀儡的精神丝线，将它们拉近！

original: channeling voice, move or activate to cancel!
translation: 正在引导声音，移动或激活以取消！

original: Takes a chunk of flesh from the victim marine through a quick swiping motion, adding 100 biomass to your biomass collection.
translation: 通过快速挥击动作从受害陆战队员身上撕下一大块血肉，为你的生物质收集增加100点生物质。

original: Launch a spine from your tail. This attack will help deter any organic as well as support your puppets and teammates in direct combat.
translation: 从你的尾部发射一根脊刺。此攻击将有助于威慑任何有机体，并在直接战斗中支援你的傀儡和队友。

original: Emit a menacing presence, striking fear into the organics and slowing them for a short duration.
translation: 释放一股威慑气场，令有机体心生恐惧，并在短时间内减缓其行动速度。

original: Harvest the biomass and organs of a body in order to create a meat puppet to do your bidding.
translation: 收割尸体的生物质和器官，以制造一个肉傀儡来执行你的命令。

original: Uses 125 biomass to create a flesh homunculus to do your bidding, at an adjacent target location.
translation: 消耗125点生物质，在相邻目标位置创造一个血肉傀儡供你驱使。

original: Causes one of our puppets to detonate on selection, spewing acid out of the puppet's body in all directions, gibbing the puppet.
translation: 引爆一个我方傀儡，使其向四周喷溅酸液，并将傀儡炸成碎片。

original: Takes direct control of a Puppet's vocal chords. Allows you to speak directly through your puppet to humans.
translation: 直接控制傀儡的声带。允许你通过傀儡直接与人类对话。

original: Burrow freshly created tendrils to tangle organics in a 3x3 patch.
translation: 在3x3区域内钻出新鲜触须，缠住有机体。

original: Give a permanent upgrade to a puppet.
translation: 给予傀儡一项永久升级。

original: Send out your puppets to attack nearby humans
translation: 派出你的傀儡攻击附近的人类

original: Recall your puppets to follow you once more
translation: 召回你的傀儡，让它们再次跟随你

original: If damage taken would put you into critical, lose 1.5/1.25/1x amount of plasma instead.
translation: 若所受伤害将使你进入濒危状态，则消耗1.5/1.25/1倍量的等离子体作为替代。

original: Dreadful Presence will inflict a temporary effect that deals 4/6/8 stamina damage every second instead.
translation: 恐怖威压将施加一个临时效果，改为每秒造成4/6/8点耐力伤害。

original: Stitch Puppet's cost is 20% of its original cost. Bestow Blessing costs 40/30/20% more.
translation: 缝合傀儡的成本是其原始成本的20%。赐福祝福的消耗增加40/30/20%。

original: A xenomorph of terrifying display, it has a tail adorned with needles that drips a strange chemical and elongated claws.
translation: 一只令人恐惧的异形，它的尾巴上装饰着滴落奇异化学物质的尖刺，爪子也异常修长。

original: Charge up to 3 tiles, attacking any organic you come across. Extinguishes the target if they were set on fire, but deals extra damage and restores plasma depending on how many fire stacks they have.
translation: 蓄力冲刺最多3格，攻击沿途遇到的任何有机体。如果目标身上有火焰，则将其扑灭，但会根据目标身上的火焰层数造成额外伤害并恢复等离子体。

original: Release a fireball that explodes in a 3x3 area on contact.
translation: 释放一个火球，在接触时爆炸，影响3x3区域。

original: Unleash a fiery tornado that goes in a straight line which will set fire around it randomly as it goes. Harms marines that directly touch it.
translation: 释放一道直线前进的烈焰龙卷风，行进过程中会随机引燃周围区域。直接接触的陆战队员将受到伤害。

original: After a short cast time, release a burst of fire in a 5x5 radius. All tiles are set on fire. Humans are set on fire and burnt.
translation: 经过短暂施法后，在5x5范围内释放火焰爆发。所有地块将被点燃。人类将被点燃并灼伤。

original: Causes a chosen target's flame to burst outwardly. The severity of the damage is based on how badly they were on fire. In addition, the area adjacent to them is set on fire.
translation: 使选定目标的火焰向外爆发。伤害的严重程度取决于其着火的程度。此外，其相邻区域也会被点燃。

original: A glowing whirlwind of... cold plasma? Seems to \"burn\"
translation: 一团发光的漩涡……冷等离子体？似乎会'灼烧'

original: If you are ontop of fire, you gain 5/10/15 armor in all categories.
translation: 如果你站在火焰上，所有伤害类别获得5/10/15点护甲。

original: Fire Charge deals no damage, does not consume melting fire stacks, and now pierces humans. Humans who are hit get 2/4/6 melting fire stacks.
translation: 火焰冲锋不造成伤害，不消耗熔化火焰层数，现在可穿透人类。被击中的人类获得2/4/6层熔化火焰。

original: Melting fire stacks you inflict causes 15/25/35% healing reduction against brute and burn.
translation: 你施加的熔化火焰层数会造成15/25/35%的钝击和火焰伤害治疗减免。

original: A skittish alien, it burns with fury.
translation: 一只胆怯的异形，它燃烧着怒火。

original: That announcement contained a word prohibited in IC chat! Consider reviewing the server rules.\n\"[input]\"
translation: 该公告包含IC聊天禁用词汇！请查阅服务器规则。\n'[input]'

original: That announcement contained characters prohibited in IC chat! Consider reviewing the server rules.
translation: 该公告包含角色扮演聊天中禁止使用的字符！请查阅服务器规则。

original: We feel our throat muscles vibrate. We are ready to screech again.
translation: 我们感到喉部肌肉在震动。我们准备好再次尖啸了。

original: Our screech will stun and deaf nearby enemies.
translation: 我们的尖啸会击晕并震聋附近的敌人。

original: Our screech will heal nearby allies.
translation: 我们的尖啸会治愈附近的盟友。

original: Our screech will restore plasma of nearby allies.
translation: 我们的尖啸将恢复附近友军的等离子体。

original: Our screech will bolster the damage of nearby allies.
translation: 我们的尖啸将增强附近盟友的伤害。

original: [xeno_owner] has selected us as a Hive Leader. The other Xenomorphs must listen to us. We will also act as a beacon for the Ruler's pheromones.
translation: [xeno_owner] 已选定我们为蜂巢领袖。其他异形必须听从我们的指令。我们也将作为统治者信息素的信标。
\The [xeno_owner] 发出一声震耳欲聋的喉音咆哮！
\The [xeno_owner] 发出一声震耳欲聋的喉音咆哮！
\The [xeno_owner] 发出一声震耳欲聋的喉音咆哮！
\The [xeno_owner] 发出一声震耳欲聋的喉音咆哮！

original: [xeno_owner] emits a broad and weak psychic aura.
translation: [xeno_owner] 散发出一种广泛而微弱的心灵灵光。

original: [xeno_owner] stops emitting its broad and weak psychic aura.
translation: [xeno_owner] 停止了散发其广泛而微弱的心灵灵光。

original: \the [owner] vomits acid over [target], mending their wounds!
translation: \the [owner] 向 [target] 喷吐酸液，治愈了他们的伤口！

original: A faint psychic aura is suddenly emitted from \the [owner]!
translation: 一股微弱的心灵灵光突然从\the [owner]身上散发出来！

original: [target] lightly shimmers in a chill light.

translation: 无法给予等离子体，已死亡
无法给予等离子体，距离太远
无法给予等离子体，已满

original: Announces a message to the hive.
translation: 向蜂巢意志发布一条信息。

original: A large area knockdown that deafens nearby enemies and disorentates them. Stun and stagger amount depends on distance from the target, maximum stun of 1.5 seconds.
translation: 大范围击倒，使附近敌人耳聋并陷入混乱。眩晕和踉跄效果取决于与目标的距离，最大眩晕时间为1.5秒。

original: A large area knockdown that causes pain and screen-shake.
translation: 大范围击倒，造成疼痛和屏幕震动。

original: A beneficial screech that grants health and sunder regeneration to you and nearby allies.
translation: 有益的尖啸，为你和附近的盟友提供生命值和破甲恢复。

original: A beneficial screech that grants plasma regeneration to you and nearby allies.
translation: 一个有益的尖啸，为你和附近的盟友提供等离子体再生。

original: A beneficial screech that grants an increase of 10% melee damage to you and nearby allies.
translation: 有益的尖啸，为你和附近的盟友提供10%的近战伤害加成。

original: See from the target Xenomorphs vision. Click again the ability to stop observing
translation: 从目标异形的视角观察。再次点击能力以停止观察

original: Zoom out for a larger view around wherever you are looking.
translation: 放大以查看您所观察位置周围的更广阔视野。

original: Make a target Xenomorph a leader.
Apply a minor heal to the target.
Give plasma to a target Xenomorph (you must be overwatching them.)
translation: 向目标异形提供等离子体（你必须正在监控它们。）

original: Creates a field of defensive energy, filling gaps in the armor of nearby sisters, making them more resilient.
translation: 生成一片防御性能量场，填补附近姐妹装甲的缝隙，使她们更具韧性。

original: Bulwark no longer grants armor. Bulwark now grants overheal of 60/80/100 for entering the affected area for the first time. This overheal is subtracted when leaving the affected area or when Bulwark ends.
translation: 壁垒不再提供护甲。壁垒现在为首次进入受影响区域的单位提供60/80/100点的过量治疗。当单位离开受影响区域或壁垒效果结束时，此过量治疗将被扣除。

original: Bulwark no longer requires you to channel, but ends when you leave the radius. It grants 50/60/70% of its original armor.
translation: Bulwark no longer requires you to channel, but ends when you leave the radius. It grants 50/60/70% of its original armor.

original: Ozelomelyn Sting is replaced with Neurotoxin Sting. Each interval gives 10/20/30% more chemicals.
translation: Ozelomelyn Sting 已被替换为 Neurotoxin Sting。每个间隔提供 10/20/30% 更多的化学物质。

original: Screech grant all xenomorphs within a 20-tile radius gain -0.3/-0.5/-0.7 speed for 4 seconds.
translation: 尖啸使20格范围内的所有异形获得-0.3/-0.5/-0.7速度，持续4秒。

original: A huge, looming alien creature. The biggest and the baddest.
translation: 一个巨大、若隐若现的外星生物。最大也最凶残。

original: Our exoskeleton quivers as we get ready to use [name] again.
translation: 我们的外骨骼在准备再次使用[name]时微微颤动。

original: We gather enough strength to Ravage again.
translation: 我们积蓄了足够的力量，可以再次发动掠夺。

original: We feel able to imbue ourselves with plasma to Endure once again!
translation: 我们感觉能够再次用等离子体灌注自身以进入坚毅状态！

original: We feel the plasma draining from our veins... [initial(name)] will last for only [timeleft(endure_timer) * 0.1] more seconds!
translation: 我们感到等离子体正从血管中流失……[initial(name)]只能再坚持[timeleft(endure_timer) * 0.1]秒了！

original: The last of the plasma drains from our body... and so does our life...
translation: 最后一点等离子体从我们体内流失……我们的生命也随之消逝……

original: The last of the plasma drains from our body... We can no longer endure beyond our normal limits!
translation: 最后一点等离子体从我们体内流失……我们再也无法超越正常极限了！

original: We are critically wounded! We can only withstand [-(endure_threshold + endure_threshold_bonus - xeno_owner.health)] more damage before we perish!
translation: 我们伤势严重！我们最多只能再承受[-(endure_threshold + endure_threshold_bonus - xeno_owner.health)]点伤害就会死亡！

original: We are able to enter our rage once again.
translation: 我们能够再次进入狂暴状态。

original: Our health isn't low enough to rage! We must take [xeno_owner.health - (xeno_owner.maxHealth * RAVAGER_RAGE_MIN_HEALTH_THRESHOLD)] more damage!
translation: 我们的生命值还不够低，无法进入狂暴状态！我们必须再承受 [xeno_owner.health - (xeno_owner.maxHealth * RAVAGER_RAGE_MIN_HEALTH_THRESHOLD)] 点伤害！

original: Our rage begins to subside... [initial(name)] will only last for only [(RAVAGER_RAGE_DURATION + bonus_duration) * (1-RAVAGER_RAGE_WARNING) * 0.1] more seconds!
translation: 我们的怒火开始消退……[initial(name)]只能再持续[(RAVAGER_RAGE_DURATION + bonus_duration) * (1-RAVAGER_RAGE_WARNING) * 0.1]秒了！

original: You will now[xeno_owner.vampirism ? "" : " no longer"] heal from attacking
translation: 你现在[xeno_owner.vampirism ? "" : " no longer"]通过攻击恢复生命值

original: THE QUEEN MOTHER IS DISPLEASED WITH YOUR PERFORMANCE ([damage_dealt]/[DEATHMARK_DAMAGE_OR_DIE]). DEATH COMES TO TAKE ITS DUE.
translation: 异形女王对您的表现感到不满（[damage_dealt]/[DEATHMARK_DAMAGE_OR_DIE]）。死亡将至，收取其应得之物。

original: THE QUEEN MOTHER IS PLEASED WITH YOUR PERFORMANCE ([damage_dealt]/[DEATHMARK_DAMAGE_OR_DIE]).
translation: 异形女王对您的表现感到满意（[damage_dealt]/[DEATHMARK_DAMAGE_OR_DIE]）。

original: \The [xeno_owner] thrashes about in a murderous frenzy!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 在嗜血的狂暴中猛烈挣扎！

original: \The [xeno_owner] becomes frenzied, bellowing with a shuddering roar!
translation: \The [xeno_owner] 变得狂暴起来，发出一声令人战栗的咆哮！

original: Charge up to 4 tiles and viciously attack your target.
translation: 蓄力冲刺最多4格，对目标发动凶猛的攻击。

original: Attacks and knockbacks enemies in the direction your facing.
translation: 朝你面对的方向攻击并击退敌人。

original: For the next few moments you will not go into crit and become resistant to explosives and immune to stagger and slowdown, but you still die if you take damage exceeding your crit health.
translation: 在接下来的几秒内，你将不会进入濒死状态，并对爆炸伤害产生抗性，同时免疫击退和减速效果，但若受到的伤害超过你的濒死生命值，你仍会死亡。

original: Use while at 50% health or lower to gain extra slash damage, resistances and speed in proportion to your missing hit points. This bonus is increased and you regain plasma while your HP is negative.
translation: 生命值低于或等于50%时使用，根据损失的生命值获得额外斩击伤害、抗性和速度。当生命值为负时，此加成会提升并恢复等离子体。

original: Toggle on to enable boosting on

translation: 生成嗜血状态的被动能力

original: Mark yourself for death, filling your bloodthirst, but failing to deal enough damage to living creatures while it is active instantly kills you.
translation: 标记自己为死亡目标，满足你的嗜血渴望，但若在激活期间未能对活体生物造成足够伤害，你将立即死亡。

original: Endure can be used in critical. It now costs 150/125/100% of its original plasma cost.
translation: 忍耐可在危急时使用。现在消耗原始等离子体成本的150/125/100%。

original: Rage can be activated at 55/60/65% maximum health. For the purposes of calculating rage power, your current health is assumed to reduced by 5/10/15% of your maximum health. This cannot go beyond the amount required for Super Rage.
translation: 狂怒可在生命值降至最大值的55/60/65%时激活。为计算狂怒强度，你的当前生命值将被视为额外减少了最大值的5/10/15%。此效果不会超过触发超级狂怒所需的阈值。

original: Endure further decreases your critical and death threshold by 50/75/100. If Endure ends while your health is under the default death threshold, you die instead.
translation: 坚忍会进一步降低你的临界和死亡阈值50/75/100点。如果坚忍结束时你的生命值低于默认死亡阈值，你将直接死亡。

original: Endure further decreases your critical and death threshold by 30/40/50.
translation: 坚忍进一步将你的临界阈值和死亡阈值降低30/40/50点。

original: Endure lasts 70/80/90% as long, but duration-increasing slashes is now available during normal Rage.
translation: 持续时间缩短至70/80/90%，但普通狂暴状态下现在可延长斩击持续时间。

original: Endure no longer grants stagger immunity nor can be activated while staggered. Endure grants 10/15/20 all soft armor while active.
translation: '坚忍'不再提供踉跄免疫，也无法在踉跄状态下激活。激活时，'坚忍'提供10/15/20点全软护甲。

original: Ravage now has an additional 10/15/20 armor penetration.
translation: 掠夺者现在获得额外的10/15/20点护甲穿透。

original: Ravage now slashes in all directions, but has a cast time of 0.6/0.4/0.2 seconds.
translation: 掠夺者现在会向所有方向进行斩击，但有0.6/0.4/0.2秒的施放时间。

original: Eviscerating Charge's cooldown duration is set to 20/15/10% of its original value, but it no longer stuns.
translation: 内脏撕裂冲锋的冷却时间缩短至原值的20/15/10%，但不再造成眩晕。

original: Rage will automatically attempt to activate when your health reaches the minimum required threshold. Rage's cooldown duration is set to 60/50/40% of its original value.
translation: 当你的生命值降至最低要求阈值时，狂怒将自动尝试激活。狂怒的冷却时间缩短至原始值的60/50/40%。

original: You lose 70 fire armor. The plasma gain from stepping into fire is now also given for being on fire. This plasma gain is increased by 200/250/300.
translation: 你失去了70点火焰护甲。踏入火焰获得的等离子体现在也会在着火时获得。该等离子体获取量增加了200/250/300点。

original: Endure now costs health to activate, but will consume plasma first. This damage is non-lethal. Endure's cooldown duration is set to 70/60/50% of its original value.
translation: 激活坚忍现在会消耗生命值，但会优先消耗等离子体。此伤害为非致命伤害。坚忍的冷却时间调整为原值的70/60/50%。

original: The heat of the fire roars in our veins! KILL! CHARGE! DESTROY!
translation: 火焰的热量在我们血管中咆哮！杀！冲锋！毁灭！

original: A huge, nasty red alien with enormous scythed claws.
translation: 一个巨大、丑陋的红色异形，长着巨大的镰刀状爪子。

original: We take evasive action, making us impossible to hit.
translation: 我们采取规避动作，使其无法命中。

original: The searing fire compromises our ability to dodge![RUNNER_EVASION_COOLDOWN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD - evasion_stacks > 0 ? " We must dodge [RUNNER_EVASION_COOLDOWN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD - evasion_stacks] more projectile damage before Evasion's cooldown refreshes." : ""]
translation: 灼热的火焰削弱了我们的闪避能力！[RUNNER_EVASION_COOLDOWN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD - evasion_stacks > 0 ? " We must dodge [RUNNER_EVASION_COOLDOWN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD - evasion_stacks] more projectile damage before Evasion's cooldown refreshes." : ""]
野蛮冲撞冷却中（[COOLDOWN_TIMELEFT(src, savage_cooldown) * 0.1]秒）
等离子体不足，无法发动野蛮攻击（[savage_cost]）

original: Leap at a target up to [pounce_range] tiles away, stunning them for [XENO_POUNCE_STUN_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)] seconds. Alternate use toggles Savage off or on. When on, do an additional slash when pouncing.
translation: 向最远[pounce_range]格外的目标发动猛扑，使其眩晕[XENO_POUNCE_STUN_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)]秒。切换使用可开启或关闭野蛮模式。开启时，猛扑会额外造成一次斩击。

original: Take an item equipped by your target in your mouth, and carry it away.
translation: 将目标装备的物品叼在嘴里，并带走。

original: Cover an object with acid to slowly melt it. Takes less time than usual.
translation: 用酸液覆盖物体以缓慢熔化它。耗时比通常更短。

original: Instantly dash for [charge_range] tiles, tackling the first marine in your path. If you manage to tackle someone, gain another cast of the ability.
translation: 立即向[charge_range]格冲刺，扑摔路径上的第一名陆战队员。若成功扑摔目标，则获得一次额外施放机会。

original: Creates see-through acid smoke below yourself.
translation: 在自身下方生成透明的酸液烟雾。

original: Slowly build up acid in preparation to launch yourself as an acidic missile. Can launch yourself early if desired. Will slow you down initially, but will ramp up speed at maximum acid of 5x5.
translation: 缓慢积聚酸液，准备将自己发射为一枚酸性导弹。若需要，可提前发射。初始会减慢你的速度，但在达到最大酸液量5x5时速度将急剧提升。

original: Upon entering critical, release stunning acid in a radius of 2/3/4 tiles. This resets upon reaching full health.
translation: 进入濒危状态时，在2/3/4格范围内释放眩晕酸液。此效果在生命值回满时重置。

original: All of your stash damage is burn damage and is now checked against acid. You inflict 1/2/3 additional melting acid stacks.
translation: 你的所有储存伤害均为燃烧伤害，现在会检查酸液抗性。你额外施加1/2/3层熔化酸液效果。

original: Corrosive Acid is now applied 50/75/100% faster.
translation: 腐蚀酸液现在应用速度加快50/75/100%。

original: Evasion is now 1/2/3 seconds longer, but no longer can auto-refresh.
translation: 闪避冷却时间延长至1/2/3秒，但不再能自动刷新。

original: Your critical threshold is decreased by 100. While you have negative health, you are slowed, staggered and cannot slash attack. If you have negative health for more than 2/3/4s, your critical threshold is increased back until you reach full health.
translation: 你的重伤阈值降低100点。当生命值为负时，你会减速、踉跄且无法进行斩击攻击。若生命值持续为负超过2/3/4秒，你的重伤阈值将逐渐恢复，直至生命值回满。

original: You lose the ability, Evasion. You have a 30/40/50% to dodge projectiles with similar conditions as Evasion. Highly accurate projectiles will reduce your dodge chance.
translation: 你失去了能力：闪避。你有30/40/50%的几率闪避弹道攻击，条件与闪避类似。高精度弹道攻击会降低你的闪避几率。

original: Pounce will slash your target for 1/1.25/1.5x damage if it was started in dim light.
translation: 猛扑若在昏暗光线下发动，将对目标造成1/1.25/1.5倍斩击伤害。

original: Pounce will slash your target for 0.5/0.75/1x slash damage based on the distance traveled. Every tile beyond the first reduces the amount by 20%.
translation: 猛扑会根据移动距离对目标造成0.5/0.75/1倍斩击伤害。每超出第一格距离，伤害减少20%。

original: Savage's plasma-to-damage conversion rate is increased by 0.05/0.1/0.15. Savage will consume all of your plasma.
translation: 蛮牛的等离子体伤害转化率提升0.05/0.1/0.15。蛮牛会消耗你所有的等离子体。

original: Pounce stuns only for 25% as long. It now confuses and blurs your target's vision for 1/2/3 seconds.
translation: 猛扑的眩晕时间缩短至25%。现在会使目标视线模糊和混乱1/2/3秒。

original: Savage's damage is converted to a buff that increases your melee damage for 7 seconds. For each point of damage, your melee damage multiplier is increased by 0.5/0.75/1%.
translation: 蛮牛的伤害会转化为增益效果，在7秒内提升你的近战伤害。每点伤害会使你的近战伤害倍率增加0.5/0.75/1%。

original: While Evasion is on, moving onto the same location as a standing human will confuse them for 2/3/4 seconds. This can only happens once per human.
translation: 开启闪避时，移动到站立人类所在位置会使其迷惑2/3/4秒。每名人类仅会受此效果影响一次。
无法在闪避时进行斩击

original: This runner isn't wearing a saddle!
A small red alien that looks like it could run fairly quickly...
translation: 一只体型小巧的红色异形，看起来能跑得相当快……

original: An eerie, four-legged alien with a hollow tail. A green, jelly-like texture characterizes its eyes and underbelly.
translation: 一只诡异的四足外星生物，长着中空的尾巴。它的眼睛和下腹部呈现出一种绿色的胶状质感。

original: [owner] vomits up a bulbous lump and throws it at [A]!
Spit a toxin at your target up to 7 tiles away, inflicting the Intoxicated debuff and dealing damage over time.
translation: 向7格内的目标喷射毒素，施加中毒减益并造成持续伤害。

original: Imbue your claws with acid for a short duration, inflicting lasting effects on your victims.
translation: 将酸液注入你的利爪，短时间内对受害者造成持续效果。

original: Sting your victim, draining them and gaining benefits if they are Intoxicated.
translation: 刺击你的受害者，吸取其生命，若其处于中毒状态，你将获得增益效果。

original: Throws a lump of compressed acidic gases, which will inflict damage over time and Intoxicate victims.
translation: 投掷一团压缩酸性气体，会造成持续伤害并使受害者中毒。

original: A fleshy mass that bounces along the ground. It seems to be heating up.
translation: 一团在地面上弹跳的肉块。它似乎在升温。

original: Throws a lump of compressed neurotoxin, which explodes into a small gas cloud.
translation: 投掷一团压缩神经毒素，爆炸形成小型毒气云。

original: A fleshy mass that bounces along the ground. It seems to be heating up.
translation: 一团在地面上弹跳的肉块。它似乎在升温。

original: Everytime you take damage, you emit non-opaque light neurotoxin gas with a radius of 2. This can happen once every 8/6/4 seconds.
translation: 每次受到伤害时，你都会释放半径为2的非不透明神经毒素气体。该效果每8/6/4秒可触发一次。

original: You gain an ability that makes your slashes inject 6/7/8u Neurotoxin for the next 3 slashes. You no longer have the ability Neurotoxin Sting.
translation: 你获得一项能力，使你的下3次斩击注入6/7/8单位神经毒素。你不再拥有神经毒素刺击能力。

original: Neurotoxin Sting injects 25% as much neurotoxin. It creates non-opaque light neurotoxin gas spreading out up to 2/3/4 tiles on use.
translation: 神经毒素刺击注入的神经毒素量减少25%。使用时会产生不透明的轻型神经毒素气体，扩散范围可达2/3/4格。

original: Toxic Slash will cause humans to passively heal you for 1/1.5/2 health per stack of Intoxicated as long you are adjacent to them.
translation: 剧毒斩击会使人类在中毒状态下，只要与你相邻，就会每层中毒状态为你被动恢复1/1.5/2点生命值。

original: Drain Sting now heals 150/175/200% of its original value. Any leftover healing is converted to overheal health.
translation: 汲取毒刺现在治疗其原始值的150/175/200%。任何剩余的治疗量将转化为过量生命值。

original: Drain Sting always triggers Drain Surge. Drain Surge only gives 1/1.25/1.5 soft armor for each Intoxicated stack.
translation: 汲取之刺必定触发汲取涌动。汲取涌动每层醉酒状态仅提供1/1.25/1.5点软护甲。

original: Your attack delay will be 0.05/0.1/0.15s faster and will always apply 1/2/3 stacks of Intoxicated against humans, but all melee damage is reduced by 50%.
translation: 你的攻击延迟将加快0.05/0.1/0.15秒，并且对人类的攻击总会施加1/2/3层中毒效果，但所有近战伤害降低50%。

original: Drain Sting can be used at targets 1 additional tile away. If the target is at maximum range, Drain Sting is 50/75/100% effective.
translation: 汲取毒刺可在额外1格距离内使用。若目标处于最大射程，汲取毒刺的效果为50/75/100%。

original: Drain Surge's armor is converted to a melee damage modifier. The melee damage modifier is further increased by 0/15/30%.
translation: 汲取涌流的护甲值转化为近战伤害修正。近战伤害修正额外提升0/15/30%。

original: Every 5/4/3u of xeno-chemicals in your target will count as one stack of Intoxicated when calculating the the strength of your Drain Sting.
translation: 目标体内每含有5/4/3单位的异形化学物质，在计算你的汲取毒刺强度时，将计为一层中毒效果。

original: Every 80/60/40 damage you take, 1 stacks of Intoxicated will be applied to nearby humans.
translation: 每受到80/60/40点伤害，你将对附近的人类施加1层中毒效果。

original: Drain Sting starts at 3/5/7 Intoxication stacks. It is automatically used against slashed humans if there are 12 Intoxication stacks or more.
translation: 汲取之刺从3/5/7层中毒效果开始生效。如果中毒层数达到12层或以上，将对被斩击的人类自动使用。

original: A slithery, spitting kind of alien.
translation: 一种滑溜、会喷射的异形。

original: Burrowed larva? What a strange concept... It's not for our hive.
translation: 埋藏的幼虫？真是个奇怪的概念……这不适合我们的蜂巢。

original: Our hive currently has no burrowed to call forth!
translation: 我们的蜂巢目前没有可召唤的潜藏者！

original: We gather enough mental strength to fling something again.
translation: 我们积蓄了足够的精神力量，可以再次甩投物体。

original: We must get closer to fling, our mind cannot reach this far.
translation: 我们必须靠近才能甩投，我们的意志无法触及这么远。

original: Our mind is ready to unleash another blast of force.
translation: 我们的意志已准备好释放另一波力量冲击。

original: We gather enough mental strength to cure sisters again.
translation: 我们已积蓄足够的精神力量，再次治愈姐妹们。

original: It's too late. This sister won't be coming back.
translation: 太迟了。这位姐妹回不来了。

original: Too far for our reach... We need to be [dist - heal_range] steps closer!
translation: 距离太远，无法触及……我们需要再靠近 [dist - heal_range] 步！

original: We can't focus properly without a clear line of sight!
translation: 没有清晰的视线，我们无法有效瞄准！

original: We can only shape on weeds. We must find some resin before we start building!
translation: 我们只能在菌毯上建造。必须先找到一些树脂才能开始建造！

original: We place an acid well; it can be filled with more acid.
translation: 我们放置一个酸液井；它可以容纳更多酸液。

original: Our mind is ready to unleash another chaotic vortex of energy.
translation: 我们的意志已准备好释放另一股混乱的能量涡流。

original: A strange buzzing hum starts to emanate from \the [xeno_owner]!
translation: 一阵奇怪的嗡嗡声开始从\the [xeno_owner]身上散发出来！

original: A strange and violent psychic aura is suddenly emitted from \the [xeno_owner]!
translation: 一股陌生而暴戾的心灵灵能突然从\the [xeno_owner]身上散发出来！

original: [movable_target] is violently flung away by an unseen force!
translation: [movable_target]被一股无形的力量猛烈地甩飞出去！

original: [owner] sends out a huge blast of psychic energy!
translation: [owner]释放出一股巨大的心灵能量冲击！

original: A strange psychic aura is suddenly emitted from \the [owner]!
translation: 一股诡异的灵能光环突然从\the [owner]身上散发出来！

original: [target] suddenly shimmers in a chill light.
A strange and violent psychic aura is suddenly emitted from \the [xeno_owner]!
translation: 一股陌生而暴戾的心灵灵压突然从\the [xeno_owner]身上散发出来！

original: [choked_human] is suddenly grabbed by the neck by an unseen force!
translation: [choked_human] 的脖子突然被一股看不见的力量扼住了！

original: Attempts to summon all currently burrowed larva.
translation: 尝试召唤所有当前潜伏的幼虫。

original: Sends an enemy or an item flying [SHRIKE_FLING_DISTANCE] tiles away. A [SHRIKE_FLING_RANGE] tile ranged ability. Stuns for [stun_duration / (1 SECONDS)] seconds.
translation: 将敌人或物品甩出[SHRIKE_FLING_DISTANCE]格远。这是一个[SHRIKE_FLING_RANGE]格射程的技能。造成[stun_duration / (1 SECONDS)]秒的眩晕。

original: Unleashes our raw psychic power, pushing aside anyone who stands in our path for [throwing_distance] tiles. Stuns for [SHRIKE_PARALYZE_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)] seconds.
translation: 释放我们原始的心灵力量，将挡在路上的任何人推开[throwing_distance]格。造成[SHRIKE_PARALYZE_DURATION / (1 SECONDS)]秒的眩晕。

original: Heal and remove debuffs from a target.
translation: 治疗目标并移除其负面状态。

original: Place an acid well that can put out fires.
translation: 放置一个能扑灭火焰的酸液池。

original: After a [VORTEX_INITIAL_CHARGE / (1 SECONDS)] second windup, channel a sizable vortex of psychic energy, drawing in any items and enemies [VORTEX_RANGE] tiles away.
translation: 经过[VORTEX_INITIAL_CHARGE / (1 SECONDS)]秒的准备后，引导一股强大的心灵能量漩涡，将[VORTEX_RANGE]格范围内的所有物品和敌人吸入其中。

original: Channel at a distance to hold a human in your psychic grasp.
translation: 远距离施放念力，将人类牢牢控制在你的精神掌控之中。

original: Psychic Cure can now target yourself. Healing yourself is only 50/60/70% as effective.
translation: 心灵治愈现在可以以自身为目标。治疗自身的效果只有50/60/70%。

original: 20/35/50% of the health restored from Psychic Cure is reapplied to you.
translation: 20/35/50% 的'心灵治愈'所恢复的生命值会重新施加于你自身。

original: Psychic Cure now also applies the effects of resin jelly to you and your target for 40/50/60 seconds.
translation: 心灵治愈现在还会为你和你的目标施加树脂凝胶的效果，持续40/50/60秒。

original: Psychic Fling deals 150/175/200% damage equal to your melee damage, enables collusions, but no longer immediately stuns. If the target collides with a human, object, or wall: both are briefly paralyzed and dealt damage again.
translation: 心灵甩投造成相当于你近战伤害的150/175/200%伤害，可引发碰撞，但不再立即击晕。如果目标与人类、物体或墙壁碰撞：双方都会被短暂麻痹并再次受到伤害。

original: Unrelenting Force pulls things towards you then pushes them away. The distance they are thrown is increased by 2/3/4.
translation: 不灭之力将物体拉向你，然后将其推开。投掷距离增加2/3/4。

original: Psychic Fling can be used on yourself and allied xenomorphs. Humans who are hit by a flung xenomorph are paralyzed for 2 seconds and dealt 150/175/200% of your slash damage.
translation: 心灵甩投可对自身和友方异形使用。被甩投异形击中的人类将麻痹2秒，并受到相当于你斩击伤害150/175/200%的伤害。

original: Psychic Heal grants slowdown immunity and delays all inbound stun, knockdown, and stagger effects caused to your target by 8/10/12 seconds. At the end of this duration, delayed status effects are reapplied.
translation: 心灵治愈赋予目标减速免疫，并延迟所有对其造成的击晕、击倒和踉跄效果8/10/12秒。延迟结束后，状态效果将重新施加。

original: Unrelenting Force now reflects all projectiles in its affected area. Reflecting more than 50 projectile damage resets Psychic Scream's cooldown to 50/40/30% of its original value.
translation: 不屈之力现在会反弹其影响区域内的所有抛射物。反弹超过50点抛射物伤害时，会将心灵尖啸的冷却时间重置为原始值的50/40/30%。

original: You lose the ability Psychic Fling in exchange for the ability Psychic Choke. Psychic Choke lets you paralyze a marine as long you channel it. The damage threshold to disrupt Psychic Choke is 20/35/50.
translation: 你失去了心灵甩投能力，换来了心灵扼喉能力。心灵扼喉能让你在持续引导时麻痹一名陆战队员。打断心灵扼喉的伤害阈值为20/35/50。

original: A large, lanky alien creature. It seems psychically unstable.
translation: 一个高大、瘦长的外星生物。它看起来精神不稳定。

original: A widow spawn, it chitters angrily without any sense of self-preservation, only to obey the widow's will.
translation: 一只黑寡妇幼体，它愤怒地嘶叫着，毫无自我保全的意识，只为遵从黑寡妇的意志。

original: Our dermal pouches bloat with fresh acid; we can use acid spray again.
translation: 我们的皮肤附包充满了新鲜酸液；我们可以再次使用酸液喷射了。

original: Our auxiliary sacks fill to bursting; we can use scatter spit again.
translation: 我们的副囊已充盈欲裂；可以再次使用散射吐息了。
\The [owner] 朝 \the [target] 扔出了什么东西！

original: Spray a line of dangerous acid at your target up to [acid_spray_distance + 1] tiles away.
translation: 向你的目标喷射一道危险的酸液，最远可达[acid_spray_distance + 1]格。

original: Spits a spread of acid projectiles that splatter on the ground.
translation: 喷射一片酸液弹，在地面上溅射开来。

original: Toss a biological grenade at your target. Has various effects depending on selection, right click to select which grenade to use. Stores up to 6 uses.
translation: 向你的目标投掷一枚生化手雷。根据选择产生不同效果，右键点击选择要使用的手雷类型。最多可储存6次使用次数。

original: A gross looking glob of acid
A swirling mix of lime and grape sparks
translation: 一团青柠与葡萄色的火花旋涡

original: A rapidly melting ball of xeno taffy
translation: 一团正在快速熔化的异形太妃糖

original: A shimmering orb of gelatin that glows with life.
translation: 一团闪烁着生命光芒的凝胶状球体。

original: Place an mine at your location. Its effects depend on your selected grenade
translation: 在当前位置放置一枚地雷。其效果取决于你选择的手雷类型。

original: Place an gas mine at your location
translation: 在你所在位置放置一枚气体地雷

original: Fire an acid rocket, costing 30% of your current health and plasma, and dealing heavy damage where you aim it.
translation: 发射一枚酸液火箭，消耗你当前生命值和等离子体的30%，并对瞄准区域造成重创。

original: Toss Grenade can target yourself. Targeting yourself will toss the grenade under you and reduce the detonation time by 0.5/0.75/1 seconds. The resulting detonation time can never go under 0.5 seconds.
translation: 投掷手雷可以以自身为目标。以自身为目标会将手雷投掷到脚下，并使引爆时间减少0.5/0.75/1秒。最终的引爆时间永远不会低于0.5秒。

original: Toss Grenade will deal damage equal to 20/17.5/15% of your maximum health and allow you to throw a non-healing grenade if you had none.
translation: 投掷手雷将造成相当于你最大生命值20/17.5/15%的伤害，并且如果你没有非治疗手雷，将允许你投掷一枚。

original: Toss Grenade stores 1/2/3 less grenades, but recharges a grenade 2/4/6 seconds faster.
translation: 投掷手雷减少1/2/3颗手雷携带量，但手雷充能速度加快2/4/6秒。

original: If you are on fire, consume 20/15/10 plasma to extinguish yourself and any fire under you. This only can occur every 1 second.
translation: 如果你身上着火，消耗20/15/10等离子体来扑灭你自身以及你下方的火焰。此操作每1秒只能进行一次。

original: Scatter Spit's cast time is 60/40/20% of its original amount. It no longer deals bonus damage.
translation: 散射唾液的施法时间是原来的60/40/20%。它不再造成额外伤害。

original: Slashing humans will reduce their fire stacks by 1/2/3.
translation: 斩击人类将减少其火焰层数1/2/3点。

original: A gross, oozing alien of some kind.
translation: 某种令人作呕、渗出粘液的外星生物。

original: A disformed spitter. Carries some form of acid on its back
translation: 一只畸形的喷射者。其背部携带着某种酸液。

original: [owner] sends out a huge blast of psychic energy!
translation: [owner] 释放出一股巨大的心灵能量冲击！
\The [owner] 开始汇聚他们的心灵之力！
还需要 [crush_cost - xeno_owner.plasma_stored] 点等离子体！
还需要 [selected_ammo.ability_cost - xeno_owner.plasma_stored] 点等离子体！
我们的注意力被打乱了

original: Channel a psychic shield at your current location that can reflect most projectiles, the shield can only hold so much though... Activate again while active to detonate the shield forcibly, producing knockback. Must remain stationary to use.
translation: 在你当前位置构筑一道心灵护盾，能够反射大多数投射物，但护盾的承受能力有限……激活状态下再次使用可强制引爆护盾，产生击退效果。使用时必须保持静止。

original: Channel an expanding AOE crush effect, activating it again pre-maturely crushes enemies over an area. The longer it is channeled, the larger area it will affect, but will consume more plasma.
translation: 引导一个不断扩大的范围性碾压效果，再次提前激活会在区域内碾压敌人。引导时间越长，影响范围越大，但会消耗更多等离子体。

original: Launch a blast of psychic energy that deals light damage and knocks back enemies in its AOE. Must remain stationary for a few seconds to use.
translation: 发射一道心灵能量冲击，对范围内的敌人造成轻微伤害并击退。使用时必须保持静止数秒。

original: Launch a blast of psychic energy that deals light burn damage and staggers in an area. Direct hits deal additional light brute damage.
translation: 发射一道心灵能量冲击，对区域内目标造成轻度灼烧伤害并使其踉跄。直接命中还会造成额外的轻度钝击伤害。

original: Launch a blast of psychic energy that deals high brute damage with high armor penetration. This can hit multiple mobs and goes through structures.
translation: 发射一道心灵能量冲击，造成高额钝击伤害并具有高护甲穿透。可击中多个目标并穿透结构。

original: Launch a blast of psychic energy that deals light stamina damage, staggers, and knockbacks in a smaller area. Direct hits deal additional light stamina damage and briefly knockdowns.
translation: 发射一道心灵能量冲击波，在小范围内造成轻微耐力伤害、踉跄和击退效果。直接命中会额外造成轻微耐力伤害并短暂击倒目标。

original: Psychic Shield will attempt to detonate if it was automatically canceled while the shield is intact. The detonation cost is now 125/100/75% of its original cost.
translation: 心灵护盾若在护盾完好时被自动取消，将尝试引爆。引爆消耗现为其原始消耗的125/100/75%。

original: Psychic Blast now switch to a different type of beam called Psychic Drain; it deals 0.7x stamina damage, briefly knockdowns on direct impact, and knockback on non-direct impact. Psychic Drain's cooldown is 95/90/85% of its original cooldown.
translation: 心灵冲击现在切换为一种名为心灵汲取的新型光束；它造成0.7倍耐力伤害，直接命中时造成短暂击倒，非直接命中时造成击退。心灵汲取的冷却时间是原冷却时间的95/90/85%。

original: Psychic Shield no longer forces you to remain still to keep the shield up. However, the shield sizzles out when manually detonating and slows you down by 0.8/0.6/0.4 while it is active.
translation: 心灵护盾不再要求你保持静止来维持护盾。然而，手动引爆时护盾会嘶嘶作响地消散，并且在护盾激活期间会使你的速度降低0.8/0.6/0.4。

original: A large, physically frail creature. It hovers in the air and seems to buzz with psychic power.
translation: 一个体型庞大、身体脆弱的生物。它悬浮在空中，周身似乎萦绕着心灵能量的嗡鸣。

original: You can be empowered by a primordial drone link.
translation: 你可以通过原始形态工蜂链接获得强化。

original: Move on all fours and loosen our scales. Increases movement speed by [abs(speed_modifier)], but reduces all soft armor by [armor_modifier]. Automatically disabled after using an ability.
translation: 四肢着地移动，放松鳞片。移动速度提升[abs(speed_modifier)]，但所有软质护甲降低[armor_modifier]。使用能力后自动关闭。

original: Lunge towards a target within [starting_lunge_distance] tiles, putting them in our grasp. Usable on allies and targets directly behind cover.
translation: 向 [starting_lunge_distance] 格范围内的目标发起突刺，将其擒入掌控。可用于友军和直接处于掩体后的目标。

original: Send a target flying up to [starting_fling_distance] tiles away. Distance reduced for bigger targets. Usable on allies.
translation: 将目标甩投至最多 [starting_fling_distance] 格远。对体型较大的目标距离会缩短。可对友方使用。

original: Throw a creature under our grasp up to [starting_toss_distance] tiles away. Distance reduced on larger targets. Usable on allies.
translation: 将我们掌控下的生物抛掷至最多 [starting_toss_distance] 格远。目标体型越大，抛掷距离越短。可对友方单位使用。

original: Strike a target, inflicting stamina damage, stagger and slowdown. Deals double damage, stagger and slowdown to grappled targets. Deals quadruple damage to structures and machinery.
translation: 攻击目标，造成耐力伤害、踉跄和减速。对被擒抱目标造成双倍伤害、踉跄和减速。对结构和机械造成四倍伤害。

original: Strike at your target with blinding speed. Dealing less damage but blinding your target.
translation: 以迅雷不及掩耳之势攻击你的目标。造成较少伤害但会使目标致盲。

original: Agility gives an additional 0.3/0.6/0.9 more speed, but decreases your armor by an additional 10/20/30.
translation: 敏捷额外提供0.3/0.6/0.9点速度，但会额外降低10/20/30点护甲。

original: Lunge can be activated from 1/2/3 additional tiles away. Fling and Grapple Toss can now sends your target 1/2/3 tiles further.
translation: 突刺可以从额外1/2/3格的距离激活。甩投和擒抱投掷现在能将目标击退1/2/3格。

original: Fling and Grapple Toss's cooldown is set to 40/25/10% of its original cooldown if it was used on allies.
translation: 甩投和擒抱投掷的冷却时间若用于盟友，则设定为原始冷却时间的40/25/10%。

original: A beefy, alien with an armored carapace.
translation: 一个肌肉发达、身披甲壳的外星生物。

original: We start burrowing into the ground...
We are now burrowed, hidden in plain sight and ready to strike.
translation: 我们现已潜伏，藏于无形，随时准备出击。

original: \The [xeno_attacker] starts to pull in the leashes from \the [src]!
translation: \The [xeno_attacker] 开始从 \the [src] 身上收回牵引索！
\The [xeno_attacker] 从 \the [src] 身上扯下了所有的牵引索！
\The [xeno_attacker] 从 \the [src] 身上扯下了所有的牵引索！
没有可攻击目标，已取消

original: Spit a web to your target, this causes different effects depending on where you hit. Spitting the head causes the target to be temporarily blind, body and arms will cause the target to be weakened, and legs will snare the target for a brief while.
translation: 向你的目标喷射蛛网，根据命中部位产生不同效果。命中头部会使目标暂时失明，命中躯干和手臂会使目标虚弱，命中腿部会使目标短暂被困。

original: Spit a huge web ball that snares groups of targets for a brief while.
translation: 喷射一个巨大的蛛网球，短暂地困住一群目标。

original: Sticky and icky. Destroy it when you are stuck!
translation: 黏糊糊的，真恶心。被粘住就赶紧破坏掉！

original: Our carapace crackles and our tendons strengthen. We are ready to evolve!
translation: 我们的甲壳噼啪作响，肌腱愈发强韧。我们已准备好进化！

original: We decide not to drop [F] after all.
Our pheromones wane. The Ruler is no longer granting us her pheromones.
translation: 我们的信息素正在减弱。统治者不再向我们提供她的信息素。

original: Our pheromones have changed. The Ruler has new plans for the Hive.
translation: 我们的信息素已经改变。统治者对蜂巢有了新的计划。

original: You have [(xeno_flags & XENO_MOBHUD) ? "enabled" : "disabled"] the Xeno Status HUD.

translation: 你感到一阵轻微的刺痛。

original: Our stinger injects our victim with [initial(toxin.name)]!
translation: 我们的毒刺向受害者注入了[initial(toxin.name)]！

original: [L] is restrained, you cannot push past.
translation: [L] 被束缚住了，你无法挤过去。

original: [L] is restraining [P], you cannot push past.
translation: [L] 正在压制 [P]，你无法挤过去。

original: That mob has already been taken.
You are jobbanned from that role.
[rider ? src : "You"] can't do that right now!
You can't see through the floor [direction == DOWN ? "below" : "above"] you.
translation: 你看不到脚下的地板[direction == DOWN ? "below" : "above"]。

original: [src] struggles to break free of [pulledby]'s grip!
[src] makes a hard landing on [impacted_turf] but remains unharmed from the fall[graceful_landing ? " and stays on [p_their()] feet" : " by tucking in rolling into the landing"].
translation: [src]在[impacted_turf]上强行着陆，但[graceful_landing ? " and stays on [p_their()] feet" : " by tucking in rolling into the landing"]从坠落中毫发无伤。

original: [src] makes a hard landing on [impacted_turf], but lands safely on [p_their()] feet!
translation: [src]在[impacted_turf]上重重着陆，但稳稳地站在了[p_their()]脚上！

original: [src] makes a hard landing on [impacted_turf], landing on [p_their()] feet painfully!
translation: [src]重重地摔在[impacted_turf]上，痛苦地用[p_their()]脚着地！

original: You are on fire! Use Resist to put yourself out!
translation: 你着火了！使用抵抗来扑灭火焰！

original: You are untouched by the flames.
It feels as if you've been dumped into an open fire!
translation: 感觉就像被扔进了火堆里！

original: Your skin feels like it is melting away!
translation: 你的皮肤感觉像在融化！

original: Your body tingles as you suddenly feel the strength drain from your body!
translation: 你的身体一阵刺痛，突然感到力量从体内流失！

original: [src] rolls in the snow, putting themselves out!
translation: [src]在雪地里打滚，扑灭了身上的火！

original: [src] rolls on the floor, trying to put themselves out!
translation: [src]在地上打滚，试图扑灭身上的火焰！
[src] 成功扑灭了身上的火焰！

original: [src] is thrown violently into [smashed_plating], smashing through it and punching straight through!
translation: [src]被猛烈地抛入[smashed_plating]，将其砸穿并径直冲了过去！

original: [src] is thrown violently into [lattice], smashing through it and punching straight through!
translation: [src]被猛烈地抛向[lattice]，将其撞得粉碎并径直穿透！

original: \The [src] slumps to the ground, too weak to continue fighting.
translation: \The [src]瘫倒在地，虚弱得无法继续战斗。

original: You've been healed due to the recent friendly fire
translation: 你因最近的友军火力而得到治疗

original: You can't resist in your current state.
translation: 你目前的状态无法抵抗。

original: That message contained a word prohibited in IC chat! Consider reviewing the server rules.
translation: 该消息包含IC聊天中禁止使用的词语！请查阅服务器规则。

original: You find yourself unable to speak!

translation: 你无法在游戏内发言（已禁言）。

original: You are banned from IC chat.
translation: 你被禁止使用角色内聊天。

translation: 目标不在空间站任何活动摄像头的监控范围内。

original: NOTICE: Connection closed with linked mortar.
translation: 注意：与链接迫击炮的连接已断开。

original: Something is already controlling this vehicle
translation: 已有其他单位正在控制此载具

original: You cannot give orders in your current state.
translation: 你当前状态无法下达命令。

original: Your last order was too recent.
translation: 你的上一个命令间隔太短。

original: That message contained a word prohibited in IC chat! Consider reviewing the server rules.\n\"[text]\"
translation: 该消息包含IC聊天中禁止使用的词汇！请查阅服务器规则。\n'[text]'

original: You must wait before issuing an alert again
translation: 请等待一段时间后再发布警报

original: You issue an alert for [A.name] to all living personnel.
translation: 你向所有存活人员发布了关于[A.name]的警报。

original: AI telemetry indicates that the [pingedacid.acid_t] which is [newdistance] units away at: [AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)] is being melted! by [pingedacid.name]!
translation: AI遥测显示，[pingedacid.acid_t]正在被熔化！位于[newdistance]单位外：[AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)]，由[pingedacid.name]造成！

original: ALERT! The ship AI has detected Hostile/Unknown: [A.name] at: [AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)].
translation: 警报！舰船AI侦测到敌对/未知目标：[A.name]位于：[AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)]。

original: AI telemetry indicates that [A.name] is [newdistance] units away to the [generaldirection].
translation: AI遥测数据显示[A.name]位于[generaldirection]方向[newdistance]单位处。

original: ALERT! The ship AI has detected Hostile/Unknown: [A.name] at: [AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)].
translation: 警报！舰船AI侦测到敌对/未知目标：[A.name]位于：[AREACOORD_NO_Z(A)]。
近距空中支援激光已探测。目标：[AREACOORD_NO_Z(incoming_laser)]

original: Electronic corruption detected at [A]! Controls overridden!
translation: 电子系统在[A]处检测到异常！控制权限已被覆盖！

original: Telemetry from our mini dropship reports that the controls have become nonfunctional!
translation: 我们的小型运输机传回的遥测数据显示，控制系统已失效！

original: A new disk has been generated at [A]!
The nuclear bomb at [A] has been activated!
A fresh clone has awoken at [A]!
translation: 一个新的克隆体已在[A]苏醒！
未找到合适记录。中止操作。

translation: 请等待一段时间后再进行广播。
正在访问内部无线电设置。

original: Automatic announcements [chan == "None" ? "will not use the radio." : "set to [chan]."]
translation: 自动广播 [chan == "None" ? "will not use the radio." : "set to [chan]."]

original: ERROR: Eyeobj not found. Creating new eye...
translation: 错误：眼体对象未找到。正在创建新眼体...

original: This action is currently disabled. Contact an administrator to enable this feature.
translation: 此功能当前已禁用。请联系管理员以启用此功能。

original: Cannot place more than [max_multicams] multicamera windows.
translation: 无法放置超过[max_multicams]个多摄像头窗口。
已添加新的多摄像头窗口。

original: This action is currently disabled. Contact an administrator to enable this feature.
translation: 此功能当前已禁用。请联系管理员以启用此功能。

original: This function is not available at this time.

translation: 多摄像头观察模式已激活。
多摄像头查看模式已停用。
你的无线电发射器已离线！

original: Wireless interface disabled, unable to interact with announcement PA.
translation: 无线接口已禁用，无法与公告广播系统交互。

original: These words are not available on the announcement system: [english_list(incorrect_words)].
translation: 这些词语在公告系统中不可用：[english_list(incorrect_words)]。

original: The armoured plating is too tough.
[user] punches [src], but doesn't leave a dent.
translation: [user] 击打了 [src]，但连个凹痕都没留下。

original: The product of alien DNA and bored geneticists.
translation: 外星DNA与无聊遗传学家的产物。

original: A caracal with very floppy ears. Its mere presence inspires fear.
translation: 一只耳朵非常松软的狞猫。它的存在本身就令人恐惧。

original: Requisition's very own caracal. You wonder how much requisition paid to get this dogdang creature on board.
translation: 补给部的专属狞猫。你很好奇补给部花了多少钱才把这该死的生物弄上船。

original: Requisition's 2nd caracal. And this one's female? What the hell is going on? Who's paying for this?
translation: 补给的第二只狞猫。这只是母的？到底怎么回事？谁在付钱？

original: It's a cat . . . Thing from another planet, maybe from another world. You think it's not dangerous, but you can't be sure. The researcher should know more about this creature.
translation: 这是一只猫……来自另一个星球的东西，也许来自另一个世界。你觉得它并不危险，但你不能确定。研究员应该更了解这种生物。

original: You recalled in another PowerPoint presentation that military loves to use that Newt is a survivor from the current Xenomorph menace. Researchers found this poor thing amidst its kins, possibly gutted by xenomorphs. Who knows if Newt is the last of her kind.
translation: 你想起在另一份PPT演示中，军方喜欢用纽特作为当前异形威胁中的幸存者案例。研究人员在其同类中发现了这个可怜的小东西，很可能被异形开膛破肚了。谁知道纽特是不是她族群的最后幸存者。

original: That's Ranger, your friendly and fierce k9. He has seen the terror of Xenomorphs, so it's best to be nice to him. RANGER LEAD THE WAY!
translation: 这是游骑兵，你友善而凶猛的朋友。它见识过异形的恐怖，所以最好对它友善点。游骑兵带路！

original: It's a bull terrier. Is that the Target dog?
translation: 这是一只蛮牛犬。是那只广告狗吗？

original: Sir, this is chief Walten Clements. He resides in medbay as this is also his realms. His minions wear scrubs for bacterial control, and they pay him in pets and treats. Do not be concern if he gets COPD as he is kept in a healthy diet full of black coffee and an exercise regimen with plenty of cardio and stretching. His daily concern is accounting; his supply of treats must be met with acute attention. Good day to you, marine.
translation: 长官，这位是首席沃尔顿·克莱门茨。他常驻医疗区，因为这里也是他的领地。他的随从们身着刷手服以控制细菌传播，他们用抚摸和零食作为报酬。如果他患上慢性阻塞性肺病也无需担心，因为他保持着健康饮食——以黑咖啡为主，并执行包含充足有氧运动和拉伸的训练计划。他每日关注的是账目管理；必须高度关注他的零食供应是否充足。祝您今日顺利，陆战队员。

original: As cute as it is colorful!

translation: 这是人事主管心爱的柯基犬。

original: A corgi puppy that has been infused with deep space energy. It's staring back...
translation: 一只被深空能量灌注的柯基幼犬。它正回望着你……

original: Unnerving, isn't it? It has to be planning something nefarious...
translation: 令人不安，对吧？它肯定在策划什么邪恶的勾当……

original: This is a real crab. The other crabs are simply gubbucks in disguise!
translation: 这是一只真正的螃蟹。其他螃蟹都只是伪装成嘎巴克的！

original: [src] gets an evil-looking gleam in [p_their()] eye.
translation: [src] 眼中闪过一丝不怀好意的光芒。

original: [src] hatches with a quiet cracking sound.
translation: [src] 伴随着轻微的碎裂声破壳而出。

original: Not known for their pleasant disposition.
Known for their milk, just don't tip them over.
translation: 以产奶闻名，只是别把它们弄翻了。

original: Adorable! They make such a racket though.
translation: 真可爱！不过它们也太吵了。

original: Hopefully the eggs are good this season.
translation: 希望这季的蛋品质不错。

original: It's a nasty, ugly, evil, disease-ridden rodent.
translation: 这是一只肮脏、丑陋、邪恶、疾病缠身的啮齿动物。

original: Jerry the cat is not amused.
translation: 杰瑞猫对此并不感到有趣。

original: The parrot squaks, \"It's a Parrot! BAWWK!\"
translation: 鹦鹉嘎嘎叫道：'是只鹦鹉！嘎！'

original: Poly the Parrot. An expert on quantum cracker theory.
translation: 波利鹦鹉。量子饼干理论的专家。
[parrot_source.available_channels.len ? "[pick(parrot_source.available_channels)] " : null]咯咯咯 把耳机放下 咯咯咯！

original: You don't need to be faster than a space bear, you just need to outrun your crewmates.
translation: 你不需要比太空熊跑得快，只需要跑赢你的队友就行。

original: Feared outlaw, this guy is one bad news bear.
translation: 令人畏惧的法外之徒，这家伙是个十足的麻烦人物。

original: It's a polar bear, in space, but not actually in space.
translation: 这是一头北极熊，在太空中，但并非真的在太空中。

original: A ferocious brown bear decked out in armor plating, a red star with yellow outlining details the shoulder plating.
translation: 一头凶猛的棕熊，身披装甲板，肩甲上饰有黄色轮廓的红色五角星。

original: A ferocious, fang-bearing creature that resembles a fish.
translation: 一种凶猛、长着尖牙、形似鱼类的生物。

original: A ferocious, fang bearing creature that resembles a shark. This one seems especially ticked off.
translation: 一头凶猛、长着利齿、形似鲨鱼的生物。这只看起来格外暴躁。

original: A failed Syndicate experiment in weaponized space carp technology, it now serves as a lovable mascot.
translation: 一次失败的辛迪加武器化太空鲤鱼实验，如今它成了一个可爱的吉祥物。

original: You are unable to equip that.
Cannot grab, lacking free hands to do so!
translation: 无法抓取，没有空闲的手！
你将[AM]从[AM.pulledby]的手中拽了出来！
[src] 将 [AM] 从 [AM.pulledby] 的手中拽了出来。

original: Something is there, but you can't see it!
translation: 有东西在那里，但你看不见它！

original: The game appears to have misplaced your mind datum, so we can't show you your notes.
translation: 游戏似乎丢失了你的心智数据，因此无法显示你的笔记。

original: You don't have a mind datum for some reason, so you can't add a note to it.
translation: 由于某些原因，你没有思维数据，因此无法为其添加备注。

original: You must be dead to use this!
translation: 你必须死亡才能使用这个！

original:
You can respawn now, enjoy your new life!
Make sure to play a different character, and please roleplay correctly.
translation:
你现在可以重新复活了，享受你的新生活吧！
请务必扮演一个不同的角色，并正确地进行角色扮演。

original: You can only use this when you're dead or crit.
translation: 你只能在死亡或濒死状态下使用这个。

original: [span_danger("Fight for your life (again), try not to die this time!")]
translation: [span_danger("Fight for your life (again), try not to die this time!")]
当前已禁用生成，请观察。

original: The game is still setting up, please try again later.
translation: 游戏仍在设置中，请稍后再试。

original: Could not locate an observer spawn point. Use the Teleport verb to jump.
translation: 无法定位观察者生成点。请使用传送功能进行跳跃。

original: The round is either not ready, or has already finished.
translation: 回合尚未准备就绪，或已结束。

original: Sorry, you cannot late join during [SSticker.mode.name]. You have to start at the beginning of the round. You may observe or try to join as an alien, if possible.
translation: 抱歉，您无法在[SSticker.mode.name]期间中途加入。您必须在回合开始时加入。您可以选择旁观，或者如果可能的话，尝试以异形身份加入。

original: You are next in line to join the game. You will be notified when a slot opens up.
translation: 你已进入游戏排队队列。有空位时会通知你。

original: There are [queue_position - 1] players in front of you in the queue to join the game.
translation: 有 [queue_position - 1] 名玩家排在你前面等待加入游戏。

original: You have been added to the queue to join the game. Your position in queue is [length(SSticker.queued_players)].
translation: 你已被加入游戏队列。你在队列中的位置是[length(SSticker.queued_players)]。

original: Something went horribly wrong processing your vote. Please contact an administrator, they should have gotten a message about this
translation: 处理您的投票时出现严重错误。请联络管理员，他们应该已收到相关通知。

original: Poll revoting is disabled and you've already replied to this poll.
translation: 投票重新投票已禁用，您已回复此投票。

original: The text you entered was blank or too long. Please correct the text and submit again.
translation: 您输入的文本为空或过长。请修正文本后重新提交。

original: invalid votes were trimmed from your ballot, please revote .
translation: 无效票已从您的选票中剔除，请重新投票。

original: Allowed option count exceeded, only the first [poll.options_allowed] selected options have been saved.
translation: 允许的选项数量超出限制，仅保存了前 [poll.options_allowed] 个选中的选项。

original: No ordering data found. Please try again or contact an administrator.
translation: 未找到订购数据。请重试或联系管理员。
你无法在死亡频道发言（已禁言）。
你已被禁止使用死亡聊天频道。

original: The ship is currently changing orbit.
The ship is already at the highest orbit!
The ship is already at the lowest orbit!
The ship is currently recalculating based on previous selection.
translation: 舰船正在根据先前选择重新计算。

original: The floor jolts under your feet!
The splint on your [display_name] comes apart!
Your infected [display_name] is turning off-color and stings like hell!
translation: 你被感染的[display_name]正在变色，而且疼得要命！
你再也感觉不到你的[display_name]了……

original: You hear a loud cracking sound coming from [owner]!
translation: 你听到[owner]传来一阵响亮的碎裂声！

original: You hear a sickening cracking sound coming from \the [owner]'s face.
translation: 你听到\the [owner]的脸上传来一阵令人作呕的碎裂声。

original: [owner]'s face melts away, turning into a mangled mess!
translation: [owner]的脸融化了，变成了一团烂肉！

original: It smells like an accident in a chemical factory.
translation: 闻起来像是化工厂出了事故。

original: You don't feel as overwhelmed by all the drugs any more.
translation: 你不再感到被所有药物压得喘不过气。

original: All the different drugs in you are starting to make you feel off...
translation: 你体内的各种药物开始让你感到不适...

original: You take an experimental bite out of \the [src].
translation: 你从\the [src]上咬下了一小口进行实验。

original: It looks like it probably just plopped out.
translation: 看起来它大概只是刚被投放出来。

original: There are no more carbon copies attached to this paper!
translation: 这张纸上没有更多复写纸了！

original: A black folder. It is decorated with stripes.
translation: 一个黑色文件夹。上面装饰着条纹。

original: You wipe off the face paint with [src].
translation: 你用[src]擦掉了脸上的油彩。

original: You must hold \the [P] steady to burn \the [src].
translation: 你必须稳住 \the [P] 才能烧灼 \the [src]。

original: Take off the carbon copy first.
You stamp the paper with your rubber stamp.
translation: 你给文件盖上了你的橡皮图章。

original: [user] begins to wipe [H]'s face paint off with \the [src].
[class][user] holds \the [P] up to \the [src], it looks like [user.p_theyre()] trying to burn it!
translation: [class][user] 将 \the [P] 举到 \the [src] 前，看起来 [user.p_theyre()] 想烧掉它！

original: [class][user] burns right through \the [src], turning it to ash. It flutters through the air before settling on the floor in a heap.
translation: [class][user] 将 \the [src] 彻底烧穿，将其化为灰烬。它在空中飘散，最终落在地面堆积成一小堆。

original: A Crash Course in Legal SOP on SS13
translation: 太空站13法律标准操作程序速成指南
关于猿类实验对象的记录

original: Proje- Oh who the fuck cares.
URGENT WORK ORDER - SUSPEND ALL OTHER ASSIGNMENTS
translation: 紧急工作指令 - 暂停所有其他任务

original: Take off the carbon copy first.
You must hold \the [P] steady to burn \the [src].
translation: 你必须稳住 \the [P] 才能烧灼 \the [src]。

original: You remove the [W.name] from the bundle.
You need to hold it in hands!
[class][user] holds \the [P] up to \the [src], it looks like [user.p_theyre()] trying to burn it!
[class][user] burns right through \the [src], turning it to ash. It flutters through the air before settling on the floor in a heap.
translation: [class][user] 将 \the [src] 彻底烧穿，将其化为灰烬。它在空中飘散片刻，最终在地面堆积成一摊。

original: This cartridge is not yet ready for replacement! Use up the rest of the toner.
translation: 这个墨盒还没到更换的时候！把剩下的墨粉用完。

original: Used to copy important documents and anatomy studies.
translation: 用于复制重要文件和人体解剖研究。

original: [src] still has some film in it!
A camera film cartridge. Insert it into a camera to reload it.
translation: 相机胶卷盒。将其插入相机以重新装填。

original: An old, slightly beat-up digital camera, with a cheap photo printer taped on. It's a nice shade of blue.
translation: 一台略显陈旧的数码相机，上面用胶带粘着一台廉价照片打印机。机身是漂亮的蓝色调。

original: [src]'s screen suddenly explodes in rain of sparks and small debris!

translation: 触感冰冷，却以不止一种方式灼烧着。

original: An advanced stun device capable of firing balls of ionized electricity. Used for nonlethal takedowns.
translation: 一种先进的电击装置，能够发射电离电球。用于非致命性制服。

original: A laser based firearm. Uses power cells.
translation: 一款基于激光的枪械。使用能量电池。

original: An accurate, recoilless laser based battle rifle with an integrated charge selector. Ideal for longer range engagements. It was the standard lasrifle for TGMC soldiers until it was replaced by the LR-73, due to its extremely modular lens system.
translation: 一款精准、无后坐力的激光战斗步枪，配备集成式能量选择器。适用于远距离交战。由于其高度模块化的透镜系统，在LR-73列装之前，它一直是TGMC士兵的标准激光步枪。

original: A heavy-duty, multifaceted energy weapon that uses pulse-based beam generation technology to emit powerful laser blasts. Because of its complexity and cost, it is rarely seen in use except by specialists and front-line combat personnel. This is a testing model issued only for Asset Protection units and offshore elite Nanotrasen squads.
translation: 一款重型多用途能量武器，采用脉冲式光束生成技术，可发射强力激光冲击。因其结构复杂且造价高昂，除特种部队及前线作战人员外鲜少列装。此为仅配发给资产保护部队及纳米传讯海外精英小队的测试型号。

original: An accurate, recoilless laser based battle rifle, based on the outdated M43 design. Only accepts practice power cells and it doesn't have a charge selector. Uses power cells instead of ballistic magazines.
translation: 一款基于过时M43设计的精准无后坐力激光战斗步枪。仅接受训练用能量电池，且没有充电选择器。使用能量电池而非弹道弹匣。

original: A multifunctional laser based rifle with an integrated mode selector. Ideal for any situation. Uses power cells instead of ballistic magazines.
translation: 一款多功能激光步枪，配备集成模式选择器。适用于任何情况。使用能量电池而非弹道弹匣。

original: A Terra Experimental energy rifle that fires balls of elecricity that shock all those near them, it is meant to drain the plasma of unidentified creatures from within, limiting their abilities. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts. Uses standard Terra Experimental (TE) power cells.
translation: 一把地球实验型能量步枪，发射电球，能电击附近的所有目标，旨在从内部耗尽不明生物的等离子体，限制其能力。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金，且不再需要子弹，相比其弹道武器同类，显著减轻了重量并提高了瞄准速度。使用标准地球实验型（TE）能量电池。

original: A Terra Experimental laser rifle, abbreviated as the TE-R. Has multiple firemodes for tactical flexibility. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: 一把地球实验型激光步枪，简称TE-R。拥有多种射击模式，提供战术灵活性。使用标准地球实验型（简称TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金制造，且不再需要子弹，这使其重量和瞄准速度相比弹道武器有显著提升。

original: A TerraGov standard issue laser pistol abbreviated as TE-P. It has an integrated charge selector for normal, heat and taser settings. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: 地球政府标准制式激光手枪，简称TE-P。配备集成式充能选择器，可在常规、加热和电击模式间切换。使用标准地球实验型（简称TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，采用轻质合金制造，且无需使用弹道弹药，相比弹道武器显著减轻了重量并提升了瞄准速度。

original: A TerraGov standard issue laser carbine, otherwise known as TE-C for short. Has multiple firemodes for tactical flexibility. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: 一把地球政府标准制式激光卡宾枪，简称TE-C。拥有多种射击模式以提供战术灵活性。使用标准地球实验型（缩写为TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金制造，且不再需要弹道武器所需的子弹，这使其重量和瞄准速度相比弹道武器有显著提升。

original: The T-ES, a Terra Experimental standard issue laser sniper rifle, has multiple powerful firemodes, although the lack of aim mode can limit its tactical flexibility. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: T-ES，一款地球实验型标准制式激光狙击步枪，拥有多种强力射击模式，尽管缺少瞄准模式可能限制其战术灵活性。使用标准地球实验型（简称TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金制造，且不再需要子弹，这使其重量和瞄准速度相比弹道武器同类产品有显著降低。

original: A Terra Experimental standard issue machine laser gun, often called as the TE-M by marines. High efficiency modulators ensure the TE-M has an extremely high fire count, and multiple firemodes makes it a flexible infantry support gun. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: 地球实验型标准制式激光机枪，陆战队员常称之为TE-M。高效调制器确保TE-M拥有极高的射击次数，多种射击模式使其成为灵活的步兵支援武器。使用标准地球实验型（简称TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金制造，且不再需要子弹，相比弹道武器显著降低了重量并提升了瞄准速度。

original: A Terra Experimental X-Ray laser rifle, abbreviated as the TE-X. It has an integrated charge selector for normal and high settings. Uses standard Terra Experimental (abbreviated as TE) power cells. As with all TE Laser weapons, they use a lightweight alloy combined without the need for bullets any longer decreases their weight and aiming speed quite some vs their ballistic counterparts.
translation: 地球政府实验型X射线激光步枪，简称TE-X。它集成了普通和高能设置的充电选择器。使用标准地球政府实验型（简称TE）能量电池。与所有TE激光武器一样，它们采用轻质合金制造，且不再需要子弹，这使其重量和瞄准速度相比弹道步枪有显著提升。

original: Volkite weapons are the pride of Martian weapons manufacturing, their construction being a tightly guarded secret. Infamous for its ability to deflagrate organic targets with its tremendous thermal energy, explosively burning flesh in a fiery blast that can be deadly to anyone unfortunate enough to be nearby. The 'serpenta' is pistol typically seen in the hands of SOM officers and some NCOs, and is quite dangerous for it's size.
translation: 沃尔坎武器是火星武器制造业的骄傲，其构造是严格保守的秘密。它以利用其巨大的热能对有机目标进行爆燃而臭名昭著，能在一阵火焰爆炸中剧烈燃烧肉体，对任何不幸靠近的人来说都可能是致命的。这种'蛇形'手枪通常见于火星之子军官和一些士官手中，就其尺寸而言相当危险。

original: The 'serpenta' is pistol typically seen in the hands of SOM officers and some NCOs, and is quite dangerous for it's size. This particular weapon appears to be a custom model with improved performance.
translation: '蛇形'手枪通常见于火星之子军官和部分士官手中，以其尺寸而言威力相当可观。这把武器似乎是经过定制改造的增强型号。

original: Volkite weapons are the pride of Martian weapons manufacturing, their construction being a tightly guarded secret. Infamous for its ability to deflagrate organic targets with its tremendous thermal energy, explosively burning flesh in a fiery blast that can be deadly to anyone unfortunate enough to be nearby. The charger is a light weight weapon with a high rate of fire, designed for high mobility and easy handling. Ineffective at longer ranges.
translation: 沃尔坎武器是火星武器制造业的骄傲，其制造工艺是严格保守的秘密。它以利用巨大热能对有机目标进行爆燃而臭名昭著，能在火焰爆炸中剧烈燃烧肉体，对附近任何不幸的个体都可能是致命的。充电器是一种轻量级武器，射速高，专为高机动性和易于操作而设计。在较远距离上效果不佳。

original: Volkite weapons are the pride of Martian weapons manufacturing, their construction being a tightly guarded secret. Infamous for its ability to deflagrate organic targets with its tremendous thermal energy, explosively burning flesh in a fiery blast that can be deadly to anyone unfortunate enough to be nearby. The caliver is the primary rifle of the volkite family, and effective at most ranges and situations. Drag click the powerpack to the gun to use that instead of magazines.
translation: 沃尔凯特武器是火星武器制造业的骄傲，其构造是严格保守的秘密。它以利用巨大的热能对有机目标进行爆燃而臭名昭著，能在火焰爆炸中剧烈燃烧肉体，对任何不幸靠近的人都可能是致命的。卡利弗是沃尔凯特家族的主要步枪，在大多数射程和情况下都有效。将能量包拖拽点击到枪上即可使用它来代替弹匣。

original: Volkite weapons are the pride of Martian weapons manufacturing, their construction being a tightly guarded secret. Infamous for its ability to deflagrate organic targets with its tremendous thermal energy, explosively burning flesh in a fiery blast that can be deadly to anyone unfortunate enough to be nearby. The culverin is the largest man portable example of volkite weaponry, and can lay down a staggering torrent of fire due to its linked back-mounted powerpack. Drag click the powerpack to the gun to load.
translation: 沃尔坎武器是火星武器制造业的骄傲，其构造是严格保守的秘密。它以利用巨大的热能对有机目标进行爆燃而臭名昭著，在炽热的爆炸中剧烈燃烧肉体，对任何不幸靠近的人都可能是致命的。卡尔弗林炮是最大型的人携式沃尔坎武器，由于其连接在背部的动力背包，可以倾泻出惊人的火力洪流。将动力背包拖拽到枪上以装载。

original: [src] does not have a nozzle installed!
The FL-240 has proven to be one of the most effective weapons at clearing out soft-targets. This is a weapon to be feared and respected as it is quite deadly.
translation: FL-240已被证明是清除软目标最有效的武器之一。这是一种令人畏惧且值得敬畏的武器，因为它极具致命性。

original: The V-62 is a deadly weapon employed in close quarter combat, favoured as much for the terror it inspires as the actual damage it inflicts. It has good range for a flamer, but lacks the integrated extinguisher of its TGMC equivalent.
translation: V-62是一种在近距离作战中使用的致命武器，其引发的恐惧与实际造成的伤害同样令人畏惧。作为一款喷火器，它拥有不错的射程，但缺少地球政府殖民地海军陆战队同类武器所配备的集成灭火器。

original: The FL-86 is a more light weight incinerator unit designed specifically to fit into its accompanying engineers bag. Can only be used with magazine fuel tanks however.
translation: FL-86是一种更轻型的喷火器单元，专门设计用于装入配套的工程师包中。但只能使用弹匣式燃料罐。

original: A weapon-mounted refillable flamethrower attachment.\nIt is designed for short bursts.
translation: 一款可重复装填的枪械配件式火焰喷射器。\n专为短点射设计。

original: The FL-84 flamethrower is the current standard issue flamethrower of the TGMC, and is used for area control and urban combat. Use unique action to use hydro cannon
translation: FL-84喷火器是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的现役标准制式喷火器，用于区域控制和城市作战。使用特殊动作来使用水炮。

original: For the quenching of unfortunate mistakes.
The CC/21 flamer, a new design made by CrashCore and is truly a sight to behold. For its heavy duty look, it makes up for it with its firepower. Canister fed and fueled by X-fuel.
translation: CC/21喷火器，由CrashCore设计的新型号，确实令人叹为观止。其重型外观，以其火力弥补。弹匣供弹，使用X燃料。

original: [src] beeps a warning noise. You are too close!
translation: [src] 发出警告的哔哔声。你靠得太近了！
\improper BR-64 下挂式榴弹发射器

original: The GL-70 is the standard grenade launcher used by the TerraGov Marine Corps for area denial and big explosions.
translation: GL-70是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队用于区域拒止和大范围爆炸的标准手雷发射器。

original: A weapon-mounted, reloadable, two-shot grenade launcher.
translation: 一款武器下挂式、可重新装填的双发手雷发射器。

original: A weapon-mounted, reloadable, two-shot grenade launcher designed to fit the BR-64.
translation: 一款可装填、双发、可安装在武器上的手雷发射器，专为BR-64设计。

original: A lightweight, single-shot grenade launcher used by the TerraGov Marine Corps for area denial and big explosions.
translation: 一款轻量型单发手雷发射器，由地球政府殖民地海军陆战队使用，用于区域封锁和大规模爆炸。

original: A lightweight, single-shot grenade launcher to launch tear gas grenades. Used by Nanotrasen security during riots.
translation: 一种轻便的单发手雷发射器，用于发射催泪瓦斯手雷。纳米传讯安保部门在骚乱期间使用。

original: A gun that fires flares. Replace with flares. Simple! Equipped with long range irons.
translation: 一把发射照明弹的枪。换上照明弹即可。简单！配备远程机械瞄具。

original: A very tiny flaregun that fires flares equipped with long range irons, the mass amounts of markings on the back and barrel denote it as owned by the TGMC.
translation: 一把非常小巧的信号枪，发射配备远程机械瞄具的信号弹，枪身和枪管上大量的标记表明它属于地球政府殖民地海军陆战队。
