original: Tomato juice, mixed with Vodka and a li'l bit of lime. Tastes like liquid murder.
translation: 番茄汁，混合伏特加和少许青柠。尝起来像液态谋杀。

original: Tequila and Coffee liqueur, brought together in a mouthwatering mixture. Drink up.
translation: 龙舌兰与咖啡利口酒，融合成令人垂涎的混合饮品。一饮而尽吧。

original: Oh great, now you feel nostalgic about sunrises back on Terra...
translation: 哦，太好了，现在你又开始怀念地球上的日出了……

original: Whoah, this thing is on FIRE!
Heavy, hot and strong. Just like the Iron fist of the LAW.
translation: 沉重、灼热而强劲。正如法律铁拳一般。

original: It's cream, mixed with whiskey. What else would you expect from the Irish?
translation: 这是奶油混合威士忌。你还能指望爱尔兰人做出什么别的？

original: A manly concoction made from Ale and Beer. Intended for true men only.
translation: 一种由麦芽酒和啤酒调制的阳刚饮品。仅供真正的男子汉享用。

original: The liquor cabinet, brought together in a delicious mix. Intended for middle-aged alcoholic women only.
translation: 酒柜里的酒，混合成一杯美味佳酿。仅供中年酗酒女性享用。

original: You've really hit rock bottom now... your liver packed its bags and left last night.
translation: 你已经彻底堕落了……你的肝脏昨晚已经收拾行李走人了。

original: Kahlua, Irish Cream, and cognac. You will get bombed.
translation: 咖啡利口酒、爱尔兰奶油和白兰地。你会被炸翻的。

original: Coffee and alcohol. More fun than a Mimosa to drink in the morning.
translation: 咖啡与酒精。比早晨喝一杯含羞草更有趣。

original: On the rocks with salt on the rim. Arriba~!
For the lactose-intolerant. Still as classy as a White Russian.
translation: 专为乳糖不耐受者准备。依然像白俄罗斯人一样优雅。

original: The Detective's undercover drink of choice. He never could stomach gin...
translation: 侦探最爱的卧底饮品。他从来都受不了杜松子酒的味道……

original: A scientist's drink of choice, for thinking how to blow up the station.
translation: 科学家的首选饮品，用于思考如何炸毁空间站。

original: Just looking at this thing makes the hair at the back of your neck stand up.
translation: 光是看着这东西就让你后颈发毛。

original: For when a gin and tonic isn't Russian enough.
translation: 当金汤力还不够俄罗斯风情时。

original: A tropical cocktail with a complex blend of flavors.
translation: 一款风味层次丰富的热带鸡尾酒。

original: A spicy mix of Vodka and Spice. Very hot.
translation: 伏特加与香料的辛辣混合。非常热辣。

original: A true Viking's beverage, made with the blood of their enemies.
translation: 真正的维京人饮品，由敌人的鲜血酿制而成。

original: A beer so frosty, the air around it freezes.
translation: 一杯冰爽透顶的啤酒，连周围的空气都仿佛要冻结。

original: A fine and cepa drink for Space.
translation: 为太空准备的优质洋葱饮料。
一杯不错但名字奇怪的饮料。

original: A drink made from your allies.
translation: 用你的盟友制成的饮品。

original: A drink from Nanotrasen. Made from live aliens.
translation: 纳米传讯出品的饮品。由活体异形制成。

original: For when even mindshields can't save you.
translation: 当连心灵护盾都救不了你的时候。

original: Only for the experienced. You think you see sand floating in the glass.
translation: 仅供老手使用。你觉得你看到玻璃里有沙子漂浮。

original: Lemon juice mixed with whiskey and a dash of sugar. Surprisingly satisfying.
translation: 柠檬汁混合威士忌，再加少许糖。出乎意料地令人满意。

original: Tastes like autumn... no wait, fall!
translation: 尝起来像秋天……不对，是坠落！

original: Induces magnetism in the imbiber. Started as a barroom prank but evolved to become popular with miners and scrappers. Metallic aftertaste.
translation: 饮用后能诱发磁性。最初只是酒吧里的恶作剧，后来在矿工和废料回收者中流行起来。带有金属余味。

original: Aromatic beverage served piping hot. According to folk tales it can almost wake the dead.
translation: 芳香四溢的热饮。据民间传说，它几乎能让死者复生。

original: You didn't think it was possible for a liquid to be so utterly revolting. Are you sure about this...?
translation: 你从没想过一种液体能让人如此反胃。你确定要这么做吗……？

original: Nanotrasen cannot take legal responsibility for your actions after imbibing.
translation: 纳米传讯对您饮用后的行为不承担法律责任。

original: Like having your brain smashed out by a slice of lemon wrapped around a large gold brick.
translation: 感觉就像被包裹在大金砖上的一片柠檬砸碎了你的大脑。

original: A drink that is guaranteed to knock you silly.
translation: 一杯保证能让你晕头转向的饮料。

original: A drink enjoyed by people during the 1960's.
translation: 一款在20世纪60年代深受人们喜爱的饮品。

original: For enjoying the most wonderful time of the year.
translation: 为了享受一年中最美好的时光。

original: For suffering during the best time of the year.
translation: 为了在一年中最美好的时光里受苦。

original: A new hit cocktail inspired by THE ARM Breweries will have you shouting Fuu ma'jin in no time!
translation: 一款源自THE ARM酿酒厂的全新热门鸡尾酒，让你瞬间高呼'Fuu ma'jin'！

original: A glass of straight Triple Sec.
You can almost feel the first breath of spring just looking at it.
translation: 光是看着它，你几乎就能感受到初春的第一缕气息。

original: A million hazing lawsuits and alcohol poisonings have started with this humble ingredient.
translation: 无数起霸凌诉讼和酒精中毒事件，都始于这种不起眼的原料。

original: An unintimidating glass of coconut liqueur.
translation: 一杯平平无奇的椰子利口酒。

original: An intimidating and lawful beverage dares you to violate the law and make its day. Still can't drink it on duty, though.
translation: 一款威严而合法的饮料，挑战你违反法律并让它满意。不过执勤时仍然不能饮用。

original: Now you are become law, destroyer of clowns.
translation: 现在你已成为法律，小丑的毁灭者。

original: You weren't aware edible beverages could be that green.
translation: 你从没想过可饮用的饮料能绿到这种程度。

original: You wonder what would happen if you pointed this at a heat source...
translation: 你想知道如果把它对准热源会发生什么……

original: If you're feeling low, count on the buttery flavor of our own bastion bourbon.
translation: 如果你心情低落，就靠我们自家堡垒波本威士忌的醇厚风味来提振精神吧。

original: Squirt cider will toughen you right up. Too bad about the musty aftertaste.
translation: 喷点苹果酒能让你立刻精神起来。可惜就是那股霉味余韵不太讨喜。

original: It's a wonder it doesn't spill out of the glass.
translation: 真奇怪，它居然没从杯子里溢出来。

original: If you can't mix a Sugar Rush, you can't tend bar.
translation: 要是连一杯'糖分冲刺'都调不出来，那你可不够格当酒保。

original: It'll either knock the drunkenness out of you or knock you out cold. Both, probably.
translation: 这玩意儿要么能让你醒酒，要么能把你彻底撂倒。很可能两者兼得。

original: A boozy minty hot cocoa that warms your belly on a cold night.
translation: 一杯酒香薄荷热可可，在寒冷的夜晚温暖你的胃。

original: A creamy, indulgent delight that is stronger than it seems.
translation: 一种浓郁醇厚的享受，比看起来更强劲。

original: A creamy, indulgent delight that is in fact as gentle as it seems.
translation: 一种奶油般、令人放纵的美味，实际上正如它看起来那样温和。

original: The one ride you'll gladly give up the wheel for.
translation: 这是你唯一会心甘情愿交出方向盘的一次旅程。

original: The only drink that comes with a label reminding you of Nanotrasen's zero-tolerance promiscuity policy.
translation: 唯一一款附带标签提醒你纳米传讯零容忍滥交政策的饮品。

original: A drink that looks as refreshing as it tastes.
translation: 一款看起来和尝起来一样清爽的饮品。

original: A chilly drink that reminds you of the Derelict.
translation: 一杯让你想起废弃飞船的冰镇饮料。

original: A sawed-off cola bottle filled with Fernet Cola. Nothing better after eating like a lardass.
translation: 一个锯短的汽水瓶，里面装满了费内特可乐。在大吃一顿之后，没有比这更好的了。

original: A glass of Fanciulli. It's just Manhattan with Fernet.
translation: 一杯范丘利。其实就是曼哈顿加菲奈特。

original: A glass of Branca Menta, perfect for those lazy and hot Sunday summer afternoons.
translation: 一杯布兰卡薄荷酒，专为慵懒炎热的周日下午而备。

original: A fizzy cocktail for those looking to start fresh.
translation: 一杯清爽的鸡尾酒，献给那些想要重新开始的人。

original: The glass bubbles and froths with an almost magical intensity.
translation: 玻璃表面泛起气泡，翻腾涌动，带着近乎魔幻的强度。

original: Your eyes begin to water as the sting of alcohol reaches them.
translation: 你的眼睛开始流泪，酒精的刺痛感扑面而来。

original: You feel like you could drink this all neight.
translation: 你觉得自己能喝上一整晚。

original: Enough of these, and you really will start to suppose your toeses are roses.
translation: 吃够这些，你恐怕真会开始觉得自己的脚趾头是玫瑰花了。

original: A turbulent cocktail for outlaw hoverbikers.
translation: 亡命悬浮摩托骑手的狂野鸡尾酒。

original: A popular drink amongst those adhering to an all synthetic diet.
translation: 一种在坚持全合成饮食的人群中颇受欢迎的饮品。

original: To imbibe one component separately from the other is consider a great faux pas.
translation: 单独饮用其中一种成分而不搭配另一种，会被视为极大的失礼。
装在杯子里的醉人天主教。

original: The glass seems to be sliding between realities. Doubles as a Berenstain remover.
translation: 玻璃似乎在现实之间滑动。同时兼具贝伦斯坦移除功能。

original: Although historians believe the drink was originally created to commemorate the end of an important conflict in man's past, its origins have largely been forgotten and it is today seen more as a general symbol of human supremacy.
translation: 尽管历史学家认为这种饮品最初是为了纪念人类过去一场重要冲突的结束而创造的，但其起源已基本被遗忘，如今它更多地被视为人类至高无上地位的普遍象征。

original: Lavaland in a drink... mug... volcano... thing.
translation: 熔岩地在一杯饮料里……马克杯……火山……东西。

original: A combination of tropical juices and rum. Surely this will make you feel better.
translation: 热带果汁与朗姆酒的混合饮品。这肯定会让你感觉好一些。

original: If you like pina coladas, and getting caught in the rain... well, you'll like this drink.
translation: 如果你喜欢椰林飘香，又喜欢淋雨的感觉……那么你一定会喜欢这款饮品。

original: A balance of fruity pineapple with thick, rich olive oil. Stir well before drinking.
translation: 一种果味菠萝与浓郁橄榄油的平衡。饮用前请充分搅拌。

original: The sprig of rosemary adds a nice aroma to the drink, and isn't just to be pretentious afterall!
translation: 这枝迷迭香为饮品增添了宜人的香气，毕竟不只是为了装腔作势！

original: A classic from old Italy and enjoyed by gangsters, pray the orange peel doesnt end up in your mouth.
translation: 来自旧意大利的经典，深受黑帮喜爱，祈祷橙皮不会掉进你嘴里。

original: A lovely fresh smelling cocktail, a true Sicilian delight.
translation: 一杯清新怡人的鸡尾酒，真正的西西里风味。

original: The fermented nectar of the Korta nut, as enjoyed by lizards galaxywide.
translation: 科塔坚果的发酵花蜜，全银河蜥蜴人的最爱。

original: Minty, chocolatey, and creamy. It's like drinkable mint chocolate chip!
translation: 薄荷味、巧克力味，还有奶油味。就像能喝的薄荷巧克力片！

original: I had a rough night and I hate the fucking humans, man.
translation: 昨晚真难熬，我他妈恨死那些人类了。

original: A drink to make facing death easier.
translation: 一杯让你直面死亡时更轻松的饮品。
卑劣，即便以蜥蜴的标准来看。

original: A toast to the Empire, long may it stand.
translation: 为帝国干杯，愿它永世长存。

original: A concoction of not-so-edible things that apparently lets you feel like you're in two places at once
translation: 一种由不太可食用的东西混合而成的混合物，显然能让你感觉同时身处两地。

original: Hail to the Admiral, for he brings fair tidings, and rum too.
translation: 向海军上将致敬，他带来了好消息，还有朗姆酒。

original: A perfect companion for a lonely long haul flight.
Named for a famous pirate, who may or may not have been fictional. But hey, why let the truth get in the way of a good yarn?
translation: 以一位著名海盗命名，这位海盗可能真实存在，也可能纯属虚构。不过，何必让真相妨碍一个好故事呢？

original: Less destructive than the real thing.
Thunder and lightning, very very frightening.
translation: 电闪雷鸣，非常非常吓人。

original: Ah, I do like to be beside the seaside.
translation: 啊，我确实喜欢待在海边。

original: Another reason to cut off an ear...
translation: 又一个割掉耳朵的理由……

original: Looks like an evening of writing fine poetry.
translation: 看起来是个写诗的好夜晚。

original: Hey, someone forgot the herb and... the cucumber in my cocktail!
translation: 嘿，有人忘了在我的鸡尾酒里加香草和……黄瓜！

original: Electrically charged wine. Recharges ethereals, but also nontoxic.
translation: 带电葡萄酒。可为以太体充能，且无毒。

original: A liquid grounding rod. Recharges ethereals and grants temporary shock resistance.
translation: 液体接地棒。可为以太体充能并提供临时电击抗性。

original: Ride the lightning! Recharges ethereals, suppresses phobias, and grants strong temporary shock resistance.
translation: 感受雷霆之力！为灵能者充能，抑制恐惧症，并赋予强大的临时电击抗性。

original: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.
translation: 我举目观看，见有一匹灰马；骑在马上的，名字叫作死，阴府也随着他。

original: A drink made in honour of Cybersun Industries' 600th year of continual business. Officially, you're meant to call this a \"Hong Kong Cooler\" on Nanotrasen stations, but that name sucks.
translation: 为纪念赛博太阳工业集团连续经营600周年而调制的饮品。在纳米传讯空间站上，官方要求你称其为'香港酷乐'，但这名字糟透了。

original: A drink to last ten-thousand years- better sip slowly then.
translation: 一杯能延续万年的饮品——最好还是小口啜饮。

original: A popular children's dessert from Japan, made adult with the addition of booze. Kanpai!
translation: 日本广受欢迎的儿童甜点，加入酒精后变身成人版。干杯！

original: Much like the American Godfather, the Kumichō is sophisticated, strong, and almost certainly tied to illicit activities.
translation: 就像美国的教父一样，组长（Kumichō）老练、强大，几乎肯定与非法活动有关。

original: A patriotic drink from Mars, commonly enjoyed on September 15th: the day that peace was declared following the Martian uprising, with the Martian Concession granting Mars proper representation as part of the Terran Federation.
translation: 一款来自火星的爱国饮品，通常在9月15日享用：这一天是火星起义后宣布和平的日子，《火星让步协议》使火星作为地球联邦的一部分获得了应有的代表权。

original: And so Amaterasu emerged from the Heavenly Rock Cave, and light was restored to the world.
translation: 于是天照大神从岩户中现身，光明重返世间。

original: A syrupy mess of a cocktail, dedicated to a felinid popstar that took Mars by storm a few years ago.
translation: 一杯黏稠的鸡尾酒，献给几年前席卷火星的猫科流行巨星。

original: Tastes like ultimate ninja power. And melon. And citrus. And some other stuff.
translation: 尝起来像是终极忍者之力。还有甜瓜。还有柑橘。还有一些别的东西。

original: A refreshing summer drink enjoyed across Mars and beyond. Any resemblance to shandies or radlers is unintentional.
translation: 一款风靡火星及其他星球的清爽夏日饮品。与任何香迪或拉德勒啤酒的相似之处纯属巧合。

original: An interesting drink invented in the Blue Room Bar and Grill in New Osaka. It's a tasty take on Mexican tepache, made with a beer base.
translation: 一种有趣的饮品，发明于新大阪的蓝屋酒吧烧烤店。这是对墨西哥特帕切酒的美味改良，以啤酒为基底。

original: A popular breakfast drink from New Osaka's bars- for the enterprising day drinker.
translation: 新大阪酒吧里一款广受欢迎的早餐饮品——专为那些有事业心的晨间酒客准备。

original: A weird drink that manages to marry a number of seemingly conflicting flavours into a single harmonious taste.
translation: 一种奇特的饮品，竟能将多种看似冲突的风味融合成和谐统一的口感。

original: Straight out of the pits of a Martian hacking convention.
translation: 来自火星黑客大会的深渊。

original: One of the infinite variations on the White Russian, this drink gets away from the frozen north and into the heat of the ring of fire with a host of toasty coconut flavours.
translation: 白色俄罗斯的无限变体之一，这款饮品摆脱了冰封北地的寒冷，带着一系列温暖的椰子风味，带你进入火焰之环的热浪之中。

original: Take a sip and be transported to the Aloha state. Metaphorically, of course.
translation: 喝上一口，即刻抵达阿罗哈之州。当然，这只是比喻。

original: I mean, who springs for orgeat these days anyway? Korta nut's the new big thing, baby.
translation: 我是说，现在谁还会买杏仁糖浆啊？科塔坚果才是新潮流，宝贝。

original: Considered an acceptable breakfast drink in Little Hawaii.
translation: 在小夏威夷被视为可接受的早餐饮品。

original: It's a tropical vacation in a glass.
translation: 这是一杯热带度假风情。
glass of triple citrus-一杯三味柑橘

original: This drink leaves you feeling nostalgic for some reason.
translation: 这杯饮料不知为何让你感到一丝怀旧。

original: You feel like taking a few golf swings after a few swigs of this.
translation: 喝上几口后，你感觉可以挥几杆高尔夫了。

original: The space doctor's favorite. Guaranteed to restore bodily injury; side effects include cravings and hunger.
translation: 太空医生的最爱。保证能恢复身体损伤；副作用包括渴望和饥饿感。

original: There is not a single drop of alcohol in this thing.
translation: 这里面一滴酒精都没有。

original: A mixture of citrus juices. Tangy, yet smooth.
translation: 混合柑橘果汁。酸爽，却顺滑。
姜汁汽水配加工石榴糖浆。

original: The smell of cucumber from lemonade, I'm sure I won't get poisoned.
translation: 柠檬水里飘出黄瓜的香气，我肯定自己不会中毒。

original: Mullets and cut-up jorts not included.
translation: 不包括鲻鱼头和剪短的牛仔短裤。
blue cherry shake-蓝色樱桃奶昔
strawberry banana smoothie-草莓香蕉奶昔
berry blast smoothie-浆果冲击冰沙
funky monkey smoothie-时髦猴子奶昔
green giant smoothie-绿色巨人奶昔
vanilla dream smoothie-香草梦幻思慕雪

original: Dr. Gibb with ice cream on top.
A classic drink which countless souls have bonded over...
translation: 一杯经典饮品，让无数灵魂在此结缘……

original: A classic drink, freshly made with hand picked berries. Or, maybe not.
translation: 经典饮品，采用手工采摘的浆果新鲜调制。或者，也许并非如此。

original: A classic drink made with chocolate and banana. No monkeys were harmed, officially.
translation: 一款用巧克力和香蕉调制的经典饮品。官方声明，没有猴子受到伤害。

original: A classic drink, if you enjoy juiced wheatgrass and chia seeds.
translation: 经典饮品，如果你喜欢小麦草汁和奇亚籽的话。

original: A wonderfully fresh melon smoothie. Guaranteed to brighten your day.
translation: 一杯美妙新鲜的西瓜奶昔。保证能让您的一天焕发光彩。

original: A classic drink made with vanilla and fresh cream.
translation: 一款用香草和新鲜奶油调制的经典饮品。
glass of Space Cola-一杯太空可乐
glass of Nuka Cola-一杯核子可乐
glass of root beer-一杯根汁汽水
glass of Grey Bull-一杯灰牛
glass of Space Mountain Wind-一杯太空山风
glass of Dr. Gibb-一杯吉布博士
glass of Space-Up-一杯太空汽水
glass of lemon-lime-柠檬青柠味汽水

translation: 一碗用根茎面包制成的辛辣可口浓汤。调味浓郁，非常美味。

translation: 没人知道为什么这碗带鸡蛋和培根的微笑米粥会以一个神话中的中国人物命名——反正一直以来大家都这么叫它。

translation: 面板脱落，露出了框架背板。

original: The cabling need to be cut first!
You begin to weld \the [src], [locked ? "repairing damage" : "preventing retraction"].
[user] begins to unscrew the tram panel from the frame...
translation: [user]开始将电车面板从框架上拧下...

original: [user] wedges \the [attacking_item] into the tram panel's gap in the frame and starts prying...
translation: [user] 将 \the [attacking_item] 楔入电车面板的框架缝隙中，开始撬动……

original: [user] resecures the tram panel to the frame...
translation: [user] 将电车面板重新固定到框架上...

original: [user] starts cutting the connective cabling on \the [src]...
[user] snaps the tram panel into place.
\the [src] locks up due to its servo overheating!
translation: \the [src] 因伺服器过热而卡住了！

original: A lightweight titanium composite structure with titanium silicate panels.
translation: 轻质钛合金复合结构，带有硅酸钛面板。

original: A lightweight titanium composite structure. There is further solid plating where the panels usually attach to the frame.
translation: 轻质钛合金复合结构。面板与框架连接处有额外的加固护板。

original: An evil tram of plasma and titanium.
translation: 邪恶的等离子体与钛合金列车。
一辆纯金电车。太有范儿了！
一辆坚固的银色轨道车。亮闪闪的！

original: A composite structure with diamond-plated panels. Looks awfully sharp...
translation: 一种带有钻石镀层面板的复合结构。看起来锋利得可怕……

original: A composite structure with bananium plating. Honk!
translation: 带有香蕉矿镀层的复合结构。Honk！

original: A composite structure with sandstone plating. Rough.
translation: 一种带有砂岩覆层的复合结构。表面粗糙。

original: A composite structure with uranium plating. This is probably a bad idea.
translation: 带有铀板层的复合结构。这大概不是个好主意。

original: A composite structure with plasma plating. This is definitely a bad idea.
translation: 带有等离子体镀层的复合结构。这绝对是个坏主意。

original: A tram with wooden framing. Flammable. There's a reason we use metal now.
translation: 一辆带有木质框架的轨道车。易燃。这就是我们现在改用金属的原因。

original: A tram with a bamboo framing.
A composite structure with rough iron plating.
translation: 一种带有粗糙铁板的复合结构。

original: A composite structure made of some kind of alien alloy.
translation: 由某种外星合金制成的复合结构。

original: Nanotrasen bought the luxury package under the impression titanium spoilers make the tram go faster. They're just for looks, or potentially stabbing anybody who gets in the way.
translation: 纳米传讯购买了豪华套餐，以为钛合金扰流板能让电车跑得更快。它们只是装饰品，或者可能用来刺伤挡路的人。

original: Perfectly designed to be comfortable to sit on, and hellish to sleep on.
translation: 完美设计，坐着舒适，睡如地狱。

original: [src] violently rams [victim_structure] out of the way!
translation: [src] 暴力地将 [victim_structure] 撞到一边！

original: A lightweight lift platform. It moves.
translation: 一个轻型的升降平台。它会移动。

original: Keeps idiots like you from walking into an open elevator shaft.
translation: 防止像你这样的傻瓜掉进敞开的电梯井里。

original: A lightweight platform. It moves in any direction, except up and down.
translation: 一个轻量级平台。它能在任何方向移动，除了上下方向。

original: The subfloor lattice of the tram. You can build a tram wall frame by using titanium sheets, or place down thermoplastic tram floor tiles.
translation: 电车的下层格栅。你可以使用钛合金板材来建造电车墙壁框架，或者铺设热塑性电车地板砖。

original: An adorable chunk of metal with an alarming amount of firepower designed to crush, immolate, destroy and maim anything that Nanotrasen wants it to. This model contains advanced Bluespace technology which allows a TARDIS-like amount of room on the inside.
translation: 一个可爱的金属块，配备了惊人的火力，旨在碾碎、焚烧、摧毁和残害任何纳米传讯想要它对付的目标。此型号包含先进的蓝空技术，内部拥有类似塔迪斯般的巨大空间。

original: The shooty bit on a tank.
A gigantic wall of metal designed for maximum Xeno destruction. Drag yourself onto it at an entrance to get inside.
translation: 专为最大限度消灭异形而设计的巨型金属墙。在入口处将自己拖上去即可进入。

original: A gigantic wall of metal designed for maximum SOM destruction. Drag yourself onto it at an entrance to get inside.
translation: 专为最大限度摧毁火星之子而设计的巨型金属壁垒。在入口处将自己拖上即可进入。
请求燃烧弹罐装弹（105毫米）
灌木丛猎手机炮穿甲弹盒（30毫米）
灌木丛猎手自动炮高爆弹箱（30毫米）
EM-2600'萨登'穿甲脱壳弹夹（30毫米）

original: A 105mm high explosive shell filled with a deadly explosive payload.
translation: 一枚105毫米高爆弹，装有致命的爆炸装药。

original: A 105mm high explosive shell filled with an incredibly explosive payload.
translation: 一枚105毫米高爆炮弹，装填了威力极强的爆炸装药。

original: A 105mm armor piercing shell with exceptional velocity and penetrating characteristics. Will pierce through walls and targets.
translation: 一枚105毫米穿甲弹，具有卓越的初速和穿透特性。能够穿透墙壁和目标。

original: A 105mm canister shell for demolishing soft targets. The payload of hundreds of small metal balls imitates a shotgun blast in trajectory.
translation: 一枚用于摧毁软目标的105毫米霰弹。其装载的数百颗小金属球在弹道上模仿了霰弹枪的射击效果。

original: A 105mm canister shell for demolishing soft targets. The payload of incendiary shrapnel imitates a shotgun blast in trajectory.
translation: 一枚用于摧毁软目标的105毫米霰弹。其装载的燃烧弹片在弹道上模仿了霰弹枪的射击效果。

original: A primary armament chaingun magazine. Loaded with high velocity, non-IFF rounds.
translation: 主武器链炮弹匣。装填有高速、非敌我识别弹。

original: A 100 round box for an autocannon. Loaded with Armor Piercing rounds.
translation: 一门自动炮的100发弹箱。装载穿甲弹。

original: A 100 round box for an autocannon. Loaded with High Explosive rounds.
translation: 一门自动炮的100发弹箱。装有高爆弹。
一个次要武器机枪弹匣

original: A heavy, disposable cell used for powering a volkite carronade.
translation: 一种重型、一次性电池，用于为火山炮提供动力。

original: A heavy, disposable cell used for powering a tank mounted particle lance.
translation: 一种重型、一次性电池，用于为坦克搭载的粒子炮供能。

original: A secondary armament MLRS magazine. Loaded with homing HE rockets
translation: 次要武器MLRS弹匣。装有自导高爆火箭弹。

original: A set of extremely dense kinetic penetrator rounds for a tank mounted coilgun.
translation: 一套用于坦克线圈炮的极高密度动能穿甲弹。

original: A fuel tank containing fuel for the secondary vehicle mounted flamer. This tank contains a more fluid mix that flows easier but flames less area at once.
translation: 一个装有车载副喷火器燃料的燃料箱。这种燃料箱内的混合物流动性更强，但单次喷射覆盖的面积较小。

original: A 7 round clip for a EM-2600 Autocannon. Loaded with Armor Piercing rounds.
translation: EM-2600 自动炮的 7 发弹夹。装有穿甲弹。

original: A 7 round clip for a EM-2600 Autocannon. Loaded with High Explosive rounds.
translation: EM-2600 自动炮的 7 发弹夹。装有高爆弹。

original: A 76mm HEAT shell filled for targeting hard targets.
translation: 一枚76毫米破甲弹，用于打击硬目标。

original: A 76mm HE shell filled for targeting large groups of soft targets.
translation: 一枚76毫米高爆弹，用于打击大型软目标群。

original: A TOw-III homing missile for the secondary TOW launcher.
translation: 用于副TOW发射器的TOw-III型制导导弹。

original: A 3x2 rack containing high explosive homing microrockets.
translation: 一个3x2的挂架，装有高爆自导微型火箭弹。

original: An antimatter containment chamber containing antimatter for a BFG glob. Do not open at threat of exploding.
translation: 一个装有反物质用于BFG弹丸的反物质约束舱。切勿打开，否则有爆炸危险。

original: An unarmed command APC designed to command and transport troops in the battlefield.
translation: 一款用于战场指挥和运输部队的非武装指挥型装甲运兵车。

original: Toggle Strafing. Disabled when Alt is held.
Yell at the admin that spawned this in please.
translation: 请向生成这个的管理员投诉。

original: A module that enhances the speed of armored combat vehicles by increasing fuel efficiency.
translation: 提升装甲战斗车辆速度的模块，通过提高燃油效率实现。

original: A module that increases the carrying capacity of a vehicle with extra seats.
translation: 提升车辆载客量的模块，增加额外座位。

original: Allows gunners to see further while looking through it. Weapons cannot be used while looking through it.
translation: 允许射手在透过它观察时看得更远。透过它观察时无法使用武器。

original: Allows the driver to launch a smokescreen in front of the tank.
translation: 允许驾驶员在坦克前方释放烟雾弹幕。

original: Allows the driver to briefly electrify the vehicle's hull. Good for unwanted guests.
translation: 允许驾驶员短暂电击载具外壳。适用于不速之客。

original: A medical interior package, stocked with a operating table and a medical vendor.
translation: 医疗舱内装包，配备手术台和医疗贩卖机。

original: A clone interior package, designed for the rapid production of cheap clone soldiers.
translation: 克隆舱内部组件套装，专为快速生产廉价克隆士兵而设计。

original: A TGMC vehicle's main turret cannon. It fires 86mm rocket propelled shells
translation: 一门地球政府殖民地海军陆战队载具的主炮塔火炮。它发射86毫米火箭推进炮弹。

original: A robotically controlled minigun that spews lead.
translation: 一门由机器人控制的、喷射铅弹的迷你炮。

original: A Bushwhacker 30mm Autocannon for vehicular use.
translation: 丛林猎手30毫米自动炮，用于车载武器。

original: A double barrelled cannon which can rapidly deploy utility packages to the battlefield.
translation: 一门双管火炮，可向战场快速部署实用装备包。

original: A large, vehicle mounted flamer. This one is capable of spraying it's payload due to a less solid mix.
translation: 一门大型车载喷火器。由于混合燃料的固态成分较少，它能够喷洒其有效载荷。

original: A single-shot, homing, vehicle-mounted TOW-III launcher designed for precision strikes against armored targets. Equipped with IFF.
translation: 单发、自寻的、车载式陶氏III型发射器，专为精确打击装甲目标设计。配备敌我识别系统。

original: A TGMC secondary vehicle-mounted multiple launch rocket system with a total of 6 homing microrockets. Capable of unleashing its entire payload in rapid succession.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队（TGMC）的副武器车载多管火箭发射系统，共搭载6枚制导微型火箭弹。能够快速连续发射全部弹药。

original: A crackling energy weapon, a slightly scaled up model of the classic BFG 9000. Point at people who killed your rabbit.
translation: 一把噼啪作响的能量武器，经典BFG 9000的略微放大版。用它对准那些杀了你兔子的人。

original: A 30mm Autocannon for the LVRT 'Fallow'. A surprisingly powerful autocannon. Sadly, beltfeeding system was lost in the slew of budget cuts related to the system. It is loaded with 4 round clips.
translation: LVRT'休耕地'的30毫米自动炮。一门威力惊人的自动炮。遗憾的是，由于该系统相关的预算削减浪潮，其弹链供弹系统已不复存在。它使用4发弹夹供弹。

original: A 76mm low velocity cannon for the LVRT 'Fallow'. It has slow travel speed and solid explosive performance. It is loaded with 76mm shells.
translation: LVRT'休耕地'使用的76毫米低速火炮。射速缓慢，但爆炸威力强劲。使用76毫米炮弹装填。

original: A beltfed coaxial with ICC markings that spews lead. Requires the Barrel shroud and power system of a vehicle to use in any way shape and form. Can use either standard ML-41 Boxes or vehicle specific boxes.
translation: 一条带有ICC标记的带式供弹同轴机枪，喷射铅弹。需要车辆的枪管护套和动力系统才能以任何形式使用。可使用标准ML-41弹药箱或车辆专用弹药箱。

original: The Light Vehicle, Recce, Tracked 'Fallow' is an ICC reconnaissance vehicle built to go fast in order to scout out and poke at enemy positions. Accepts either a low velocity tank cannon or a SARDEN as armament.
translation: 轻型侦察履带车'休耕'是一款ICC侦察车辆，专为高速机动设计，用于侦察和袭扰敌方阵地。可选择配备低速坦克炮或SARDEN作为武器。

original: A gun breech used for loading large caliber rounds into the main gun.
translation: 用于将大口径炮弹装填进主炮的炮闩。

original: A feeding mechanism for loading ammo into the secondary weapon.
translation: 用于向副武器装填弹药的供弹机构。

original: A feeding mechanism for loading ammo into the vehicle's coaxial feed.
translation: 用于向车辆同轴供弹系统装填弹药的供弹机构。

original: A periscope for viewing the outside of the vehicle. Resist or move to stop looking through it.
translation: 用于观察车辆外部的潜望镜。抵抗或移动以停止观察。

original: A heavily armoured vehicle with light armaments designed to ferry troops around the battlefield, or assist with search and rescue (SAR) operations.
translation: 一款重型装甲车辆，配备轻型武器，设计用于在战场上运送部队或协助搜救行动。

original: A metal behemoth which is designed to cleave through enemy lines. It comes pre installed with a main tank cannon capable of deploying heavy payloads, as well as a minigun which can tear through multiple targets in quick succession.
translation: 一台金属巨兽，专为撕裂敌军防线而设计。它预装了主战坦克炮，能够投送重型有效载荷，以及一门可快速连续撕裂多个目标的加特林机枪。

original: A miniaturized replica of a popular personnel carrier. For ages 5 and up.
translation: 一款流行人员运输车的迷你模型。适合5岁以上儿童。

original: The particle lance is a powerful energy beam weapon, able to tear apart anything in its path with a concentrated beam of charged particles. Particularly potent against armored targets.
translation: 粒子长矛是一种强大的能量光束武器，能够用集中的带电粒子束撕裂路径上的一切。对装甲目标尤其有效。

original: A pair of forward facing multiple launch rocket systems with a total of 12 homing rockets. Can unleash its entire payload in rapid succession.
translation: 一套前向多管火箭发射系统，总计12枚制导火箭。可快速连续发射全部弹药。

original: A terrifying behemoth, the Malleus pattern hover tank is the SOM's main battle tank. Combining excellent mobility and formidable weaponry, it has earned a fearsome reputation among TerraGov forces that have faced it.
translation: 一种可怕的巨兽，马勒斯型悬浮坦克是火星之子的主战坦克。它结合了出色的机动性和强大的火力，在曾面对过它的地球政府部队中赢得了可怕的声誉。

original: A large automated 3D printer for producing new vehicle parts and maintaining old ones.
translation: 一台大型自动化3D打印机，用于制造新载具部件并维护旧部件。

original: An unarmed MRAP designed to transport troops across the battlefield quickly and safely.
translation: 一款无武装的防地雷反伏击车，旨在快速安全地运送部队穿越战场。

original: An all-terrain vehicle built for traversing rough terrain with ease. One of the few old-Earth technologies that are still relevant on most planet-bound outposts.
translation: 专为轻松穿越崎岖地形而设计的全地形车。少数几种在大多数行星前哨站仍具实用价值的旧地球技术之一。

original: A TGMC heavy motorbike. Used to swiftly carry up to 2 soldiers over the roughest of terrain, at high speed and with respectable survivibility. Is typically armed with a pair of forwarded mounted weapons. Favoured for rapid assaults.
translation: 一辆地球政府殖民地海军陆战队重型摩托车。用于在崎岖地形上高速运送最多2名士兵，具备可观的生存能力。通常配备一对前向固定武器。适用于快速突击。

original: A ridable electric car designed for pulling cargo trolleys.
translation: 一款可骑乘的电动小车，专为牵引货物拖车而设计。

original: A keyring with a small steel key, and a yellow fob reading \"Choo Choo!\".
translation: 一把钥匙环，上面挂着一把小钢钥匙和一个黄色钥匙扣，上面写着'Choo Choo!'。

original: You push against the back of \the [src]'s trunk to try and get out.
translation: 你用力推着\the [src]的后备箱试图爬出来。

original: The people stuck in [src]'s trunk all come tumbling out.
translation: 困在[src]后备箱里的人全都滚了出来。

original: A SOM light hovercraft. Used to swiftly carry up to 2 soldiers over the roughest of terrain, or light defences. Is typically armed with a pair of forwarded mounted weapons. Favoured for rapid assaults.
translation: 火星之子轻型悬浮载具。用于在崎岖地形或轻型防御工事上快速运送最多2名士兵。通常配备一对前向固定武器。适用于快速突击。

original: Equipment control unit has been rebooted successfully.
translation: 装备控制单元已成功重启。

original: You're in the wrong seat to interact with your hands.
translation: 你坐的位置不对，无法用手操作。

original: You don't know how to pilot this
A mecha repair pack, consisting of various auto-extinguisher systems, materials and repair nano-scarabs.
translation: 一套机甲维修包，包含多种自动灭火系统、材料和维修纳米甲虫。

original: A lightweight, security exosuit. Popular among private and corporate security.
translation: 轻量型安保外骨骼。在私人和企业安保中颇受欢迎。

original: A lightweight exosuit, painted in a dark scheme. This model appears to have some modifications.
translation: 一套轻量化外骨骼，采用深色涂装。此型号似乎经过了一些改装。

original: Heavy-duty, combat exosuit, developed after the Durand model. Rarely found among civilian populations.
translation: 重型战斗外骨骼，基于杜兰德模型开发。在平民中极为罕见。

original: Heavy-duty, command-type exosuit. This is a custom model, utilized only by high-ranking military personnel.
translation: 重型指挥型动力外骨骼。这是定制型号，仅供高级军事人员使用。

original: Heavy-duty, combat exosuit, developed off of the existing Marauder model.
translation: 重型战斗外骨骼，基于现有'掠夺者'型号开发。

original: your punches will now deal brute damage
translation: 你的拳击现在会造成钝击伤害

original: your punches will now deal burn damage
translation: 你的拳击现在会造成灼烧伤害

original: your punches will now deal toxin damage
translation: 你的拳击现在会造成毒素伤害
重新配置手臂微工具阵列

original: This is a Phazon exosuit. The pinnacle of scientific research and pride of Nanotrasen, it uses cutting edge bluespace technology and expensive materials.
translation: 这是一台法扎恩动力外骨骼。这是纳米传讯科学研究的巅峰与骄傲，它采用了最前沿的蓝空科技和昂贵的材料。

original: You need to wait [DisplayTimeText(timeleft, 1)] before attempting to Skyfall.
translation: 你需要等待 [DisplayTimeText(timeleft, 1)] 才能尝试使用天降。

original: The tremors from [chassis] landing sends you flying!
[chassis] crashes down on you from above!
You need to wait [DisplayTimeText(timeleft, 1)] before firing another Ivanov Strike.
translation: 你需要等待 [DisplayTimeText(timeleft, 1)] 才能再次发射伊万诺夫打击。

original: [chassis] clicks and whirrs for a moment, with a low hum emerging from the legs.
translation: [chassis] 咔嗒作响并嗡鸣了片刻，腿部发出低沉的嗡鸣声。

original: [chassis] begins to shake, the sounds of electricity growing louder.
[chassis] assumes a pose as it rattles violently.
translation: [chassis] 剧烈震动，摆出一个姿势。

original: [chassis] sparks and shutters as it finalizes preparation.
translation: [chassis] 火花四溅，机体震颤，最终完成准备。
导弹模式开启（点击选择目标）

original: An insanely overbulked mecha that handily crushes single-pilot opponents. The price is that you need two pilots to use it.
translation: 一台体型异常庞大的机甲，能轻松碾压单驾驶员对手。代价是需要两名驾驶员才能操作。

original: A holographic projection designating the landing zone of something. It's probably best to stand back.
translation: 一个全息投影，标示着某物的着陆区。最好还是站远点。

original: You are unable to attach [src] to [M]!
Error -- Equipment control unit is unresponsive.
translation: 错误——装备控制单元无响应。

original: Determines boosting speed and power. Balanced option. Sets dash consumption to 200 and dash range to 3, and boost consumption per step to 50.
translation: 决定冲刺速度和力量。平衡选项。将冲刺消耗设为200，冲刺距离设为3，每步冲刺消耗设为50。

original: Determines boosting speed and power. Lightweight option. Sets dash consumption to 300 and dash range to 4, and boost consumption per step to 25. Provides about half the speed boost.
translation: 决定冲刺速度和力量。轻量化选项。将冲刺消耗设为300，冲刺距离设为4，每步冲刺消耗设为25。提供约一半的速度加成。

original: An advanced Nanotrasen phoron engine core prototype designed for TGMC advanced mech exosuits. Optimimized for energy storage.
translation: 一款为地球政府殖民地海军陆战队先进机甲外骨骼设计的先进纳米传讯等离子体引擎核心原型。针对能量存储进行了优化。

original: A highly experimental phoron fusion core. Optimized for energy generation.
translation: 一个高度实验性的等离子体聚变核心。专为能量生成优化。

original: A bluespace orion-sperkov converter. Through science you can't be bothered to understand, makes mechs faster and their weapons able to draw more power, making them more dangerous. However this comes at the cost of not being able to use projectile and laser weaponry.
translation: 一个蓝空间猎户座-斯佩尔科夫转换器。通过你懒得去理解的科学原理，它能让机甲更快，并使它们的武器能够汲取更多能量，从而更具威胁性。然而，其代价是无法使用弹道和激光武器。

original: A magnifying module that allows the pilot to see much further than with the standard optics. Night vision not included.
translation: 一个放大模块，能让驾驶员看得比标准光学设备远得多。不包含夜视功能。

original: A tanglefoot smoke generator capable of dispensing large amounts of non-lethal gas that saps the energy from any xenoform creatures it touches.
translation: 一种能够释放大量非致命性气体的缠足烟雾发生器，会吸干任何接触到的异形生物的能量。

original: A multiple launch module that generates a large amount of cloaking smoke to disguise nearby friendlies. Sadly, huge robots are too difficult to hide with it.
translation: 一种多管发射模块，能产生大量遮蔽烟雾来掩护附近的友军。可惜的是，巨大的机器人用它来隐藏还是太困难了。

original: A laser core that allows a core purge to emit a burst of lasers around the mecha. Slows mecha while charging.
translation: 一个激光核心，允许核心净化时在机甲周围发射激光爆发。充能时会减慢机甲速度。

original: A mech stealth cloaking device. Cannot fire while cloaked, and cloaking drains energy.
translation: 机甲隐形装置。隐形时无法开火，且隐形会消耗能量。

original: A mech overboost device. Allows overloading the leg accumulators to dash in a direction, throwing back anyone hit by the mech.
translation: 机甲过载推进装置。允许超载腿部蓄能器向指定方向冲刺，击退被机甲撞到的任何人。

original: A mech module that when activated, creates a shield that slowly decays. Costs energy to activate.
translation: 一个机甲模块，激活时会产生一个缓慢衰减的护盾。激活需要消耗能量。

original: [icon2html(src, user)][span_danger("[src] is too durable to drill through.")]
translation: [icon2html(src, user)][span_danger("[src] is too durable to drill through.")]
金刚石钻头外骨骼钻机

original: Equipment for engineering and combat exosuits. This is the drill that'll pierce the heavens!
translation: 工程与战斗外骨骼装备。这是能刺穿苍穹的钻头！

original: Equipment for engineering and combat exosuits. This is an upgraded version of the drill that'll pierce the heavens!
translation: 工程与战斗外骨骼装备。这是能刺穿天际的升级版钻头！

original: [icon2html(src, user)][span_warning("[fuel] traces in target minimal! [P] cannot be used as fuel.")]
translation: [icon2html(src, user)][span_warning("[fuel] traces in target minimal! [P] cannot be used as fuel.")]
护甲增强模块（近战武器）
护甲增强模块（远程武器）

original: Boosts exosuit armor against melee attacks
translation: 提升外骨骼装甲对近战攻击的防御力

original: Boosts exosuit armor against ranged attacks. Completely blocks taser shots.
translation: 提升外骨骼装甲对远程攻击的防御力。完全阻挡电击枪射击。

original: An automated repair droid for exosuits. Scans for damage and repairs it. Can fix almost all types of external or internal damage.
translation: 一款用于外骨骼的自动维修机器人。扫描并修复损伤。能够修复几乎所有类型的外部或内部损伤。

original: An exosuit module that generates power using solid plasma as fuel. Pollutes the environment.
translation: 一种使用固态等离子体作为燃料产生动力的外骨骼模块。会污染环境。

original: No further supplies can be provided to [M].
No providable supplies found in cargo hold
translation: 货舱内未找到可提供的补给

translation: [icon2html(src, source)][span_warning("Not enough room in cargo compartment!")]

original: [icon2html(src, source)][span_notice("You push [target] out of the way.")]
translation: [icon2html(src, source)][span_notice("You push [target] out of the way.")]

original: You longingly wish to tear [M]'s arms off.
translation: 你渴望将[M]的双臂撕扯下来。

original: Refill failed. No compatible tank found.
translation: 补充失败。未找到兼容气罐。

original: [chassis] lifts [target] and starts to load it into cargo compartment.
translation: [chassis] 抬起 [target] 并开始将其装载到货舱中。

original: [chassis] tosses [target] like a piece of paper!
translation: [chassis] 像扔纸片一样把 [target] 甩了出去！
[chassis] 撕掉了 [target] 的胳膊和腿！

original: Equipment for engineering exosuits. Lifts objects and loads them into cargo.
translation: 工程外骨骼装备。可抬起物体并装载至货舱。

original: They won't know what clamped them! This time for real!
translation: 他们根本不知道是什么抓住了他们！这次可是动真格的！

original: They won't know what clamped them!
translation: 他们根本不知道是什么抓住了他们！

original: Equipment for engineering exosuits. A rapid-firing high capacity fire extinguisher.
translation: 工程外骨骼装备。一款速射大容量火焰灭火器。

original: [icon2html(src, chassis.occupants)][span_warning("Unable to dash while in zoom mode!")]
translation: [icon2html(src, chassis.occupants)][span_warning("Unable to dash while in zoom mode!")]
\improper 亥伯龙重型火箭发射器
\improper 阿斯特里亚微型火箭吊舱

original: The smallest weapon available to mechs. It packs a small punch, but allows the mech to achieve higher mobility.
translation: 机甲可用的最小型武器。威力不大，但能让机甲获得更高的机动性。

original: A burstfiring weapon fitted for mechs. Offers higher mobility and accuracy than larger weapons, but reduced damage.
translation: 为机甲配备的连发武器。相比大型武器，机动性和精度更高，但伤害较低。

original: As the smallest autofiring weapon, it offers improved mobility but less firepower than most of it's larger cousins.
translation: 作为最小的自动射击武器，它提供了比大多数大型同类武器更好的机动性，但火力较弱。

original: Medium-sized mech assault weapon. Similar to the Cronus assault rifle, but fires in bursts.
translation: 中型机甲突击武器。类似克洛诺斯突击步枪，但以点射模式开火。

original: The stock-and-standard extra-sized multipurpose rifle for TGMC mech units.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队机甲部队标配的加大尺寸多用途步枪。

original: The TGMC classic weapon, but bigger and better! Fires plus-sized buckshot for high damage in close combat.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的经典武器，但更大更强！发射加号尺寸的鹿弹，在近战中造成高额伤害。

original: A massive hulk of metal that fires base-bleed LMG rounds. Like the standard LMG, but bigger, better and heavier.
translation: 一个巨大的金属块，发射底排式轻机枪子弹。就像标准轻机枪一样，但更大、更好、更重。

original: A drum-fed autocannon that fires fragmentation rounds that burst in a frontal cone when the bullet impacts. Extra effective against clusters of enemies.
translation: 一种弹鼓供弹的自动炮，发射破片弹，弹道命中时会在前方锥形区域内爆炸。对集群敌人特别有效。

original: Standard mech laser rifle. Does not require amnmo refills and shoots highly accurate lasers that immediately hit, but deals slightly less damage compared to similar weapons.
translation: 标准机甲激光步枪。无需补充弹药，发射高精度激光，能够立即命中目标，但相比同类武器造成的伤害略低。

original: A laser projector, capable of burstfiring. Does not require amnmo refills and shoots highly accurate lasers that immediately hit, but deals slightly less damage compared to similar weapons.
translation: 激光投影器，能够进行点射。无需补充弹药，发射高精度激光，可立即命中目标，但与同类武器相比造成的伤害略低。

original: Standard mech laser SMG. Does not require amnmo refills and shoots highly accurate lasers that immediately hit, but deals slightly less damage compared to similar weapons. More mobile than the laser rifle.
translation: 标准机甲激光冲锋枪。无需补充弹药，发射高精度激光，可立即命中目标，但相比同类武器伤害略低。比激光步枪更灵活。

original: Nothing says \"Go to hell\" like a tank cannon mounted on a war robot. Packs a big punch despite needing a reload after each shot.
translation: 没有什么比装在战争机器人上的坦克炮更能表达'下地狱去吧'的意思了。尽管每发之后都需要重新装填，但威力巨大。

original: Mobility isn't needed when you can just hide behind a hail of bullets! Requires windup before firing.
translation: 当你能够躲在弹幕之后时，机动性就不再是必需品！发射前需要蓄力。

original: A anti-tank rifle only capable of being wielded by mechs. Originally designed for fighting small armored vehicles, but works just as well against similarly sized creatures. Has IFF.
translation: 一款仅限机甲使用的反坦克步枪。最初设计用于对抗小型装甲车辆，但对体型相近的生物同样有效。配备敌我识别系统。

original: The TGMC's definitive answer to whether a bigger boom is better. Fires heavy AP rockets.
translation: 地球政府殖民地海军陆战队对于'爆炸越大越好'这一问题的最终答案。发射重型穿甲火箭。

original: A specialized flamer for mounting on mechs. Bad mobility, but the additional napalm more than makes up for it.
translation: 一种专为机甲设计的喷火器。机动性较差，但额外的凝固汽油足以弥补这一缺陷。

original: A mech missile pod. Does not hold a lot of spare ammo and requires frequent external refills. But hey, exploding missiles all the way!
translation: 一个机甲导弹舱。备用弹药不多，需要频繁从外部补充。不过嘛，爆炸导弹一路走起！

original: A mech micromissile pod. Launches a barrage of microrockets that home on the target.
translation: 一个机甲微型导弹舱。发射一连串微型火箭，可自动追踪目标。

original: A specialized mech laser blade made out of plasma. Its compact size allows fast, short-ranged attacks. When activated, overloads the leg actuators to dash forward, before cutting with the superheated plasma beam.
translation: 一种由等离子体制成的专用机甲激光刃。其紧凑的尺寸允许快速、短程的攻击。激活时，会使腿部执行器过载向前冲刺，然后用超热的等离子体光束进行切割。

original: A spear made of compressed energy for the TGMC Combat Mech. A melee weapon for strong defense at short-to-medium range. Extends a spear of superheated plasma upon activation, piericing everything in its path. A melee core will increase both its range and power. It is a top-of-the-line melee weapon of TGMC's fine line of mecha close-range offensive capability.
translation: 为地球政府殖民地海军陆战队战斗机甲设计的压缩能量长矛。一种用于中短距离强力防御的近战武器。激活时会延伸出一支超高温等离子体长矛，刺穿路径上的一切。近战核心将同时提升其射程和威力。这是地球政府殖民地海军陆战队精良机甲近战攻击能力系列中的顶级近战武器。

original: You cannot flatten the ammo box until it's empty!
translation: 弹药箱清空前无法压扁！
一箱轻型加农炮弹道弹药

original: A box of ammo for an unknown weapon.
A box of incendiary ammunition for use with exosuit weapons.
translation: 一箱用于外骨骼武器的燃烧弹药。

original: A box of scaled-up buckshot, for use in exosuit shotguns.
translation: 一盒放大尺寸的鹿弹，用于外骨骼霰弹枪。

original: A box of linked ammunition, designed for the Ultra AC 2 exosuit weapon.
translation: 一箱链接式弹药，专为超速自动炮2型外骨骼武器设计。

original: A box of large missiles, ready for loading into a BRM-6 exosuit missile rack.
translation: 一箱大型导弹，已准备就绪，可装入BRM-6外骨骼导弹发射架。

original: A box of large missiles, ready for loading into an SRM-8 exosuit missile rack.
translation: 一箱大型导弹，准备装入SRM-8外骨骼导弹发射架。

original: A box of smooth flashbangs, for use with a large exosuit launcher. Cannot be primed by hand.
translation: 一盒光滑的闪光弹，用于大型外骨骼发射器。无法手动启动。

original: A box of clustered flashbangs, for use with a specialized exosuit cluster launcher. Cannot be primed by hand.
translation: 一盒集束闪光弹，专为特种外骨骼集束发射器设计。无法手动引爆。

original: A box of rather large LMG bullets.
translation: 一盒相当大的轻机枪弹道弹药。

original: A box of large rocket-assisted rifle bullets. it has \"DO NOT USE AS FIRECRACKERS\" written on the side.
translation: 一盒大型火箭助推步枪子弹。侧面写着'请勿用作鞭炮'。

original: A box of large rocket-assisted burstrifle bullets. it has \"DO NOT USE AS FIRECRACKERS\" written on the side.
translation: 一盒大型火箭助推连发步枪弹道弹药。侧面写着'请勿用作鞭炮'。

original: A box of large shotgun shells. Sadly they only fit into mech-sized weapons.
translation: 一盒大型霰弹枪弹。可惜它们只能装进机甲尺寸的武器。

original: A box of light cannon shells. For being light the box is rather heavy.
translation: 一箱轻型加农炮弹。说是轻型，但这箱子相当沉重。

original: A massive tank shell for loading into mech cannons.
translation: 用于装填机甲火炮的大型坦克炮弹。

original: A box of normal SMG bullets, but bigger!
translation: 一盒普通冲锋枪弹道弹，但更大！
一盒冲锋手枪弹道弹药。

original: Bigger version of the small pistol bullets most marines use.
translation: 比大多数陆战队员使用的小型手枪弹道更大的版本。

original: A TGMC mech missile. You probably shouldnt hit the pointy end with anything.
translation: 一枚地球政府殖民地海军陆战队的机甲导弹。你大概不该用任何东西去碰它的尖头。

original: Unfortunately for you, every bullet that comes out of the vulcan cannon must also be loaded into it.
translation: 可惜的是，从火神炮射出的每一发弹道弹药都必须事先装填进去。

original: A box of anti-tank bullets for shooting at small armored vehicles, and small armored creatures.
translation: 一盒反坦克弹道弹药，用于射击小型装甲车辆和小型装甲生物。

original: A rack filled with rows of grenades secured with plastic.
translation: 一个装满手雷的架子，手雷用塑料固定。

original: A specialized fuel tank designed for refilling TGMC standard issue mech flamers.
translation: 专为补充地球政府殖民地海军陆战队标准机甲喷火器燃料而设计的专用燃料罐。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Shoots incendiary bullets.
translation: 一款用于战斗外骨骼的武器。发射燃烧弹道弹药。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Shoots a spread of pellets.
translation: 一款用于战斗外骨骼的武器。发射散射弹丸。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Shoots a rapid, three shot burst.
translation: 一款用于战斗外骨骼的武器。可进行快速的三连发射击。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Launches light explosive missiles.
translation: 一款用于战斗外骨骼的武器。发射轻型爆炸导弹。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Launches low-explosive breaching missiles designed to explode only when striking a sturdy target.
translation: 一种用于战斗外骨骼的武器。发射低爆破门导弹，设计为仅在撞击坚固目标时爆炸。

original: A weapon for combat exosuits. Launches primed flashbangs.
translation: 一款用于战斗外骨骼的武器。可发射已激活的闪光弹。

original: This port recharges a mech's internal power cell.
translation: 这个端口可为机甲内部电池充电。

original: Displays the status of mechs connected to the recharge station.
translation: 显示与充电站连接的机甲状态。

original: You're in the wrong seat to control movement.
translation: 你坐错位置了，无法控制移动。
正在从 [chassis.use_internal_tank ? "internal airtank" : "environment"] 抽取空气

original: Toggle Strafing. Disabled when Alt is held.
translation: 切换扫射模式。按住Alt键时禁用。
重新装填已装备的武器

original: Used to remotely locate or lockdown exosuits.
translation: 用于远程定位或锁定外骨骼。

original: Device used to transmit exosuit data.
translation: 用于传输外骨骼数据的设备。

original: A device used to transmit exosuit data. Also allows active AI units to take control of said exosuit.
translation: 用于传输外骨骼数据的设备。也允许活跃的AI单位控制该外骨骼。

translation: [icon2html(src, occupants)][span_boldnotice("Damaged internal tank has been sealed.")]

original: Error -- Connection to equipment control unit has been lost.
translation: 错误——与设备控制单元的连接已断开。
维护协议已被操作员禁用。

original: There's already a power cell installed!
translation: 已经安装了一个能量电池！

original: There's already a scanning module installed!
translation: 已经安装了一个扫描模块！

original: You open the hatch to the power unit.
translation: 你打开了动力单元的舱门。

original: You close the hatch to the power unit.
translation: 你关上了动力单元的舱门。

original: This box of ammo is empty!
You can't fit any more ammo of this type!
translation: 这种类型的弹药已经装不下了！

original: None of the equipment on this exosuit can use this ammo!
translation: 这身外骨骼上的任何装备都无法使用这种弹药！
[user] [hit_verb][plural_s(hit_verb)] [src] 使用 [attacking_item][damage_taken ? "." : ", without leaving a mark!"]

original: Access denied. [name] is secured with a DNA lock.
translation: 访问被拒绝。[name] 已通过DNA锁锁定。
访问被拒绝。操作密钥码不足。

original: You cannot get in the [src], it has been destroyed!
translation: 你无法进入[src]，它已被摧毁！

original: You can't enter the exosuit while buckled.
translation: 你被固定时无法进入外骨骼。

original: You can't enter the exosuit with other creatures attached to you!
translation: 你不能在其它生物附着于你身上时进入外骨骼！

original: Something on your back prevents you from entering the mech!
translation: 你背上的东西让你无法进入机甲！

original: You begin the ejection procedure. Equipment is disabled during this process. Hold still to finish ejecting.
translation: 你开始弹射程序。此过程中设备将被禁用。保持静止以完成弹射。

original: You stop exiting the mech. Weapons are enabled again.
translation: 你停止了离开机甲。武器已重新启用。

translation: [icon2html(src, occupants)][span_warning("Air port connection has been severed!")]

translation: [icon2html(src, occupants)][span_warning("Unable to move while connected to the air system port!")]

translation: [icon2html(src, occupants)][span_warning("Unable to move while in zoom mode!")]

translation: [icon2html(src, occupants)][span_warning("A dull, universal force is preventing you from [phasing] here!")]

translation: \The [src] 粘在你手上了，你无法把它放进 \the [M]！

里普利中央控制模块（外骨骼主板）

original: Gygax Weapon Control and Targeting module (Exosuit Board)
translation: 吉格斯武器控制与瞄准模块（外骨骼控制板）
吉格斯中央控制模块（外骨骼主板）
杜兰德外设控制模块（外骨骼主板）

original: Durand Weapon Control and Targeting module (Exosuit Board)
translation: 杜兰德武器控制与瞄准模块（外骨骼主板）
杜兰德中央控制模块（外骨骼主板）
H.O.N.K 外设控制模块（外骨骼主板）

original: A pair of 20mm autocannons, designed to be mounted on light vehicles such as the heavy motorbike. It packs a heavy punch, providing formidable firepower and a large internal magazine.
translation: 一对20毫米自动炮，设计用于安装在重型摩托车等轻型载具上。它威力强大，提供可观的杀伤力和大容量内置弹匣。

original: A small grey key for starting and operating ATVs.
translation: 用于启动和操作全地形车的小型灰色钥匙。

original: A keyring with a small steel key, and a rubber stun baton accessory.
translation: 一个钥匙环，上面挂着一把小钢钥匙和一个橡胶电击警棍配件。

original: You begin to detach the wheels...
You detach the wheels and deconstruct the chair.
translation: 你拆下轮子并拆解了椅子。

original: A chair with big wheels. It looks like you can move in this on your own.
translation: 一把带大轮子的椅子。看起来你可以自己坐着它移动。

original: A sturdy wheelchair fitted with a minigun. Your legs may have failed you, but your weapon won't.
translation: 一把装有迷你机枪的坚固轮椅。你的双腿或许已经不行了，但你的武器不会。

original: A pool of weak viscous acid that solidifies quickly when removed from the pool. Swimming is not recommended due to the lack of a lifeguard.
translation: 一滩稀薄的粘稠酸液，离开酸液池后会迅速凝固。由于没有救生员，不建议在此游泳。

original: You sense your acid well at [A.name] has been destroyed!
translation: 你感知到你在[A.name]处的酸液井已被摧毁！

original: We add acid to [src]. It is currently has [charges] / [XENO_ACID_WELL_MAX_CHARGES] charges.
translation: 我们向[src]添加酸液。它目前拥有[charges] / [XENO_ACID_WELL_MAX_CHARGES] 点充能。
需要[XENO_ACID_WELL_FILL_COST - xeno_attacker.plasma_stored]更多等离子体

当前拥有 [charges] / [XENO_ACID_WELL_MAX_CHARGES] 点酸液储量

original: An acid well. It stores acid to put out fires.
translation: 一个酸液井。它储存酸液用于扑灭火焰。

original: We reach into \the [src], but only find dregs of resin. We should wait some more.
translation: 我们把手伸进\the [src]，却只找到一些树脂残渣。我们应该再等一会儿。

original: A large resin pod. Inside is a thick, viscous fluid that looks like it doesnt burn easily.
translation: 一个大型树脂荚。内部是浓稠的粘性液体，看起来不易燃烧。

original: A deep hole in the ground. Its walls are coated with resin and you see the occasional vent or fang.
translation: 地面上的一个深坑。坑壁覆盖着树脂，你能看到偶尔出现的通风口或尖牙。

original: A hole in the ground. Its walls are coated with resin and there is some smoke billowing out.
translation: 地上的一个洞。洞壁覆盖着树脂，有烟雾从中涌出。

original: A mash of bone, rock, and lots of resin.
translation: 骨头、岩石和大量树脂的混合物。

original: It bulges with whatever is inside it.
translation: 它因内部的东西而鼓胀。

original: A resin formation that looks like a small pillar. A faint, weird smell can be perceived from it.
translation: 一个看起来像小柱子的树脂构造。可以从中闻到一股微弱而奇怪的气味。

original: A resin pillar with a purple orb on the top. It pulsates with a faint hum.
translation: 一根顶端带有紫色球体的树脂柱。它随着微弱的嗡鸣声脉动。

original: A resin monument to your tresspass. Alerts the xenomorph hive when an enemy approaches.
translation: 你入侵的树脂纪念碑。当敌人接近时会向异形蜂巢发出警报。

original: A slimy, oozy resin bed filled with foul-looking egg-like ...things.
translation: 一个黏滑、渗液的树脂床，里面填满了看起来恶心的蛋状……东西。

original: A slimy, oozy resin bed filled with foul-looking egg-like ...things.
translation: 一个黏滑、渗液的树脂床，里面填满了看起来恶心的蛋状……东西。
无法插入死亡的抱脸虫

original: It looks like a hiding hole.
Select a tunnel to go to.
[M] begins heaving their huge bulk down into \the [src].
translation: [M] 开始将其庞大的身躯沉入 \the [src]。
无法在无法移动时进入

original: A tunnel entrance. Looks like it was dug by some kind of clawed beast.
translation: 一个隧道入口。看起来像是某种带爪的野兽挖掘出来的。

original: A menacing looking construct of resin, it seems to be alive. It fires acid against intruders.
translation: 一个由树脂构成的威胁性构造体，它似乎具有生命。它会向入侵者喷射酸液。

original: A menacing looking construct of resin, it seems to be alive. It fires resin against intruders.
translation: 一个由树脂构成的威胁性构造体，它似乎具有生命。它会向入侵者发射树脂。

original: A menacing looking construct of resin, it seems to be alive. It fires huggers against intruders.
translation: 一个由树脂构成的威胁性构造体，它似乎具有生命。它会向入侵者发射抱脸虫。

original: We feel a sudden soothing chill as [src] tends to our wounds.
translation: 我们感到一阵突如其来的舒缓凉意，[src]正在处理我们的伤口。

original: [src] bursts, releasing a strong gust of pressurised gas!
translation: [src] 爆裂开来，释放出一股强烈的加压气体！

original: We shed our shattered scales as new ones grow to replace them!
translation: 我们褪去破碎的鳞片，新生的鳞甲将取而代之！

original: But our body rejects the fruit, we do not share the same plasma type!
translation: 但我们的身体排斥这果实，我们的等离子体类型并不相同！

original: [src] Restores our plasma reserves, our organism is on overdrive!
translation: [src] 恢复了我们的等离子体储备，我们的机体正在超负荷运转！
你轻抚[src]的花瓣，什么也没发生。

original: [src] soft light shimmers, we should give it more time to recover!
translation: [src] 的柔和光芒在闪烁，我们应该给它更多时间恢复！

original: The pollen from [src] reacts with our scales, we are blending with our surroundings!
translation: [src]的花粉与我们的鳞片发生反应，我们正在与周围环境融为一体！
[src] 爆裂开来，释放出炽热的蓝色气体！

original: [src] releases a burst of glowing pollen!
[src] petals shift in hue, it is ready to release more pollen.
translation: [src]的花瓣颜色发生变化，它已准备好释放更多花粉。

original: It would almost be appetizing wasn't it for the green colour and the shifting fluids inside...
translation: 要不是这绿色的外观和里面晃动的液体，它看起来几乎挺诱人的……

original: The contents of this fruit are protected by a tough outer shell.
translation: 这颗果实的内容物被一层坚硬的外壳保护着。

original: A cyan fruit, beating like a creature's heart
translation: 一颗青色的果实，搏动着如同生物的心脏

original: A beautiful flower, what purpose it could serve to the alien hive is beyond you however...
translation: 一朵美丽的花，但它对异形蜂巢有何用处，你却不得而知……

original: A sickly outcrop from the ground. It seems to ooze a strange chemical that shimmers and warps the ground around it.
translation: 地面上一处病态的突起。它似乎在渗出一种奇特的化学物质，使周围的地面闪烁着微光并扭曲变形。

original: A sickly outcrop from the ground. It seems to allow for more advanced growth of the Xenomorphs.
translation: 地面上的一处病态突起。它似乎能促进异形更高级的成长。
